title: Emotional Intelligence, Perceived Stress and Buying Impulsiveness-A Comparative Study among Undergraduate and Postgraduate Students in Kolkata, India
affiliations: Independent and Independent

detail.title: Emotional Intelligence, Perceived Stress and Buying Impulsiveness-A Comparative Study among Undergraduate and Postgraduate Students in Kolkata, India
detail.abstract: The present study compares the relationship of emotional intelligence, perceived stress, and buying impulsiveness among undergraduate and postgraduate students residing in Kolkata and extended Kolkata. The sample consisted of 90 participants, including 54 undergraduate students and 36 postgraduate students. Tools such as the Wong and Law Emotional Intelligence Scale (WLEIS), Perceived Stress Scale (PSS), Buying Impulsiveness Scale (BIS), and a General Information Schedule were administered. The undergraduate and postgraduate students in this study demonstrated relatively high levels of emotional intelligence (EI) and no statistically significant difference in perceived stress levels. The findings also showed no statistically significant difference in the levels of buying impulsiveness between undergraduate (UG) and postgraduate (PG) students. A negative correlation was found between emotional intelligence and buying impulsiveness for both undergraduate and postgraduate students, indicating that students with higher emotional intelligence are generally less prone to impulsive buying behaviours. A weak positive correlation was observed between perceived stress and buying impulsiveness for both groups, although it was not statistically significant.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较了加尔各答地区本科生和研究生的情绪智力、感知压力与购买冲动之间的关系，发现两组学生在情绪智力和购买冲动方面无显著差异，情绪智力与购买冲动呈负相关，感知压力与购买冲动呈弱正相关但不显著。
AI.research_question: 本科生和研究生在情绪智力、感知压力和购买冲动方面是否存在差异，以及这些变量之间的相互关系如何
AI.motivation: 探讨不同学历层次学生的情绪智力、压力感知和消费行为特征，为理解学生消费心理提供实证依据
AI.theoretical_framework: 情绪智力理论、压力-应对理论、冲动购买行为理论
AI.method: 问卷调查法，使用WLEIS情绪智力量表、PSS感知压力量表、BIS购买冲动量表，样本为90名学生（54名本科生，36名研究生）
AI.findings: 1. 本科生和研究生情绪智力水平都较高且无显著差异；2. 两组感知压力水平无显著差异；3. 购买冲动水平无显著差异；4. 情绪智力与购买冲动呈负相关；5. 感知压力与购买冲动呈弱正相关但不显著
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了情绪智力与消费行为关系的研究，为不同学历层次学生的心理行为差异提供了实证证据
AI.practical_contributions: 为高校心理健康教育和消费行为指导提供参考，建议通过提升情绪智力来减少冲动购买行为

title: The Platform Paradox: How Regulatory Fragmentation Undermines Child Online Safety Goals
affiliations: University of North Carolina (UNC) at Chapel Hill - School of Media and Journalism

detail.title: The Platform Paradox: How Regulatory Fragmentation Undermines Child Online Safety Goals
detail.abstract:
The recent wave of state-level social media regulation represents an unprecedented experiment in territorial control of digital platforms. While constitutional questions around state authority remain central to these debates, this article examines a distinct but complementary concern: the mathematical reality of how overlapping technical requirements multiply compliance burdens. These laws aim to protect youth online through technical mandates, yet they create a regulatory patchwork that generates multiplicative rather than additive costs. Following combination theory [N(N-1)/2], each new state regulation creates conflict points with existing requirements.

This article analyzes how this regulatory multiplication affects platform architecture, user experience, and safety outcomes. By examining technical requirements from recently enacted state laws, three key findings emerge. First, state-specific technical mandates force fundamental changes to platform architecture, with each new jurisdiction multiplying system complexity that reduce reliability and divert resources from actual safety improvements. Second, contradictory state requirements create compounding operational burdens, particularly disadvantaging smaller platforms and new entrants—potentially leading to strategic market exit from heavily regulated states and increasing market concentration. Third, the regulatory patchwork paradoxically undermines its own safety goals by incentivizing technical workarounds, fragmenting user experience, and constraining safety innovation—effects that compound as platforms attempt to reconcile growing numbers of conflicting state requirements. These findings suggest the need to rethink assumptions about territorial regulation of global platforms and highlight how mathematical principles can help explain the systemic challenges of fragmented digital governance. This research contributes to both practical policy debates about platform regulation and theoretical understanding of scale challenges in digital governance.

AI.tldr: 州级社交媒体监管通过技术授权形成监管拼凑，产生乘数而非加法的合规成本，导致平台架构复杂性增加、运营负担加重，反而削弱了安全目标，需要重新思考全球平台的属地监管假设。
AI.research_question: 州级社交媒体监管的技术要求重叠如何产生乘数合规负担，以及对平台架构、用户体验和安全结果产生什么影响？
AI.motivation: 近期州级社交媒体监管浪潮代表了数字平台属地控制的空前实验，虽然宪法问题很重要，但本文关注技术要求的数学现实如何产生乘数而非加法的合规成本。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组合理论[N(N-1)/2]，每个新州法规与现有要求产生冲突点，形成监管拼凑的数学原理分析。
AI.method: 分析近期颁布的州法律中的技术要求，研究监管乘数效应对平台架构、用户体验和安全结果的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 州特定技术授权迫使平台架构根本性改变，系统复杂性乘数增长降低可靠性；2. 矛盾要求产生复合运营负担，不利于小平台和新进入者；3. 监管拼凑反而削弱安全目标，激励技术变通方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过数学原理解释碎片化数字治理的系统性挑战，为数字治理规模挑战的理论理解做出贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台监管的实际政策辩论提供见解，重新思考全球平台属地监管的假设，帮助理解监管碎片化的系统性影响。

title: Up-and Cross-Selling to Repeat Customers: Empirical Evidence from Optical Retail

detail.title: Up-and Cross-Selling to Repeat Customers: Empirical Evidence from Optical Retail
detail.abstract: By examining repeat purchases, we study the effect of customer loyalty on the ability to up-sell. Using an extensive dataset from optical retail including the sales activities of more than 410 opticians over 20 years, we track and analyze customer purchases using catalogue and invoice prices, depth of discount and gross profit. We find that the first repeat purchase results in deeper discounts and lower prices, thus decreasing the gross profit. In contrast, the subsequent repeat purchases allow retailers to up-sell customers by shifting them towards products with higher prices and profits. Additional purchases deepen the discount at a constant rate and the other variables show decreasing positive marginal effects. Finally, our results suggest that the effect of repeat purchases on discount depth varies between regular and cross-selling activities, with deeper marginal increases to discount for products sold through cross-selling.

AI.tldr: 通过分析光学零售数据发现，首次重复购买导致折扣加深和利润下降，但后续重复购买能够实现向上销售，推动客户转向更高价格和利润的产品。重复购买对折扣深度的影响在常规销售和交叉销售中存在差异。
AI.research_question: 客户忠诚度（通过重复购买体现）如何影响向上销售的能力？
AI.motivation: 研究重复购买行为对零售商向上销售策略的影响，以及这种影响如何随购买次数变化
AI.theoretical_framework: 客户忠诚度理论、重复购买行为理论、向上销售理论、定价策略理论
AI.method: 使用光学零售行业超过20年、410多家验光师的销售活动数据，通过目录价格、发票价格、折扣深度和毛利润来追踪分析客户购买行为
AI.findings: 1) 首次重复购买导致折扣加深和价格降低，毛利润下降；2) 后续重复购买能够实现向上销售，推动客户转向更高价格和利润的产品；3) 额外购买以恒定速率加深折扣；4) 重复购买对折扣深度的影响在常规销售和交叉销售中存在差异，交叉销售的折扣边际增加更深
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对重复购买行为与向上销售关系理解，揭示了不同购买阶段对定价策略的差异化影响
AI.practical_contributions: 为零售商制定差异化定价和销售策略提供实证依据，帮助优化客户忠诚度管理和向上销售策略

title: Demand for Green Skills in an Evolving Landscape
affiliations: Vienna University of Economics and Business, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Essex, University of Essex and King’s College London

detail.title: Demand for Green Skills in an Evolving Landscape
detail.abstract: How does firms’ skill demand change as the business landscape evolves? We present evidence from the green transition by analyzing how hurricanes impact demand for green skills. These disasters signal the risks of not acting on environmental issues. Using data from U.S. online job postings (2010–2019) and hurricane paths, we create a new measure of green job postings. Firms in areas affected by hurricanes are 6.4% more likely to post jobs that require green skills after the event, particularly those serving local markets.

AI.tldr: 飓风灾害后，受影响地区的企业更倾向于招聘绿色技能人才，特别是服务本地市场的企业，绿色职位发布概率增加6.4%
AI.research_question: 飓风如何影响企业对绿色技能的需求变化？
AI.motivation: 研究企业如何应对商业环境变化，特别是气候变化带来的绿色转型需求
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于环境风险和信号理论，自然灾害作为环境风险的信号影响企业行为
AI.method: 使用美国在线职位发布数据（2010-2019年）和飓风路径数据，构建绿色职位发布的新度量指标
AI.findings: 受飓风影响地区的企业在灾后发布绿色技能职位的概率增加6.4%，特别是服务本地市场的企业
AI.theory_contributions: 为环境风险信号理论提供实证证据，揭示自然灾害如何驱动企业绿色技能需求
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业应对气候变化和绿色转型提供决策参考，帮助政策制定者理解灾害对劳动力市场的影响

title: Impact Of Apple's Branding on Financial Performance: To What Extent Has Apple's Branding Affected Their Financial Performance in the Smartphone Market?

detail.title: Impact Of Apple's Branding on Financial Performance: To What Extent Has Apple's Branding Affected Their Financial Performance in the Smartphone Market?
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the impact of Apple Inc.’s branding on its financial performance in the smartphone market. It explores how Apple’s decisions and focus on design, innovation, and premium positioning have shaped market perceptions and reinforced customer loyalty. By reviewing financial data, market reports, and industry analysis, the paper highlights how branding strategy contributes to Apple’s sustained profitability and ability to command higher price margins compared to competitors. The findings suggest that Apple’s premium branding is not only a marketing strategy but also a key driver of its long-term financial success and market dominance.

AI.tldr: 苹果公司的品牌战略通过设计、创新和高端定位塑造市场认知，增强客户忠诚度，从而推动其财务表现和市场主导地位。
AI.research_question: 苹果公司的品牌战略如何影响其在智能手机市场的财务表现？
AI.motivation: 探讨苹果公司通过品牌战略在竞争激烈的智能手机市场中维持高利润率和市场主导地位的原因。
AI.theoretical_framework: 品牌战略理论、市场营销理论、消费者行为理论
AI.method: 文献综述法，分析财务数据、市场报告和行业分析
AI.findings: 苹果的高端品牌战略不仅是营销手段，更是其长期财务成功和市场主导地位的关键驱动因素
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对品牌战略与财务绩效关系的理解，为品牌价值创造理论提供了实证支持
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业如何通过品牌建设实现溢价能力和市场竞争优势提供了实践指导

title: Combating AI Aversion with Disclosure Framing: The Case of AI-Generated Webcomics
affiliations: University of Macau, University of Macau, University of Macau and Independent

detail.title: Combating AI Aversion with Disclosure Framing: The Case of AI-Generated Webcomics
detail.abstract: The prevalence of artificial intelligence content generation technologies has led platforms and regulators to increasingly demand transparency regarding the use of AI in content production. However, content platforms are concerned about potential negative reactions from viewers when they become aware of the content's AI origin. Additionally, they are interested in whether effective disclosure designs exist that can mitigate the negative impact of AI disclosure. We conducted a field experiment in a company that already uses these technologies to create webcomics for paid consumption, where we voluntarily disclosed to viewers that the comics were generated by AI. Our experiment confirmed that a simple AI-generated content (AIGC) disclosure results in a net decrease of viewer engagement across all performance metrics, including conversion rate, payment amount, number of viewed episodes, and total viewing time. We further designed and tested three disclosure framing strategies aimed at overcoming the negative impact of AIGC disclosure. Our results show that carefully framed disclosure messages can largely mitigate the negative effects of AI disclosure. Specifically, a normative framing indicating that the AI model is accepted by viewers and a technology framing highlighting the advanced nature of the AI system achieved performance metrics that are on par with the non-disclosure case. An effort framing aiming to remind viewers that the AI system is costly to build did not seem to be as effective. Further, a lab experiment not only replicated the findings in the field but also explicated the mechanisms underlying the two working disclosure framing strategies: normative framing reduces uncertainty regarding AI and increases trust in it, whereas curiosity mediates the effect of technology framing. Our cost-benefit analysis concludes that the net gain in productivity largely outweighs the loss from AI disclosure. Finally, our study provides direct AI disclosure strategies for content platforms and producers.

AI.tldr: AI内容生成技术披露会降低用户参与度，但通过规范性和技术性框架的披露设计可以缓解负面影响，提高生产力收益超过披露损失
AI.research_question: AI生成内容披露如何影响用户参与度？是否存在有效的披露框架设计来减轻AI披露的负面影响？
AI.motivation: 平台和监管机构要求AI内容透明度，但平台担心用户对AI内容的负面反应，需要寻找有效的披露策略
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息披露理论、框架效应理论、用户行为反应理论
AI.method: 现场实验（在付费网络漫画平台）+实验室实验，测试三种披露框架策略（规范性、技术性、努力性）
AI.findings: 简单AI披露导致用户参与度全面下降；规范性框架和技术性框架能有效缓解负面影响，绩效指标与不披露情况相当；努力性框架效果不佳
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了AI披露的负面效应机制，阐明了不同披露框架的作用路径（不确定性降低、信任提升、好奇心中介）
AI.practical_contributions: 为内容平台和生产者提供了具体的AI披露策略，证明生产力收益大于披露损失，支持AI技术的商业化应用

title: Drivers and Consequences of In-Store Promotion-Execution Shortfalls: An Analysis for Temporary Loyalty Programs
affiliations: University of Amsterdam, , Tilburg University - Tilburg University School of Economics and Management and Tilburg University - Tilburg University School of Economics and Management

detail.title: Drivers and Consequences of In-Store Promotion-Execution Shortfalls: An Analysis for Temporary Loyalty Programs
detail.abstract: The success of promotional campaigns hinges on their proper execution in retail stores. However, industry reports suggest that commitment to execution standards is often poor. Our study sheds light on the magnitude and drivers of execution shortfalls in temporary loyalty programs (TLPs), and on the impact that these have on store sales. We use a unique dataset that tracks in-store execution during a TLP and create a panel dataset with sales data before, during and after the program. We show that poor execution of in-store promotional instruments (signage, displays, staff knowledge, and reward availability) is ubiquitous, and uncover its link with store characteristics. We also document the pattern of sales losses from execution shortfalls, across instruments and stores, and illustrate that poor execution affects reward redemption in the TLP. Our results can guide retailers and external parties in optimizing the sales effectiveness of in-store promotional execution.

AI.tldr: 本研究揭示了临时忠诚度计划中执行不足的严重程度、驱动因素及其对门店销售的影响，发现促销工具执行不力普遍存在，并证明了执行不足与销售损失和奖励兑换的关系。
AI.research_question: 临时忠诚度计划中执行不足的程度、驱动因素是什么？这些执行不足对门店销售有何影响？
AI.motivation: 行业报告显示促销活动执行标准往往执行不力，但缺乏对执行不足程度、原因及其销售影响的实证研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于零售促销执行理论和忠诚度计划有效性理论，关注店内促销工具执行对销售绩效的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用独特的店内执行追踪数据集，创建包含计划前、中、后销售数据的面板数据集进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 店内促销工具（标识、陈列、员工知识、奖励可获得性）执行不力普遍存在；执行不足与门店特征相关；执行不足导致销售损失并影响奖励兑换。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次实证量化临时忠诚度计划执行不足的程度和影响，拓展了促销执行理论和忠诚度计划有效性的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为零售商和外部方提供优化店内促销执行销售效果的指导，帮助改善促销活动的实际执行效果。

title: JUE Insight: The Uneven Decline of Volatility: Evidence from the U.S. Commuting Zones
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and The University of Sydney

detail.title: JUE Insight: The Uneven Decline of Volatility: Evidence from the U.S. Commuting Zones
detail.abstract: This paper examines the substantial decline in U.S. aggregate employment volatility from 1975 to 2015, emphasizing its uneven regional patterns. We show that mid-sized commuting zones experienced the largest decline in employment volatility. We identify the non-tradable service sector as the key driver of this spatial pattern and find disproportionate growth in the number of large non-tradable service establishments in these mid-sized commuting zones. Because large establishments have lower employment turnover, their growth helps explain the sharper decline in volatility. Our findings highlight micro-founded mechanisms behind volatility dynamics and their spatial variation.

AI.tldr: 美国就业波动性在1975-2015年间显著下降，中等规模通勤区的下降幅度最大，主要受非贸易服务部门大型企业数量增长驱动。
AI.research_question: 美国就业波动性下降的空间模式及其驱动因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解美国整体就业波动性下降现象背后的区域差异和微观机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于企业规模和就业流动性的理论框架，大型企业具有较低的就业流动率。
AI.method: 分析1975-2015年美国通勤区层面的就业数据，识别不同规模通勤区的波动性变化模式。
AI.findings: 中等规模通勤区就业波动性下降最显著；非贸易服务部门是主要驱动因素；大型非贸易服务企业在这些区域的不成比例增长是关键机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了就业波动性空间变化的微观基础机制，强调了企业规模结构变化的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为区域经济稳定政策提供依据，帮助理解不同规模城市就业市场的差异化发展路径。

title: Bayesian Hybrid Machine Learning of Gallstone Risk
affiliations: Yanqi Lake Beijing Institute of Mathematical Sciences and Applications and Mahindra University

detail.title: Bayesian Hybrid Machine Learning of Gallstone Risk
detail.abstract: Gallstone disease is a complex, multifactorial condition with significant global health burdens. Identifying underlying risk factors and their interactions is crucial for early diagnosis, targeted prevention, and effective clinical management. Although logistic regression remains a standard tool for assessing associations between predictors and gallstone status, it often underperforms in high-dimensional settings and may fail to capture intricate relationships among variables. To address these limitations, we propose a hybrid machine learning framework that integrates robust variable selection with advanced interaction detection. Specifically, Adaptive LASSO is employed to identify a sparse and interpretable subset of influential features, followed by Bayesian Additive Regression Trees (BART) to model nonlinear effects and uncover key interactions. Selected interactions are further characterized by physiological knowledge through differential equation-informed interaction terms, grounding the model in biologically plausible mechanisms. The insights gained from these steps are then integrated into a final logistic regression model within a Bayesian framework, providing a balance between predictive accuracy and clinical interpretability. This proposed framework not only enhances prediction but also yields actionable insights, offering a valuable support tool for medical research and decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个混合机器学习框架，结合自适应LASSO进行变量选择，使用BART检测非线性效应和交互作用，并通过微分方程知识增强交互项的生物合理性，最终在贝叶斯框架下构建逻辑回归模型，以提高胆结石疾病预测的准确性和临床可解释性。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个既能提高预测准确性又能保持临床可解释性的机器学习框架来识别胆结石疾病的风险因素和交互作用？
AI.motivation: 胆结石疾病是一个复杂的多因素疾病，传统逻辑回归在高维设置中表现不佳且难以捕捉变量间的复杂关系，需要更先进的建模方法来改善预测和提供可操作的临床见解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于机器学习理论，结合自适应LASSO（变量选择理论）、贝叶斯加性回归树（BART，非线性建模理论）和贝叶斯统计框架，融入微分方程知识来增强模型的生物合理性。
AI.method: 采用混合机器学习框架：1）自适应LASSO进行特征选择；2）BART建模非线性效应和检测交互作用；3）基于生理知识的微分方程增强交互项；4）贝叶斯逻辑回归整合所有发现。
AI.findings: 提出的混合框架能够有效识别胆结石风险因素的重要特征，捕捉复杂的非线性关系和交互作用，同时在保持临床可解释性的前提下提高预测准确性。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了结合变量选择、非线性建模和生物知识整合的混合机器学习理论框架，为复杂疾病的预测建模提供了新的方法论思路。

title: Overconsumption and Self-control: Evidence from Cigarette Purchases
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Overconsumption and Self-control: Evidence from Cigarette Purchases

publicationDetails.detailsText: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper
publicationDetails.journalName: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper Series

detail.abstract: Using transaction data from more than 10,000 smokers across 121 convenience stores, this study examines how consumers exercise self-control when purchasing vice goods. I exploit variation in exposure to multipack discounts (e.g., "buy 2, get $1 off") and show that many smokers forgo these deals in favor of frequent single-pack trips. This pattern is cigarette-specific: the same consumers redeem beverage multi-unit discounts at typical rates. Using an instrumental variable strategy, I find that buying an extra pack due to a discount causes smokers to increase daily smoking by 52%. I then estimate a mixed-type model in which consumers are either (i) sophisticated, (ii) partially naive, or (iii) naive about their overconsumption risk, and find that roughly two-thirds show at least some awareness. Counterfactuals reveal that reintroducing a half-sized pack reduces consumption by 3.2%, while banning quantity discounts cuts it by less than 1%-a result corroborated by evidence from a real statewide discount ban in New York. These findings highlight how consumer self-control can inform more effective policies in vice markets.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分析1万多名吸烟者在121家便利店的交易数据，发现吸烟者会放弃多包折扣优惠（如"买2包减1美元"），选择频繁购买单包香烟，这种模式具有香烟特异性。研究发现折扣导致吸烟量增加52%，约三分之二消费者对过度消费风险有一定认知。政策模拟显示推出半包装可减少3.2%消费，而禁止数量折扣的效果不足1%。
AI.research_question: 消费者在购买恶习商品时如何行使自我控制？多包折扣对吸烟者消费行为的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解消费者在恶习商品市场的自我控制行为，为制定更有效的公共政策提供实证依据
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学中的自我控制理论、消费者 sophistication-naivety 分类框架
AI.method: 利用121家便利店10,000多名吸烟者的交易数据，采用工具变量策略和混合类型模型分析
AI.findings: 吸烟者会放弃多包折扣；折扣导致日吸烟量增加52%；约三分之二消费者对过度消费风险有认知；半包装可减少3.2%消费，禁止折扣效果有限
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了消费者自我控制理论在恶习商品市场的应用，验证了 sophistication-naivety 分类框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定提供实证依据：推出小包装比禁止折扣更有效，帮助设计更精准的公共健康政策

title: Leveraging Sovereign Capital – A Policy Perspective

detail.title: Leveraging Sovereign Capital – A Policy Perspective
detail.abstract: In the world of international capital flows, analysts and policymakers typically focus on private investments. But increasingly, and especially in the past two decades, key participants in cross-border capital flows have been government owned entities-usually referred to as Sovereign Wealth Funds, or SWFs. Today, these SWFs have assets under management (AUM) exceeding USD 13 trillion, making them possibly the most influential class of investors across the world. SWFs are now seen as critical quasi-state actors shaping the global economy of the 21st century. The discussion around SWFs acquired greater relevance recently with an Executive Order 3 issued by the US administration to establish a Sovereign Wealth Fund for the United States. In the past two decades and especially since the Global Financial Crisis of 2007-09, there has been considerable research on the motivations, mandates and investment behavior of SWFs. This paper attempts to review and consolidate the existing literature on the subject from a range of perspectives and to highlight specific policy considerations for SWFs with a focus on the considerations for the host country and its firms that expect to receive and benefit from investments by SWFs. The paper concludes with some policy recommendations.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了主权财富基金（SWFs）作为重要跨境资本流动参与者的研究文献，重点关注其动机、投资行为以及对东道国和企业的政策影响，最后提出政策建议。
AI.research_question: 主权财富基金的动机、投资行为及其对东道国和企业的政策影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 主权财富基金已成为管理资产超过13万亿美元的重要跨境资本流动参与者，特别是在美国考虑建立主权财富基金的背景下，需要系统梳理相关研究文献和政策考量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国际资本流动理论、主权财富基金投资行为理论和东道国政策分析框架
AI.method: 文献综述法，系统梳理和分析过去20年特别是2007-09年全球金融危机以来的相关研究
AI.findings: 主权财富基金已成为21世纪全球经济中关键准国家行为体，其投资行为对东道国和企业具有重要影响
AI.theory_contributions: 整合了主权财富基金研究的多视角理论框架，为后续研究提供理论基础
AI.practical_contributions: 为东道国和企业如何受益于主权财富基金投资提供具体的政策建议和考量

title: Job Mismatch and Early Career Success
affiliations: University of California, San Diego (UCSD) - Department of Economics, University of California, San Diego (UCSD) and

detail.title: Job Mismatch and Early Career Success
detail.abstract: How does being over- or underqualified at the beginning of a worker’s career affect skill acquisition, retention, and promotion? Despite the importance of mismatch for the labor market, self-selection into jobs has made estimating these effects difficult. We overcome endogeneity concerns in the context of the US Air Force, which allocates new enlistees to over 130 different jobs based, in part, on test scores. Using these test scores, we create simulated job assignments based on factors outside of an individual’s control: the available slots in upcoming training programs and the quality of other recruits entering at the same time. These factors create quasi-random variation in job assignment and hence how cognitively demanding an individual’s job is relative to their own ability. We find that being overqualified for a job causes higher attrition, both during technical training and afterward when individuals are working in their assigned jobs. It also results in more behavioral problems, worse performance evaluations, and lower scores on general knowledge tests about the military taken by all workers. On the other hand, overqualification results in better performance relative to others in the same job: job-specific test scores rise both during technical training and while on the job, and these individuals are more likely to be promoted. Combined, these patterns suggest that overqualified individuals are less motivated, but still outperform others in their same job. Underqualification results in a polar opposite set of findings, suggesting these individuals are motivated to put forth more effort, but still struggle to compete when judged relative to others. Consistent with differential incentives, individuals who are overqualified are in jobs which are less valuable in terms of outside earnings potential, while the reverse is true for those who are underqualified.

AI.tldr: 本文通过美国空军新兵分配制度，研究了职业初期资格不匹配对技能获取、留任和晋升的影响。研究发现：资格过高导致更高离职率、更多行为问题，但在同岗位表现更好；资格过低则相反，员工更努力但表现较差。
AI.research_question: 职业初期的资格过高或过低如何影响员工的技能获取、留任和晋升？
AI.motivation: 劳动力市场中资格不匹配现象普遍，但由于自我选择偏误，难以准确估计其因果效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人力资本理论和激励理论，探讨资格不匹配对员工行为和绩效的影响机制。
AI.method: 利用美国空军基于测试分数分配新兵到130多个岗位的制度，创建模拟工作分配工具变量，解决内生性问题。
AI.findings: 资格过高导致更高离职率、更多行为问题、更差绩效评估，但在同岗位表现更好、更易晋升；资格过低则呈现相反模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了资格不匹配的双重效应：激励效应（动机变化）和能力效应（相对表现），深化了对人力资本积累机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织人力资源管理提供实证依据，建议合理匹配员工资格以平衡留任率和绩效表现。

title: Role of Artificial Intelligence in Business Decision-Making

detail.title: Role of Artificial Intelligence in Business Decision-Making
detail.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has emerged as one of the most transformative technologies in the 21st century, redefining the ways businesses operate, compete, and grow. This research paper explores the role of AI in business decision-making, examining its applications, benefits, challenges, and future prospects. Through an analysis of existing literature, case studies, and industry reports, the paper highlights how AI assists in predictive analytics, customer insights, process automation, and strategic planning. The study concludes that while AI enhances efficiency and accuracy in decision-making, ethical considerations, bias, and dependency on data quality remain significant challenges.

title: Developing a Cross-Border E-Commerce Model: The Impact of Consumer Rights Protection, Legal Frameworks, and Cultural Disparities on Consumer Behavior Using the Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB)
affiliations: Case Western Reserve University

detail.title: Developing a Cross-Border E-Commerce Model: The Impact of Consumer Rights Protection, Legal Frameworks, and Cultural Disparities on Consumer Behavior Using the Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB)
detail.abstract: The global e-commerce market has been undergoing rapid changes, with cross-border businesses presenting both benefits and risks to international trade. Although the sphere of accessing global goods and services is growing, concerns about losing consumer rights protection, legislative complications, and confidence in the e-commerce system remain widespread. This paper examines the role of consumer rights protection, laws, and cultural disparities in influencing consumer behaviour in cross-border e-commerce scenarios, incorporating the theory of planned behaviour (TPB). During the study, a quantitative and cross-sectional design was employed to collect data from 381 consumers in the U.S. using Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk). The research focuses on the correlation between consumer awareness, online stores, consumer protection laws in other countries, consumer trust, consumer satisfaction, perceived risk, and buying behaviour. The results indicate that consumer awareness and the presence of e-commerce platforms affect consumer satisfaction and perceived risk, which subsequently influence purchase behavior. The cultural difference moderates the association between consumer satisfaction and purchase behaviour, thereby requiring a cross-cultural, customized e-commerce strategy. The study adds new theory to the field of cross-border e-commerce by extending TPB to include legal and cultural backgrounds. It provides practical suggestions for business strategies and government policies to enhance consumer confidence and foster international e-commerce. The paper also identifies key research gaps that future studies should address, including the exploration of longitudinal designs and the consideration of additional cultural and technological variables.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了消费者权益保护、法律和文化差异在跨境电子商务中对消费者行为的影响，基于计划行为理论，通过定量研究发现消费者意识和电商平台影响满意度和感知风险，进而影响购买行为，文化差异调节满意度与购买行为之间的关系。

AI.motivation: 全球电子商务市场快速发展，跨境业务既带来利益也存在风险，消费者权益保护缺失、立法复杂性和对电商系统信心不足等问题普遍存在。

AI.findings: 消费者意识和电商平台存在影响消费者满意度和感知风险，进而影响购买行为；文化差异调节满意度与购买行为之间的关系

detail.abstract: Global pet ownership and rising veterinary costs have elevated the significance of pet accident insurance. While the global market is projected to grow from USD 18.32 billion in 2024 to over USD 48.98 billion by 2030 (CAGR = 17.97%), insurance penetration remains low (2.48% in the U.S.; 3.10% in Canada). This paper reviews empirical data, identifies coverage gaps, and develops a conceptual framework linking pet ownership, veterinary costs, legal liability, and insurance adoption.

title: Cognitive Immunology: The Adaptive Falsification Hypothesis and the Evolutionary Origins of Scientific Skepticism
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Cognitive Immunology: The Adaptive Falsification Hypothesis and the Evolutionary Origins of Scientific Skepticism

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal conflicts of interest. The research was conducted independently without influence from any organizations or individuals with vested interests in the outcomes or interpretations of the study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This paper presents a theoretical and mathematical framework and does not involve human participants, clinical data, or sensitive subject matter requiring ethics board review.
declarations.funderStatement: This work received no direct funding and was independently developed by the author as part of an ongoing interdisciplinary exploration of time, emergence, and non-linear dynamics.

detail.abstract: Scientific falsification presents an evolutionary paradox: how did humans develop the capacity to deliberately seek disconfirmation of beliefs that historically ensured survival? While philosophers from Popper to Lakatos have debated whether falsification demarcates science, none have explained its cognitive origins. The Adaptive Falsification Hypothesis (AFH) proposes that falsification emerged through cultural hijacking of evolutionary machinery-pattern-detection systems optimized for survival get repurposed as a "cognitive immune system" that attacks our own theories. We integrate four mechanisms to explain this paradox: (1) Cognitive dissonance theory shows how institutions force scientists to resolve contradictions by abandoning theories rather than dismissing evidence; (2) Error Management Theory demonstrates that science reverses evolution's bias from false positives to false negatives; (3) Fitness landscape topology explains why beautiful theories become epistemic traps; (4) Generative Adversarial Networks provide a computational model for automated falsification. AFH generates testable predictions about symmetry detection in threat contexts, the failure rate of aesthetically-driven theories, and the development of falsification capacity. By grounding Popperian philosophy in cognitive science and evolutionary biology, AFH explains why falsification is both essential to science and psychologically unnatural-requiring constant institutional reinforcement against evolved defaults.

AI.tldr: 适应性证伪假说（AFH）通过文化劫持进化机制来解释科学证伪的认知起源，提出证伪能力是通过将优化的模式检测系统重新用作攻击自身理论的"认知免疫系统"而发展出来的。
AI.research_question: 人类如何发展出故意寻求信念证伪的能力，而这种能力在历史上曾威胁生存？
AI.motivation: 科学证伪呈现了一个进化悖论：历史上确保生存的信念，人类为何会发展出故意证伪的能力？哲学家们虽然辩论证伪是否界定科学，但无人解释其认知起源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 适应性证伪假说（AFH），整合认知失调理论、错误管理理论、适应度景观拓扑学和生成对抗网络四个机制
AI.method: 理论整合与概念分析，结合认知科学、进化生物学和计算建模的多学科方法
AI.findings: 证伪是通过文化劫持进化机制发展而来，模式检测系统被重新用作"认知免疫系统"；科学逆转了进化偏向，从假阳性转向假阴性；美丽理论可能成为认知陷阱
AI.theory_contributions: 为波普尔哲学提供认知科学和进化生物学基础，解释证伪为何对科学至关重要但在心理上不自然，需要制度强化来对抗进化默认
AI.practical_contributions: 生成关于威胁情境中对称性检测、美学驱动理论失败率和证伪能力发展的可检验预测，为科学方法论提供认知基础

title: Cross-Platform Complementarity in Digital Advertising Ecosystems: Evidence from Field Data and a Randomized Experiment
affiliations: , Southern University of Science and Technology, Old Dominion University and Arizona State University (ASU) - W.P. Carey School of Business

detail.title: Cross-Platform Complementarity in Digital Advertising Ecosystems: Evidence from Field Data and a Randomized Experiment
detail.abstract: Digital ecosystems have become critical infrastructures in today's economy, enabling firms to coordinate activities, integrate data, and generate network-based advantages. The extant literature emphasizes that digital ecosystems generate value through interdependence and complementarity. Despite extensive theorizing, empirical evidence quantifying how IT-enabled ecosystem complementarity translates into business value is limited. We address this gap by studying a unified digital advertising ecosystem in which platforms share identity data, creative assets, and delivery algorithms. Using a unique dataset of 74,647 promotional campaigns, combined with a randomized field experiment, we identify the causal effects of cross-platform complementarity enabled by IT infrastructure. We find that cross-platform coordination significantly enhances advertising effectiveness-improving impressions, engagement, conversions, and return on investment-especially for low-budget campaigns, diverse ad content, and high-uncertainty product categories. The evidence is consistent with an information-uncertainty reduction mechanism in which complementarity supplies additional, non-redundant informational cues across platforms, rather than simple repetition effects or broader reach. Our study contributes to the IS literature by offering one of the first largescale, causal demonstrations that IT-enabled complementarity within digital ecosystems creates measurable business value. The findings also yield actionable guidance for practice: advertisers can enhance performance by diversifying ad content across platforms to reduce consumer uncertainty, while strategically managing exposure to maximize budget efficiency and sustained campaign impact.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模随机实验证明，IT基础设施支持的跨平台互补性能够显著提升数字广告生态系统的商业价值，特别是对低预算广告、多样化内容和不确定性高的产品类别效果更明显。
AI.research_question: IT支持的数字生态系统互补性如何转化为可衡量的商业价值？
AI.motivation: 尽管数字生态系统通过相互依赖和互补性创造价值的理论已有广泛讨论，但量化IT支持的生态系统互补性如何转化为商业价值的实证证据仍然有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字生态系统理论、互补性理论、信息不确定性减少机制
AI.method: 使用74,647个促销活动的独特数据集，结合随机现场实验，识别IT基础设施支持的跨平台互补性的因果效应。
AI.findings: 跨平台协调显著提升广告效果（印象、参与度、转化率和投资回报率），特别是对低预算广告、多样化广告内容和高不确定性产品类别效果更明显。证据支持信息不确定性减少机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 为IS文献提供了首批大规模因果证据，证明IT支持的互补性在数字生态系统中创造可衡量的商业价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 为广告商提供可操作的指导：通过跨平台多样化广告内容来减少消费者不确定性，同时战略性地管理曝光以最大化预算效率和持续影响。

title: Edge-Cloud Orchestration with Adaptive K-means++ Clustering for Educational Platforms
affiliations: Ibn Tofail University, Ibn Tofail University and Ibn Tofail University

detail.title: Edge-Cloud Orchestration with Adaptive K-means++ Clustering for Educational Platforms
detail.abstract: This paper introduces EduCloud-Orchestrator, a novel framework combining sovereign cloud infrastructure with intelligent VM clustering for Morocco's Massar platform. Our key innovations include: • Hybrid K-means++ algorithm for dynamic VM allocation (38% faster convergence) • Context-aware edge caching using LSTM prediction models (89% hit rate) • Energy-aware scheduling complying with Morocco's Green IT Initiative Experimental results from 326 schools show 82.3% latency reduction while maintaining 99.95% availability during national examinations.

AI.tldr: 提出了EduCloud-Orchestrator框架，结合主权云基础设施和智能虚拟机集群，为摩洛哥Massar平台提供动态VM分配、上下文感知边缘缓存和能源感知调度，在326所学校实验中实现82.3%延迟降低和99.95%可用性。
AI.research_question: 如何为摩洛哥Massar教育平台构建一个结合主权云基础设施和智能虚拟机集群的高效、节能的云计算编排框架？
AI.motivation: 满足摩洛哥教育平台Massar对高性能、低延迟、高可用性的需求，同时符合摩洛哥绿色IT倡议的能源效率要求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于云计算编排理论、虚拟机集群管理理论和边缘计算缓存理论，结合机器学习和预测模型。
AI.method: 采用混合K-means++算法进行动态VM分配，使用LSTM预测模型实现上下文感知边缘缓存，设计能源感知调度机制。
AI.findings: 实验结果显示：38%更快的收敛速度，89%的缓存命中率，82.3%的延迟降低，在国家考试期间保持99.95%的可用性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了结合主权云和智能VM集群的新框架，发展了混合K-means++算法和基于LSTM的上下文感知缓存理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为摩洛哥教育系统提供了可扩展的云解决方案，显著提升了系统性能，符合绿色IT标准，具有实际部署价值。

title: Understanding User Engagement and Competing Cascades in Social Media Diffusion: A Hawkes-Transformer Approach
affiliations: Shandong University and Southern University of Science and Technology

detail.title: Understanding User Engagement and Competing Cascades in Social Media Diffusion: A Hawkes-Transformer Approach
detail.abstract: Understanding information diffusion on social media is essential for firms seeking to optimize digital strategies and platform governance. Prior research typically models user engagement behaviors such as retweets, comments, and likes individually or in isolation, overlooking the complex interactions among different engagement types and the competitive dynamics among parallel information cascades. To address this theoretical and empirical gap, we propose a novel retweet-centric diffusion model that explicitly captures both the self-exciting nature of retweets and the interactive influences of comments and likes, as well as the competitive interactions between parallel cascades on the same topic. Empirically, we integrate Hawkes-estimated temporal parameters as prior knowledge into a Transformer-based deep learning framework, significantly enhancing prediction accuracy and interpretability of diffusion patterns. Validated using a large-scale dataset from Sina Weibo, our hybrid approach offers richer insights into engagement dynamics, enabling platforms and firms to strategically manage content visibility, timing, and engagement interactions on social media.

AI.tldr: 提出了一个新颖的基于转发的扩散模型，整合霍克斯过程估计的时间参数到Transformer深度学习框架中，显著提高了社交媒体信息扩散预测的准确性和可解释性
AI.research_question: 如何更好地理解和预测社交媒体上不同类型用户参与行为（转发、评论、点赞）之间的复杂互动关系以及并行信息级联的竞争动态
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常单独建模用户参与行为，忽略了不同参与类型之间的复杂互动以及并行信息级联的竞争动态，存在理论和实证空白
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于霍克斯过程的自激励理论和Transformer深度学习框架，整合时间序列建模和深度学习方法
AI.method: 混合方法：将霍克斯过程估计的时间参数作为先验知识整合到Transformer深度学习框架中，使用新浪微博大规模数据集进行验证
AI.findings: 混合方法显著提高了扩散模式的预测准确性和可解释性，提供了对参与动态的更丰富洞察
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个新颖的转发中心扩散模型，明确捕捉转发的自激励特性、评论和点赞的互动影响，以及并行级联的竞争互动
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台和企业提供了战略性管理内容可见性、时机和参与互动的工具，有助于优化数字战略和平台治理

reference: ADB Economics Working Paper Series No. 799
title: Youth, Labor Market Dynamics, and the Role of Entrepreneurship in Bhutan
affiliations: Asian Development Bank and Asian Development Bank

detail.title: Youth, Labor Market Dynamics, and the Role of Entrepreneurship in Bhutan

publicationDetails.detailsText: ADB Economics Working Paper Series No. 799

detail.abstract: Young people in Bhutan face rising rates of exclusion from employment, education, or training, and limited access to quality jobs, despite gains in education. Entrepreneurship is often viewed as an alternative pathway, but most youth-led ventures remain necessity-driven, informal, and short-lived. Using data from the 2018–2023 Labor Force Survey and the 2024 Jobs and Skills Survey, this paper examines youth entrepreneurship dynamics, including motivations, earnings, productivity, and sectoral patterns. Findings show that opportunity-driven entrepreneurs— especially young women—achieve higher earnings and productivity, but few business ventures by young people transition beyond the early stages. A shift from necessity-driven to opportunitydriven entrepreneurship could yield economic gains equivalent to 1.4% of gross domestic product. Realizing this potential requires gender-responsive, stage-specific support and embedding entrepreneurship within a broader strategy for decent work and inclusive growth.

AI.tldr: 不丹青年面临就业、教育和培训排斥问题，尽管教育水平提高，但优质工作机会有限。研究发现机会型创业（特别是女性创业者）收益更高，但大多数青年创业仍停留在生存型阶段。从生存型向机会型转变可带来相当于GDP 1.4%的经济收益。
AI.research_question: 不丹青年创业的动态特征、动机、收益和生产力表现如何？如何促进从生存型向机会型创业转变？
AI.motivation: 不丹青年面临就业排斥和教育培训机会有限的问题，尽管教育水平有所提高，但优质工作机会仍然匮乏。创业被视为替代路径，但大多数青年创业项目属于生存型、非正规且短暂。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于创业动机理论（生存型vs机会型创业），结合劳动力市场排斥理论和青年就业理论，分析不丹青年创业的经济效益和发展潜力。
AI.method: 使用2018-2023年劳动力调查数据和2024年工作与技能调查数据，分析青年创业动态、动机、收益、生产力和行业模式。
AI.findings: 机会型创业者（特别是年轻女性）获得更高收益和生产力，但大多数青年创业项目难以超越早期阶段。从生存型向机会型转变可带来相当于GDP 1.4%的经济收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对发展中国家青年创业动机与经济效益关系的理解，特别是性别差异在创业成功中的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出需要性别响应、阶段特定的支持政策，并将创业纳入体面工作和包容性增长的更广泛战略中，以促进青年创业从生存型向机会型转变。

title: An Empirical Study on Customers Perception towards Awareness and Usage of Airtel Payment Bank Services with Special Reference to Tirupathur District
affiliations: Jamal Mohamed College (JMC) and Jamal Mohamed College (JMC)

detail.title: An Empirical Study on Customers Perception towards Awareness and Usage of Airtel Payment Bank Services with Special Reference to Tirupathur District
detail.abstract: Airtel Payments Bank. is the first company in India to take a payment bank authorization from the Reserve Bank of India and it became the first live payments bank in the country. On April 11, 2016 opening accounts for its customers. The purpose of the study is to know the awareness and usage level of Airtel payment bank users and find out the gap between awareness and usage level of payment bank users. The response was collected from 126 users of the Airtel payment bank form the Tirupathur District. The study concludes that the majority of the users of payment banks are in the age group of Below 25 Year. The users of payment bank services are aware of the Airtel payment bank.

AI.tldr: 该研究调查了印度Tirupathur地区Airtel支付银行用户的认知度和使用水平，发现大多数用户年龄在25岁以下，且对Airtel支付银行有较好的认知。
AI.research_question: Airtel支付银行用户的认知度和使用水平如何？两者之间存在什么差距？
AI.motivation: Airtel是印度首家获得支付银行授权的公司，研究其用户的认知和使用情况对了解支付银行发展状况具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金融服务采用理论和用户行为理论，研究支付银行服务的认知-使用关系。
AI.method: 从Tirupathur地区收集了126名Airtel支付银行用户的问卷数据，进行定量分析。
AI.findings: 大多数支付银行用户年龄在25岁以下；用户对Airtel支付银行有较好的认知度；认知度与使用水平之间存在一定差距。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了新兴市场数字金融服务采用的理论研究，特别是支付银行这一新型金融模式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为Airtel支付银行和其他支付银行提供用户洞察，帮助改进服务和营销策略，促进数字金融包容性。

title: Impact of Economic Regulation on the Transformation of the Family Institution during the “Reform and Opening Up” Policy
affiliations: Saint Petersburg State University

detail.title: Impact of Economic Regulation on the Transformation of the Family Institution during the “Reform and Opening Up” Policy
detail.abstract:
At the dawn of the «Reform and Opening up» ( gaige kaifang) policy, one of the important issues in the PRC's domestic political narrative was to limit uncontrolled population growth. In view of the poor economic condition caused by the political-economic campaigns of the 1960s and 1970s, the expected economic growth could have been minimised by the ever-increasing population.

To avoid falling into the “Malthus trap”, the “One Child” policy was introduced in 1979, which lasted until 2016. Economic leverage in the form of increased taxation and fines for families that did not follow the government's policy were introduced and actively used to limit fertility. However, the last decade has seen the reversed process — faced with an ageing population and increasing pressure on the social security sector, the government of the People's Republic of China has taken active steps to stimulate fertility. New policies include tax relief and financial support for families. However, in the long term, these measures carry some hidden socio-economic threats.

AI.tldr: 中国从1979年计划生育政策到2016年后的鼓励生育政策转变，分析其社会经济影响和潜在风险
AI.research_question: 中国人口政策从限制生育到鼓励生育的转变过程中，经济杠杆措施的效果如何？存在哪些潜在的社会经济威胁？
AI.motivation: 改革开放初期为控制人口过快增长实施计划生育政策，但近年来面临人口老龄化和社保压力，政策转向鼓励生育，需要分析这种政策转变的经济杠杆效果和潜在风险
AI.theoretical_framework: 马尔萨斯陷阱理论、人口经济学、政策干预理论
AI.method: 政策分析、历史比较分析、社会经济影响评估
AI.findings: 计划生育政策通过税收和罚款等经济手段有效控制了人口增长，但导致人口老龄化问题；当前鼓励生育政策通过税收减免和财政支持等措施，但长期可能带来社会经济威胁
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富人口政策经济杠杆效应的理论研究，为政策转变提供理论依据
AI.practical_contributions: 为中国人口政策调整提供实践参考，警示政策实施中可能面临的社会经济风险

title: Better Listening through Seeing? Origins and Solutions to Multimodal Cognitive Conflict in AI-Generated Visuals
affiliations: , Southern University of Science and Technology, Arizona State University (ASU) - W.P. Carey School of Business, Arizona State University (ASU) - W.P. Carey School of Business and Arizona State University, W. P. Carey School of Business

detail.title: Better Listening through Seeing? Origins and Solutions to Multimodal Cognitive Conflict in AI-Generated Visuals
detail.abstract: Firms have started to invest intensively in generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) to automate workflows, reduce costs, and achieve scalable operations. Yet, despite its promise, the operational effectiveness of GenAI remains uncertain, particularly for multimodal output that may interact directly with end users. We conceptualize and empirically validate a novel operational risk of adoption-multimodal cognitive conflict-which arises when AI-generated visuals are visually salient but semantically misaligned with task content, thereby disrupting user cognitive processing and impairing performance. Drawing on the Cognitive Theory of Multimedia Learning (CTML), we develop a theory-driven prompt engineering framework to mitigate this risk by aligning generative outputs with human cognition. We test this framework in a randomized field experiment on an online learning platform, where students complete dictation task with multimodal interaction. This context is operationally ideal as the platform faces resource constraints, making automated visual generation appealing but risky. Participants were randomly assigned to one of three conditions: no visuals (control), naïve GenAI-generated visuals, or theory-driven GenAI-generated visuals. Results show that naïve visuals reduced practice intensity and impaired dictation performance without improving monetization. In contrast, theory-driven visuals increased practice attempts by 29.9%, improved learning performance, and raised average user payments by 23.23 RMB. Our study contributes by introducing the origins of a new operational risk in multimodal GenAI adoption, proposing a theory-driven solution, and validating it through a field experiment.

AI.tldr: 本文识别并验证了多模态生成式AI应用中的认知冲突风险，提出了基于多媒体学习认知理论的理论驱动提示工程框架，并通过现场实验证明该框架能有效提升用户学习表现和商业价值。
AI.research_question: 多模态生成式AI在操作应用中如何避免视觉显著性但语义错配导致的认知冲突风险？
AI.motivation: 企业大量投资生成式AI以实现工作流自动化和规模化运营，但多模态输出的操作效果存在不确定性，特别是可能直接与终端用户交互的场景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多媒体学习认知理论（Cognitive Theory of Multimedia Learning, CTML），构建理论驱动的提示工程框架。
AI.method: 在在线学习平台上进行随机现场实验，将参与者分为三组：无视觉内容（对照组）、朴素生成式AI生成视觉内容、理论驱动生成式AI生成视觉内容。
AI.findings: 朴素视觉内容降低了练习强度和听写表现，而理论驱动视觉内容使练习尝试增加29.9%，改善学习表现，并将平均用户支付提高23.23元。
AI.theory_contributions: 引入了多模态生成式AI采用中的新型操作风险概念——多模态认知冲突，并提出了理论驱动的解决方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了可操作的提示工程框架，帮助在资源受限环境下安全有效地部署多模态生成式AI，同时提升用户体验和商业价值。

title: North West Indian Sociological Association (NWISA) Conference 2023 Missing Women: Son-meta Preference
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: North West Indian Sociological Association (NWISA) Conference 2023 Missing Women: Son-meta Preference
detail.abstract: "Missing women" describes the deficit of women in populations caused by gender bias before and after birth. The paper synthesizes evidence on three linked ideas: (1) sex ratio at birth (SRB) distortions driven by son preference and access to sex-selection, (2) post-birth excess female mortality, and (3) son meta-preference parents' tendency to keep having children until they get a son, which skews family composition even when sex-selective abortion is curbed. Using India as the main case and global comparators (China, Republic of Korea), we document trends to 2023, quantify scale, and assess what worked. India's SRB (girls per 1,000 boys) has improved from roughly ~919 (2015-16) to ~929 (2019-21) but remains below the biological norm; South Korea normalized to ~105 boys per 100 girls by 2022; China continues to decline from a 2005 peak >120 boys per 100 girls but still sits above normal. UNFPA estimates suggest well over 100 million girls/women are "missing" globally when birth and post-birth discrimination are combined. We close with policy recommendations: protect and enforce anti-sex selection laws, attack the meta-preference through incentives and social norm change, invest in girls' survival and human capital, and monitor SRB transparently.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了全球"失踪女性"现象，重点关注印度、中国和韩国的出生性别比扭曲、产后超额女性死亡率以及儿子元偏好问题，提出了政策建议。
AI.research_question: 全球"失踪女性"现象的规模、趋势和影响因素是什么？如何有效应对性别偏见导致的出生前后女性缺失问题？
AI.motivation: 性别偏见导致的大量女性缺失是一个严重的全球性问题，需要系统分析其成因、规模和解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人口学中的性别选择理论、家庭经济学中的生育决策理论，以及社会规范对生育行为的影响理论。
AI.method: 采用印度为主要案例，中国和韩国作为全球比较对象，分析截至2023年的趋势数据，量化规模并评估有效干预措施。
AI.findings: 印度出生性别比从2015-16年的约919女孩/1000男孩改善到2019-21年的929，但仍低于生物正常水平；韩国已恢复正常（约105男孩/100女孩）；中国从2005年峰值>120持续下降但仍偏高。全球估计有超过1亿女性"失踪"。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"儿子元偏好"概念，深化了对性别选择行为的理解，建立了综合分析出生前后性别歧视的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了具体的政策建议：保护并执行反性别选择法律、通过激励措施和社会规范改变来应对元偏好、投资于女孩生存和人力资本、透明监测出生性别比。

title: Young Firms Under Pressure: Heterogeneous Investment Responses to a Trade Shock
affiliations: ETH Zürich and Heinrich Heine University Dusseldorf - Duesseldorf Institute for Competition Economics (DICE)

detail.title: Young Firms Under Pressure: Heterogeneous Investment Responses to a Trade Shock
detail.abstract: This paper studies heterogeneous firm responses to a sudden trade-induced profitability shock – the 2015 Swiss franc appreciation. Using firm-level investment data and a novel measure of exposure, we document that this trade shock causes large and persistent investment declines among affected firms. Examining heterogeneous responses among firms with similar exposure, we find that differences in responsiveness are not explained by economic fundamentals but are strongly linked to firm age and managerial experience. Younger firms and those led by less experienced managers react substantially more strongly. We argue that these empirical patterns are consistent with a model of Bayesian learning, in which firms update their beliefs about profitability over time. The results provide important insights into the long-lasting effects of trade shocks on business dynamism, capital investment, and local employment.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2015年瑞士法郎升值这一突发贸易冲击对企业投资的异质性影响，发现受影响企业投资大幅持续下降，且年轻企业和经验不足管理者管理的企业反应更强烈，这符合贝叶斯学习模型。
AI.research_question: 企业如何对突发贸易冲击（2015年瑞士法郎升值）做出异质性投资反应？企业年龄和管理者经验如何影响这种反应？
AI.motivation: 理解企业在面对突发贸易冲击时的异质性反应机制，特别是企业年龄和管理者经验在其中的作用，有助于揭示贸易冲击对企业动态、资本投资和就业的长期影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯学习模型，企业随时间更新对盈利能力的信念
AI.method: 使用企业层面投资数据和新的暴露度测量方法，分析2015年瑞士法郎升值冲击
