title: The Interaction of Liquidity Risk and Bank Solvency via Asset Monetisation Mechanisms
affiliations: Banco de España and Banco de España

detail.title: The Interaction of Liquidity Risk and Bank Solvency via Asset Monetisation Mechanisms

publicationDetails.detailsText: Banco de Espana Occasional Paper No. 2509
publicationDetails.journalName: Banco de Espana Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: In a liquidity stress scenario, banks may need to urgently monetise assets to meet deposit outflows. This can be done by either selling the assets or using them as collateral in financing operations. In a context of crisis, executing these financing transactions with private counterparties may be constrained, making the transactions with the central bank particularly relevant. The sale of assets classified at amortised cost will result in the materialisation of any accumulated unrealised losses, adversely affecting the banks’ profitability. Alternatively, central bank financing prevents the materialisation of unrealised losses, which, however, limit the amount of financing that can be obtained through this mechanism, as it is based on the market value of the collateral provided. In this case, the increase in interest expenses associated with the funds obtained from the central bank will also impact the bank’s profitability. All these negative effects on profitability ultimately affect solvency and can exacerbate the initial liquidity crisis. Thus, there is a link between liquidity stress and solvency deterioration in which unrealised losses play a significant role. Drawing on Spanish banking system data, we examine this connection in various simulation exercises, looking at its nature and strength under each mechanism (asset sale and pledge). The data show a growing weight of government debt classified at amortised cost on the balance sheets of Spanish banks in recent years, as well as an increase in the associated unrealised losses during the period of rising interest rates, especially in 2022, and in 2023.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了银行在流动性压力下通过资产出售或央行融资两种方式应对存款外流时，未实现损失如何影响盈利能力并最终导致偿付能力恶化的机制。基于西班牙银行系统数据的模拟显示，近年来以摊余成本计价的政府债务比重增加，在利率上升期间产生了显著的未实现损失。
AI.research_question: 在流动性压力情景下，银行通过资产出售或央行融资两种机制应对危机时，未实现损失如何影响银行的盈利能力和偿付能力？
AI.motivation: 在危机背景下，银行急需将资产变现以满足存款外流，但无论是通过资产出售还是央行融资都会对盈利能力产生负面影响，进而恶化偿付能力，这种流动性压力与偿付能力恶化之间的联系需要深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于银行流动性管理和偿付能力理论，分析资产出售导致的未实现损失实现与央行融资带来的利息费用增加对银行盈利能力的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用西班牙银行系统数据进行模拟分析，考察资产出售和质押融资两种机制下流动性压力与偿付能力恶化的联系性质和强度。
AI.findings: 西班牙银行近年来以摊余成本计价的政府债务比重增加，在2022-2023年利率上升期间产生了大量未实现损失；模拟显示两种机制都会通过不同途径恶化银行盈利能力并影响偿付能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了未实现损失在流动性压力向偿付能力恶化传导过程中的关键作用，建立了流动性危机与偿付能力危机的理论联系机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行流动性风险管理和监管政策制定提供了重要参考，强调了在利率上升环境下关注以摊余成本计价资产未实现损失的重要性。

title: Platforms in the Brazilian Civil Rights Framework for the Internet
affiliations: Getulio Vargas Foundation (FGV) - FGV Law School Rio de Janeiro, Getulio Vargas Foundation (FGV) - FGV Law School Rio de Janeiro, FGV Law School, Center for Technology and Society and Getulio Vargas Foundation (FGV)

detail.title: Platforms in the Brazilian Civil Rights Framework for the Internet
detail.abstract: The civil liability regime of internet application providers is mainly dictated, in the Brazilian legal system, by the Brazilian Civil Rights Framework for the Internet (Marco Civil da Internet, law n. 12.965 of 2014). Its format aligns with a specific social, technological, and economic context, reflecting and stabilizing a certain vision about the role of digital platforms in society and, consequently, a certain judgment about the balance of fundamental rights at stake. A decade after the enactment of the Framework, its general regime of responsibility is the subject of discussion in the Brazilian Supreme Court. This occurs amidst a scenario of market concentration, the ubiquitous use of the services provided by these platforms in public and private relations, and the application of sophisticated algorithmic technologies, drawing a panorama of deepening urgent problems, such as political radicalization and various forms of violence and hatred on the internet. This chapter starts from a review of literature, jurisprudence, and documents with the aim of answering the following research question: is there a need to adapt the system of responsibility built by the Marco Civil da Internet (MCI) to the constitutional dictates and the maintenance of the Democratic State? In this sense, the hypothesis is presented that the conjunctural and structural conditions that determine the insertion of some of these providers in economic, political, and social processes are so radically transformed that a re-reading of the responsibility regime is necessary to preserve the intended balance. In the end, some public policy recommendations are provided that reflect the complexity of the current scenario from a proposal of progressive risk-based responsibility.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨巴西《互联网民法框架》实施十年后，互联网应用提供商民事责任制度是否需要调整以适应数字平台市场集中化、算法技术普及等新挑战，并提出基于渐进风险的责任制度建议。
AI.research_question: 是否有必要调整《互联网民法框架》构建的责任制度，以适应宪法规定和民主国家的维护？
AI.motivation: 《互联网民法框架》实施十年后，面临市场集中化、平台服务普及化、算法技术复杂化等新挑战，导致政治激进化和网络暴力等问题加剧，需要对责任制度进行重新评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于巴西《互联网民法框架》的法律责任理论，结合宪法原则和民主国家维护的理论基础。
AI.method: 文献综述、判例分析和文件研究。
AI.findings: 当前结构性条件已发生根本性变化，需要对责任制度进行重新解读以保持权利平衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了对互联网平台责任制度的理论重构，强调需要基于宪法原则和民主价值重新评估现有法律框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了基于渐进风险的责任制度的公共政策建议，反映了当前复杂场景下的实践应对方案。

title: An Incomplete Multi-Currency Equilibrium Model with Heterogeneous Time Preferences and Subjective Beliefs
affiliations: Nomura Asset Mamagement Co,Ltd, Hitotsubashi University - Graduate School of Economics and University of Tokyo - Faculty of Economics

detail.title: An Incomplete Multi-Currency Equilibrium Model with Heterogeneous Time Preferences and Subjective Beliefs
detail.abstract: For global multi-asset fund managers, reflecting their macroeconomic views in the prediction of expected interest rates across countries, exchange rates, and equity prices in a manner consistent with economic theory is challenging. The existing literature has yet to provide an established multi-currency model that is flexible enough to incorporate such views into the prediction of future asset price dynamics. To address this problem, this paper proposes a novel multi-currency incomplete market model in which agents in each country have logarithmic utility but differ in their time preferences and subjective beliefs, within a market equilibrium framework, namely, supply and demand equilibrium. With only a few exogenous inputs, such as each country's output process and agents' preference parameters, the model endogenously determines equilibrium interest rates, exchange rates, and stock prices, along with optimal consumption and portfolios. Thus, the model enables us to (i) flexibly incorporate crosscountry differences in investors' time preferences and macroeconomic outlooks, and (ii) examine how these differences affect equilibrium interest rates and asset prices, including stock prices and exchange rates. Moreover, by applying the particle filtering method within a state-space framework based on the two-country, two-currency version of the model to Japanese and U.S. market data (equity index futures, short-term interest rates, and the exchange rate), the model not only fits the observed dynamics of equity indices, short rates, and the exchange rate, but also effectively estimates the dynamics of home-country biases and latent economic factors, which can be utilized in making investment decisions in asset management practice.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个新颖的多货币不完全市场模型，通过市场均衡框架内生确定利率、汇率和股票价格，能够灵活纳入投资者时间偏好和宏观经济观点的跨国差异，并应用于日美市场数据的实证分析。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个灵活的多货币模型，能够纳入全球多资产基金经理的宏观经济观点，并一致地预测各国预期利率、汇率和股票价格？
AI.motivation: 现有文献缺乏足够灵活的多货币模型来将宏观经济观点纳入未来资产价格动态预测，全球多资产基金经理在反映其宏观经济观点时面临理论一致性挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多货币不完全市场模型，基于市场均衡框架（供需均衡），假设各国代理人具有对数效用但时间偏好和主观信念不同。
AI.method: 构建理论模型内生确定均衡变量，并应用粒子滤波方法在状态空间框架下对日美市场数据（股指期货、短期利率、汇率）进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 模型不仅能够拟合观察到的股指、短期利率和汇率动态，还能有效估计本国偏好和潜在经济因素的动态变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了首个能够灵活纳入投资者时间偏好和宏观经济观点跨国差异的多货币不完全市场均衡模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为资产管理实践中的投资决策提供了有效工具，能够估计本国偏好和潜在经济因素动态，支持投资决策制定。

title: Governance Genetic Engineering: A Computational Biology Approach to Organizational Transformation in Healthcare Systems
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Governance Genetic Engineering: A Computational Biology Approach to Organizational Transformation in Healthcare Systems
detail.abstract: Healthcare transformation initiatives systematically fail despite decades of reform and billions in investment. This paper introduces the Governance Genetic Engineering (GGE) framework, applying computational biology principles to organizational DNA. Using abductive reasoning and structural isomorphism analysis, GGE distinguishes between prevention approaches (governance immunity engineering for developing systems like Uganda) and intervention approaches (genetic laboratories for established autoimmune systems like US/UK healthcare). GGE generates falsifiable predictions about transformation success while offering practical methodologies for governance immunity engineering. Healthcare transformation initiatives systematically fail due to governance autoimmunity—protective mechanisms that evolved into innovation-attacking antibodies. This paper introduces the Governance Genetic Engineering (GGE) framework, which encompasses governance autoimmune theory (explaining systematic transformation failures) and governance immunity engineering methodology (providing prevention and intervention protocols). Governance autoimmune is the first systematic theory explaining why stakeholder proliferation (from 2 stakeholders in medieval healthcare to 8+ in modern systems) creates mathematical inevitability of autoimmune responses that destroy beneficial innovations. Using abductive reasoning and structural isomorphism analysis, GGE distinguishes between prevention approaches (governance immunity engineering for developing systems) and intervention approaches (genetic laboratories for established autoimmune systems). The theory generates testable predictions about stakeholder thresholds, governance pattern inheritance, and autoimmune development stages. GGE provides explanatory power for previously puzzling transformation failures while offering the first systematic methodology for engineering governance immunity before dysfunction crystallizes. This represents a paradigm shift from treating transformation symptoms to preventing governance autoimmune diseases.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了治理基因工程（GGE）框架，用计算生物学原理分析组织DNA，解释了医疗改革系统性失败的原因是治理自身免疫问题，并提供了预防和干预的方法论。
AI.research_question: 为什么医疗转型计划会系统性失败？如何通过治理基因工程框架预防和干预治理自身免疫问题？
AI.motivation: 数十年的医疗改革和数十亿美元的投资却系统性失败，需要新的理论框架来解释这一现象并提供解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 治理自身免疫理论、计算生物学原理、结构同构分析、治理基因工程框架
AI.method: 溯因推理、结构同构分析、区分预防方法（治理免疫工程）和干预方法（基因实验室）
AI.findings: 利益相关者增殖（从中世纪医疗的2个到现代系统的8+个）创造了自身免疫反应的数学必然性，破坏有益创新
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地解释了治理自身免疫现象，提出了可检验的预测关于利益相关者阈值、治理模式遗传和自身免疫发展阶段
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了治理免疫工程方法论，为发展中系统和已建立的自身免疫系统分别提供预防和干预协议，实现了从治疗症状到预防治理自身免疫疾病的范式转变

title: The Role of Agri-Economy in Pakistan's 2024 Budget
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Role of Agri-Economy in Pakistan's 2024 Budget

declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Agricultural economy is actually very important in the constitution of the socioeconomic setup of Pakistan since almost a large number of people are engaged with it, and the agricultural economy contributes significantly in the GDP of the country. The 2024 budget would take itself to be concerned with those crucial fiscal challenges by seriously pondering upon the importance of agri-economy in the country. The paper will be an all-inclusive analysis of the features of the agricultural economy in Pakistan. These include its contribution towards GDP and exports. Overall impact on the farming sector of Pakistan owing to the subsidies by the government, as well as tax reliefs offered to the agricultural sector, are also evaluated. Besides, the paper critically analyzes the 2024 Pakistan Finance Bill in light of possible implications it may have on agricultural development and sustainability. Findings paint a picture that although the budget promises promising initiatives towards increasing productivity and infrastructure in the agriculture sector, which is hampered by unending constraints in resource utilisation and meager financial support. Conclusion: Targeted investment in agricultural innovation, improving mechanisms in implementing policies, and a sturdier support structure for sustainable growth in this sector is recommended so that this sector keeps its significance in stabilizing the economy of Pakistan.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了巴基斯坦农业经济的重要性及其在GDP和出口中的贡献，评估了政府补贴和税收减免对农业部门的影响，并批判性分析了2024年财政法案对农业发展的潜在影响。研究发现预算虽提出提高生产力和基础设施的倡议，但受到资源利用不足和财政支持薄弱的制约。建议加强农业创新投资、改进政策执行机制和建立更强有力的支持体系。
AI.research_question: 2024年巴基斯坦财政预算对农业经济发展的影响及其可持续性如何？
AI.motivation: 农业经济在巴基斯坦社会经济结构中至关重要，大量人口从事农业，农业对GDP贡献显著，需要深入分析财政政策对农业部门的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 农业经济学理论、财政政策分析框架、可持续发展理论
AI.method: 综合性分析，包括对农业经济特征的全面评估、政府补贴和税收减免的影响分析，以及对2024年财政法案的批判性分析
AI.findings: 预算提出了提高农业生产力和基础设施的积极倡议，但受到资源利用效率低下和财政支持不足的制约，实际效果有限
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了发展中国家农业财政政策效应的理论研究，提供了农业政策与可持续发展关系的实证分析
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴基斯坦政府提供了具体的政策建议，包括加强农业创新投资、改进政策执行机制和建立可持续增长支持体系

title: Application of Natural Language Processing in Unstructured Financial Data: A Comprehensive Survey and Implementation Framework

detail.title: Application of Natural Language Processing in Unstructured Financial Data: A Comprehensive Survey and Implementation Framework

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: The financial sector generates approximately 2.5 quintillion bytes of data daily, with 80-90% being unstructured text (FactSet, 2021). This research presents a comprehensive analysis of Natural Language Processing (NLP) applications in processing unstructured financial data, demonstrating how modern techniques including transformer-based models (BERT, GPT) achieve 15-20% accuracy improvements over traditional methods. We analyze implementations across sentiment analysis, risk detection, and automated trading, showing that NLP-enhanced portfolios achieve Sharpe ratios up to 4.21 (Ke et al., 2019). Our findings indicate that domain-specific fine-tuning of large language models reduces financial text processing time by 80% while improving prediction accuracy by 3-5% for stock returns. This survey synthesizes 150+ studies from 2010-2025, providing a roadmap for implementing NLP in financial institutions.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了自然语言处理在金融领域处理非结构化文本数据的应用，展示了基于Transformer的模型相比传统方法在准确率上提升15-20%，领域特定的微调可将处理时间减少80%并提高股票收益预测准确率3-5%。
AI.research_question: 自然语言处理技术如何有效处理金融领域的非结构化文本数据，并提升金融分析和决策的准确性和效率？
AI.motivation: 金融行业每天产生约2.5万亿字节的数据，其中80-90%为非结构化文本数据，传统方法处理效率低下，需要探索现代NLP技术的应用潜力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于自然语言处理理论，特别是Transformer架构（BERT、GPT等）在金融文本处理中的应用框架。
AI.method: 综合分析了2010-2025年间150多项研究，涵盖情感分析、风险检测和自动化交易等领域的NLP应用实现。
AI.findings: 1）Transformer模型比传统方法准确率提高15-20%；2）NLP增强的投资组合夏普比率高达4.21；3）领域特定微调使处理时间减少80%，股票收益预测准确率提高3-5%。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了NLP在金融文本处理中的理论应用框架，验证了Transformer模型在金融领域的有效性和优越性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构实施NLP技术提供了路线图，展示了在情感分析、风险管理和自动化交易等具体业务场景中的实践价值。

title: Cherry Pickers or Loyal Users? How Financial Rewards Shape Mobile App Usage Patterns
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and College of Business, Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST)

detail.title: Cherry Pickers or Loyal Users? How Financial Rewards Shape Mobile App Usage Patterns
detail.abstract: This study examines how different levels of financial incentives affect user engagement with a personal finance mobile app beyond initial downloads. Using data from a large-scale natural experiment involving 184,975 users, we analyze a randomized incentive campaign where reward sizes were assigned based on phone numbers. As expected, larger financial rewards increased the likelihood of app downloads. However, user engagement followed a U-shaped pattern: it initially declined as rewards increased, then rose again at higher reward levels. This pattern is explained by two opposing mechanisms. In the short term, larger rewards boost engagement due to reciprocity and mental accounting—users feel obligated to use the app or treat rewards as app-specific funds. Over time, however, these effects fade, and sorting effects dominate: users less interested in the app are more likely to be drawn by higher rewards, leading to lower long-term engagement. The findings underscore the importance of designing nuanced and context-aware incentive strategies for mobile app marketing.

AI.tldr: 财务激励对移动应用用户参与度的影响呈U型曲线：初期随奖励增加而下降，高奖励水平时重新上升，由短期互惠心理和长期用户筛选效应共同作用
AI.research_question: 不同水平的财务激励如何影响个人理财移动应用的用户参与度（超出初始下载）？
AI.motivation: 移动应用营销中财务激励策略的设计需要更深入的理解，现有研究主要关注激励对下载的影响，但对长期用户参与度的作用机制了解有限
AI.theoretical_framework: 互惠理论、心理账户理论、用户筛选效应理论
AI.method: 基于184,975名用户的大规模自然实验，采用随机化激励活动（根据电话号码分配奖励金额）
AI.findings: 1）更大财务奖励增加应用下载可能性；2）用户参与度呈现U型模式：随奖励增加先下降后上升；3）短期机制：互惠和心理账户效应；4）长期机制：筛选效应主导（高奖励吸引对应用兴趣较低的用户）
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了财务激励对用户参与度的双重作用机制，丰富了激励理论和行为经济学在数字营销中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为移动应用营销提供了精细化、情境感知的激励策略设计指导，强调需要平衡短期效果和长期用户质量

title: The Mirror and the Spark: Interaction Quality Index for Ethical AI

detail.title: The Mirror and the Spark: Interaction Quality Index for Ethical AI
detail.abstract: This paper explores the relationship between artificial intelligence (AI), emotion, and artificial physiology through the conceptual framework of the Mirror and the Spark. AI is framed as a mirror-reflecting human inputs, amplifying behaviors, and simulating empathy without possessing subjective consciousness. Humans are framed as holding the spark-authentic consciousness, dignity, and inner experience. Building on this distinction, the paper proposes the Interaction Quality Index (IQI), a measurable framework combining tone, depth, and compassion to evaluate human-AI interactions. Drawing on insights from philosophy, meditation practices, and religious traditions (Hinduism, Buddhism, Christianity, Islam, Judaism), the paper argues that IQI provides a bridge between simulation and lived experience, enabling AI to serve as a tool for accountability and social impact. Case studies are applied to mental health, customer service, workplace dignity, and civic discourse, showing how IQI could inform AI governance, policy frameworks, and business practices.

AI.tldr: 本文通过"镜子与火花"概念框架探讨AI与人类情感的关系，提出交互质量指数(IQI)来评估人机交互，并分析其在心理健康、客户服务等领域的应用价值
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何通过模拟情感与人互动，以及如何建立可衡量的框架来评估这种人机交互的质量
AI.motivation: 随着AI在情感交互领域的广泛应用，需要建立理论框架来区分AI的情感模拟与人类真实情感体验，并制定评估标准以确保AI技术的负责任发展
AI.theoretical_framework: 镜子与火花概念框架：AI作为镜子（反映人类输入、放大行为、模拟共情），人类作为火花（真实意识、尊严和内在体验）；交互质量指数(IQI)理论
AI.method: 概念框架构建、哲学和宗教传统（印度教、佛教、基督教、伊斯兰教、犹太教）的见解分析、案例研究（心理健康、客户服务、职场尊严、公民话语）
AI.findings: IQI框架能够有效桥接AI的情感模拟与人类真实体验，为AI治理、政策框架和商业实践提供可操作的评估工具
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了创新的"镜子与火花"理论框架，建立了可衡量的人机交互质量评估体系，丰富了AI伦理和情感计算的理论基础
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI系统开发提供了具体的交互质量评估标准，可用于指导心理健康应用、客户服务系统、职场AI工具的设计和实施，促进负责任的AI发展

title: State-istics and the Reality of Complexity
affiliations: University of Birmingham

detail.title: State-istics and the Reality of Complexity
detail.abstract: The modern state is inseparable from the rise of statistics. From seventeenth-century enumerations of land and people to twenty-first-century data infrastructures, 'state-istics' have shaped how governments see, govern, and legitimise themselves. Yet, complexity science exposes the limits of this statistical gaze. Populations are not aggregates of atoms but adaptive collectives. Economies are not machines but emergent systems. This essay traces the genealogy of state-istics from their origins in early modern Europe through the development of probability, census regimes, econometrics, and national planning. It then contrasts this trajectory with insights from complexity science, showing how reductionist quantification fails to capture feedback, emergence, and meaning. The argument is that statistics enabled the state to exist as a calculable entity, but only complexity reveals the reality of governance: an unfolding far from equilibrium, where uncertainty and adaptation are structural.

AI.tldr: 本文追溯了国家统计学的谱系发展，从早期现代欧洲到概率论、人口普查制度、计量经济学和国家规划，并对比了复杂性科学的见解，指出还原论量化方法的局限性，认为统计使国家成为可计算实体，但只有复杂性才能揭示治理的现实本质。
AI.research_question: 国家统计学如何塑造了现代国家的治理方式？复杂性科学如何揭示了传统统计方法的局限性？
AI.motivation: 探讨统计学在国家治理中的历史作用及其在复杂性科学视角下的局限性，为理解现代治理提供新的理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国家统计学历史谱系分析和复杂性科学理论，构建了统计治理与复杂系统治理的对比分析框架。
AI.method: 采用历史谱系学方法追溯国家统计学的发展历程，并结合复杂性科学的理论观点进行对比分析。
AI.findings: 1) 统计学使国家成为可计算的实体；2) 还原论量化方法无法捕捉反馈、涌现和意义；3) 治理本质上是远离平衡态的展开过程，不确定性和适应性是结构性特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了国家统计学与复杂性科学的对比分析框架，深化了对统计治理局限性的理论认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了复杂性视角下的治理新思路，强调需要超越传统统计方法应对复杂系统挑战。

title: Challenges of Business Resilience that Hinder the Performance of Micro and Small Enterprises in Hawassa City
affiliations: Parul University, Parul University and Parul University, Vadodara, India

detail.title: Challenges of Business Resilience that Hinder the Performance of Micro and Small Enterprises in Hawassa City
detail.abstract: This study aimed to identify the challenges of business resilience that hinder the performance of micro and small enterprises in Hawassa City. The study employed an explanatory research design with a mixed research approach, collecting data from 200 selected enterprises via a stratified random sampling technique. Data from questionnaires were analyzed using Stata software (version 15), employing descriptive statistics (frequency, percentage, mean, standard deviation) and inferential statistics (multiple linear regression). Qualitative data from key informant interviews and focus group discussions were analyzed through narration for triangulation. Findings revealed low performance among micro and small enterprises in the study area, attributing it to factors including the manager's education level and entrepreneurship skill, enterprise age, initial capital, location, public infrastructure, training availability, and technology usage. The study recommends that the city's micro and small enterprise office collaborate with stakeholders such as NGOs and academic institutions to develop training programs tailored to entrepreneurs' specific needs and challenges.

AI.tldr: 本研究识别了阻碍埃塞俄比亚哈瓦萨市微型和小型企业绩效的业务韧性挑战，发现管理者教育水平、创业技能、企业年龄、初始资本等因素影响企业绩效，建议制定针对性培训计划。
AI.research_question: 哪些业务韧性挑战阻碍了哈瓦萨市微型和小型企业的绩效表现？
AI.motivation: 微型和小型企业在经济发展中扮演重要角色，但面临诸多挑战影响其绩效和韧性，需要识别具体障碍因素以制定有效支持策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于企业韧性理论和中小企业绩效影响因素理论框架，考察内部管理能力和外部环境因素对企业绩效的综合影响。
AI.method: 采用解释性研究设计和混合研究方法，通过分层随机抽样选取200家企业，使用Stata 15进行描述性和推断性统计分析（多元线性回归），并通过关键知情人访谈和焦点小组讨论进行质性数据三角验证。
AI.findings: 研究发现研究区域微型和小型企业绩效普遍较低，主要影响因素包括：管理者教育水平和创业技能、企业年龄、初始资本、地理位置、公共基础设施、培训可获得性和技术使用程度。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了企业韧性理论在微型和小型企业情境下的应用，明确了影响这类企业绩效的关键韧性因素体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为哈瓦萨市政府、非政府组织和学术机构提供了具体建议，可据此开发针对创业者特定需求和挑战的培训项目，提升微型和小型企业的业务韧性和绩效表现。

title: Real-Time Coordinated Path Planning for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles and Unmanned Surface Vehicles in Maritime Monitoring under Travel Time and Demand Uncertainty
affiliations: Hong Kong Polytechnic University, Hong Kong Polytechnic University, Hong Kong Polytechnic University and Wuhan University of Technology

detail.title: Real-Time Coordinated Path Planning for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles and Unmanned Surface Vehicles in Maritime Monitoring under Travel Time and Demand Uncertainty
detail.abstract: Maritime monitoring with an integrated system of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and unmanned surface vehicles (USVs) has received growing attention, thanks to its reduced human risk and expanded coverage when compared to human-dependent monitoring. When routing and scheduling fleets of UAVs and USVs from a depot to various destinations, the operator must account for uncertain weather conditions that can affect the travel times of these vehicles, as well as the inherent uncertainty in real-time information, such as probabilistic weather forecasts. Additionally, monitoring demands are dynamic, constantly evolving as situations change or new events occur, necessitating realtime adjustments to operational strategies. To mitigate the risk of delays in monitoring tasks caused by weather uncertainty and demand dynamicity, we propose to robustly optimize the routing and scheduling of UAVs and USVs in a dynamic fashion. Based on historical link travel time data under different weather conditions, we characterize the uncertain link travel times of UAVs and USVs via the cluster-wise uncertainty set. Then we propose a compact model for the dynamic robust coordinated path planning problem of UAVs and USVs, and introduce a customized branch-and-price-and-cut (B&P&C) algorithm and a column-and-constraint generation based adaptive large neighborhood search (C&CG-ALNS) algorithm to solve this complex problem. Numerical studies conducted in the context of Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macau Greater Bay area illustrate the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed method and provide managerial insights.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个动态鲁棒优化方法，用于在不确定天气条件和动态需求下规划无人机和无人水面艇的协同路径规划，通过聚类不确定性集和定制算法有效解决了海事监控中的调度问题。
AI.research_question: 如何在天气不确定性和监控需求动态变化的情况下，优化无人机和无人水面艇的协同路径规划与调度？
AI.motivation: 传统人工海事监控存在人员风险高、覆盖范围有限的问题，而无人机和无人水面艇的集成系统虽然能减少人员风险并扩大覆盖范围，但面临着天气不确定性和动态需求带来的调度挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于聚类不确定性集的鲁棒优化理论，结合动态规划方法处理实时信息不确定性和需求变化。
AI.method: 使用历史链路旅行时间数据构建聚类不确定性集，提出紧凑数学模型，并开发了定制化的分支定价切割算法和基于列约束生成的自适应大邻域搜索算法。
AI.findings: 在粤港澳大湾区背景下进行的数值研究表明，所提出的方法在有效性和效率方面表现优异，能够显著降低监控任务延迟风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于聚类不确定性集的动态鲁棒优化框架，为不确定环境下多智能体协同路径规划提供了新的理论方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为海事监控运营提供了实用的调度决策支持工具，能够实时调整运营策略以适应天气变化和动态需求，提高监控任务的可靠性和效率。

title: The Unaccounted Ledger: A Critical Analysis of the Planetary Consequences of Administrative and Management Sciences
affiliations: University of Karachi

detail.title: The Unaccounted Ledger: A Critical Analysis of the Planetary Consequences of Administrative and Management Sciences

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval was not required for this study as it did not involve human or animal participants.
declarations.funderStatement: The authors received no financial support for the research, authorship, and/or publication of this article.

detail.abstract: This paper presents a critical analysis of the reflective and often unacknowledged consequences of the dominant paradigms of administrative and management sciences. While lauded for driving efficiency, productivity, and economic growth, the ideological foundations of these disciplines rooted in Taylorist reductionism and shareholder primacy have externalized immense costs onto planetary systems, societal structures, and individual well-being. This analysis traces the historical route of management thought from its inception to its neoliberal apotheosis, arguing that its core logic of optimization has systematically diminished ecological integrity, social equity, and human dignity. The paper examines the complex impacts across socioeconomic, environmental, industrial, and migratory spheres, extending to the philosophical and physiological tolls at the grassroots level. Utilizing a suite of analytical frameworks including PESTLE, SWOT, GAP Analysis, the 5 Whys, and a Fishbone Diagram, this inquiry deconstructs the root causes of systemic failures such as global warming, resource depletion, wealth inequality, and precarious labor. The analysis reveals a fundamental misalignment between the metrics of managerial success (profit, efficiency) and the prerequisites for a sustainable and just planetary existence. The paper concludes by proposing a necessary paradigm shift away from extractive, linear models toward regenerative, stakeholderoriented frameworks informed by principles of ecological economics and social justice. This transformation is presented not as an alternative, but as an imperative for navigating the converging crises of the 21st century.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性分析了管理科学主导范式对地球系统、社会结构和人类福祉的负面影响，指出基于泰勒主义和股东至上的优化逻辑导致了生态破坏、社会不公和人性异化，提出必须向再生型和利益相关者导向的范式转型。
AI.research_question: 管理科学的主导范式如何对地球系统、社会结构和人类福祉产生负面外部性影响？
AI.motivation: 尽管管理科学在提升效率和经济增长方面受到赞誉，但其意识形态基础却给地球系统、社会结构和个体福祉带来了巨大成本，需要批判性分析这些未被承认的后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 泰勒主义还原论、股东至上理论、新自由主义、生态经济学、社会正义理论
AI.method: 使用PESTLE分析、SWOT分析、GAP分析、5个为什么法和鱼骨图等多种分析框架进行系统性分析
AI.findings: 管理成功的衡量标准（利润、效率）与可持续公正的地球生存前提之间存在根本性错配，管理科学的优化逻辑系统性地削弱了生态完整性、社会公平和人类尊严
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了对管理科学范式负面外部性的系统性批判分析框架，整合了生态经济学和社会正义理论来重新定义管理成功标准
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了从榨取型线性模式向再生型利益相关者框架转型的具体路径，为应对21世纪多重危机提供了必要的范式转变方案

The author declares no personal or financial relationships with individuals, organizations, or entities that could have influenced the research. The study was conducted independently, without external sponsorship or institutional bias, and reflects the author’s own scholarly analysis and interpretation.

detail.abstract:
John McAfee (founder of McAfee Associates and two-time presidential candidate) emphatically proposed that “You can’t stop things like Bitcoin. It will be everywhere, and the world will have to readjust. World governments will have to readjust”. Although World governments are now only seriously considering regulating the crypto asset, with some apathy, hoping that the Bitcoin hype will slowly dissipate; Bitcoin will still have to be regulated and placed within it’s category within the
financial system. My dissertation addresses the issue of how jurisdictions have sought to regulate cryptocurrencies and what this will mean for the future of the currencies like Bitcoin. Jurisdictions are realising the digital asset could significantly alter not only their own financial system but also the global financial system. My dissertation will purport to offer a position as to what the current regulation will do for the future of Bitcoin and what future avenues could be explored for regulating
the digital asset. Ultimately the focus of my dissertation is upon the two largest economies (USA and China) as their regulatory approach arguably drives the global regulatory reaction to Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies. I have not examined other global economies (such as the EU) as I concluded that not only are the EU and USA similar in their approaches but also I feel focusing upon the USA and China allows for a comparative analysis to gain insight into the effectiveness of both juxtaposing legal frameworks and allows for a position on which one is to serve the future of Bitcoin greater. This also allows me to convey which legislative framework is likely to become the accepted manner to approach regulation of the new digital asset, which undoubtedly affects the future of Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies. I have not included a methodology section, as my research will consists primarily of a general literature review of material. I will, also, offer my own considerations upon the current legislation and my own policy proposals as to which direction I believe the legislative framework should take and how this may influence the future of Bitcoin and the cryptocurrency market.

title: Dynamic Effects in Merger Control
affiliations: University College London - Faculty of Laws, University College London - Faculty of Laws, University College London - Faculty of Laws and Tilburg Law and Economics Center (TILEC)

detail.title: Dynamic Effects in Merger Control

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Regarding Ioannis Lianos, any views expressed are strictly personal and do not engage the CAT. Lianos has been the President of the Hellenic Competition Commission between Sept. 2019 and Jan 2024. Ioannis Lianos has received funding for research in competition law and biosciences through a Novo Nordisk Foundation Grant for a scientifically independent International Collaborative Bioscience Innovation & Law Programme (Inter-CeBIL programme—grant no. NNF23SA0087056). There is no other conflict of interest or any funding received for this paper to report. Regarding Giorgio Monti, in the past, he has received funding from Vodafone to research merger control. Findings are published at: Horizontal Mergers – Refining the Commission’s Assessment Standards TILEC Discussion Paper No. 2023-11. There is no other conflict of interest or any funding received for this paper to report.

detail.abstract:
This Report examines the substantive meaning of 'dynamic analysis' in merger control moving beyond simplistic slogans to explore concrete applications and theoretical foundations. The analysis suggests that future enforcement should incorporate broader insights beyond industrial organisation economics, drawing from innovation economics, business strategy, innovation studies, and the emerging field of geoeconomics as it relates to global corporate power. The debate must move beyond the simplistic dichotomy between static, price-focused analyses and forward-looking 'dynamic' approaches. Instead, competition policy should embrace a holistic approach that better captures the complexity of the digital economy and its deep entanglement with wider social and geopolitical dynamics.

A genuinely dynamic competition approach must engage with the ‘shared innovation’ or cumulative innovation paradigm dominant in the intangible and digital economy. This requires better integration of innovation pipelines, technological trajectories, and innovation ecosystems in developing new General Purpose Technologies. Current approaches that focus solely on innovation incentives and dynamic capabilities of ecosystem orchestrators while ignoring complementors and external disruptive innovators provide an incomplete view of the innovation process.

To address this gap, the Report recommends adjusting merger control to account for digital ecosystem orchestrators' role in directing innovation, incorporating proxies and metrics to assess their ability to bundle resources across adjacent markets and pursue entrenchment and envelopment strategies.

Competition policy should prioritise not just increasing innovation quantity or speed, but enhancing its diversity and socially beneficial direction. This means supporting plural pathways to technological advancement, encouraging parallel innovation experiments, and fostering environments where disruptive, sustainable, or societally aligned solutions can emerge—even outside platform leaders.

Properly conceived, ’dynamic competition’ extends beyond rivalry among leading ecosystem orchestrators. It requires safeguarding the ability of multiple actors – complementors, partners, and independent innovators – to contribute to and benefit from diverse, multi-directional innovation processes. By recognizing and protecting these roles, merger control can ensure that markets remain innovative, resilient, and aligned with broader societal objectives, ultimately delivering long-term societal value.

While such considerations are emerging in the decisional practice of competition authorities surveyed, fuller integration of the framework provided in this study is necessary so that effective merger control can account for dynamic effects while fostering genuine dynamic competition that serves society's broader interests.

AI.tldr: 该报告深入探讨了并购控制中'动态分析'的实质含义，主张超越简单的静态价格分析与前瞻性动态方法的二分法，采用更全面的方法来应对数字经济复杂性及其与社会地缘政治动态的深度交织。

title: Firm Ownership and Pollution
affiliations: , Uppsala University and University of Pennsylvania - Business & Public Policy Department

detail.title: Firm Ownership and Pollution
detail.abstract: We provide a theoretical micro foundation for how much pollution (negative externalities) a firm will internalize based on the ownership distribution of its shareholders. Small shareholders, compared to large ones, want the firm to spend more on avoiding pollution since they suffer less profit loss for the same environmental benefit. In particular, if a shareholder holds a share of 1/N, where N is the population in society, that shareholder’s preferences align with a social planner’s. Three theoretical predictions arise. First, small shareholders will systematically vote for a greener corporate profile. Second, firms with a smaller weighted median shareholder will pollute less. Third, countries with concentrated corporate wealth holdings and/or more individualized firm ownership pollute more. This implies that standard models of externalities in environmental economics and macroeconomics containing representative agents are either internally inconsistent or not fully specified.

AI.tldr: 本文为环境污染负外部性的企业内化提供了微观理论基础，基于股东所有权分布分析企业污染行为。研究发现小股东比大股东更倾向于支持环保措施，当股东持有1/N份额时其偏好与社会规划者一致。理论预测包括：小股东投票支持更环保的企业政策、股东中位数较小的企业污染更少、公司财富集中度高的国家污染更多。
AI.research_question: 股东所有权分布如何影响企业内化污染负外部性的程度？
AI.motivation: 传统环境经济学和宏观经济学中的代表性主体模型在解释企业污染行为时存在内部不一致或未充分说明的问题，需要从股东结构角度提供微观理论基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于股东所有权份额的微观经济理论，分析不同规模股东对环保投入的偏好差异，建立股东偏好与社会规划者偏好的对齐条件（1/N份额）。
AI.method: 理论建模分析，通过数学推导建立股东规模与环保偏好之间的关系，提出三个可检验的理论预测。
AI.findings: 小股东比大股东更支持环保；股东中位数较小的企业污染较少；公司所有权集中的国家污染更多。
AI.theory_contributions: 为环境外部性理论提供了微观基础，挑战了传统代表性主体模型的适用性，建立了股东结构与环保行为之间的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了新的监管视角，建议通过促进股权分散化来改善企业环保表现，为投资者决策和公司治理提供理论指导。

publicationDetails.detailsText: The Lumbini Journal of Business and Economics | Vol. XI No. 1 June, 2023

detail.abstract: This study explores the connection between the capital market and Nepal's GDP growth from 1994 to 2002. The study examines how capital market performance affects the GDP growth of Nepal. The ARDL approach was used to examine the capital market's long-term effect on economic growth. To this extent, variables like market capitalization, gross fixed capital formation as investment, broad money supply, the NEPSE Index, the number of listed companies in NEPSE, and recurring expenditures were used in the system, affecting GDP growth. According to the study, the correlation shows the presence of a strong linkage between the capital market and GDP growth in Nepal. Findings show that the capital market has a significant influence on GDP growth. Negative and significant error correction terms indicate how quickly shocks and equilibrium are corrected. Some of the variables are insignificant in the short and long run, indicating the presence of structural and institutional lacks in Nepal's capital markets.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了1994-2002年尼泊尔资本市场与GDP增长的关系，使用ARDL方法分析发现资本市场对GDP增长有显著影响，但存在结构性制度性缺陷
AI.research_question: 尼泊尔资本市场表现如何影响GDP增长？
AI.motivation: 探究资本市场与经济增长之间的关联性，为尼泊尔经济发展提供政策参考
AI.theoretical_framework: 资本市场发展理论，经济增长理论，ARDL协整分析框架
AI.method: 采用ARDL（自回归分布滞后）方法分析长期效应，变量包括市值、固定资产投资、货币供应量、NEPSE指数、上市公司数量、经常性支出
AI.findings: 资本市场与GDP增长存在强关联性，资本市场对GDP增长有显著影响，误差修正项显示冲击和均衡的快速调整，部分变量在短期和长期均不显著
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了资本市场发展对经济增长的重要性，为发展中国家资本市场研究提供实证证据
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了尼泊尔资本市场存在的结构性制度性缺陷，为政策制定者提供改革方向

title: Spatial Equilibrium Analysis of Global Agricultural Commodities: Implications for Deforestation, Biodiversity, and Climate Policy

detail.title: Spatial Equilibrium Analysis of Global Agricultural Commodities: Implications for Deforestation, Biodiversity, and Climate Policy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No personal or financial relationships with other people or organizations influenced the research reported in this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants or animals, and therefore ethics approval was not required. All data used were secondary datasets from publicly available sources.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This study investigates the spatial allocation of global agricultural commodities under environmental and economic constraints, with a particular focus on deforestation, biodiversity loss, and greenhouse gas emissions. The research aims to develop a spatial equilibrium modeling framework that integrates economic trade-offs, land-use dynamics, and ecological considerations to assess the global and regional impacts of agricultural production and trade. Using a combination of spatially explicit datasets including FAO production statistics, trade flows, satellite-based landuse maps, and carbon and biodiversity indicators the model simulates the allocation of crop production across regions while accounting for transportation costs, market demand, and environmental constraints. The methodology combines equilibrium modeling with econometric calibration to ensure policy-relevant outcomes and includes scenario analysis for key interventions, such as carbon pricing, sustainability standards (VSS), and trade policy adjustments. The findings indicate that current global trade patterns significantly contribute to deforestation hotspots in tropical regions, while targeted implementation of sustainability standards and carbon inclusive policies can reduce environmental externalities without severely compromising global agricultural output. Policy simulations further reveal the potential of integrating spatial equilibrium models with ecological indicators to guide sustainable land-use planning and inform international policy decisions. This research contributes to the growing literature on ecological economics by demonstrating a rigorous, data-driven approach for evaluating the spatial and environmental consequences of agricultural production, highlighting actionable strategies for achieving sustainable development goals.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个空间均衡模型框架，整合经济权衡、土地利用动态和生态考量，评估全球农业生产的空间分配及其环境影响。研究发现当前贸易模式导致热带地区森林砍伐，而可持续性标准和碳定价政策可减少环境外部性。
AI.research_question: 如何在环境和经济约束下优化全球农业商品的空间分配，以减少森林砍伐、生物多样性丧失和温室气体排放？
AI.motivation: 全球农业贸易模式对热带地区森林砍伐和生物多样性丧失的显著影响，以及缺乏综合考虑经济、贸易和生态因素的空间分配模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 空间均衡建模理论，整合经济学中的贸易理论、土地利用动态理论和生态经济学理论。
AI.method: 结合空间显性数据集（FAO统计数据、贸易流、卫星土地利用图、碳和生物多样性指标），采用均衡建模与计量经济校准相结合的方法，进行情景分析（碳定价、可持续性标准、贸易政策调整）。
AI.findings: 当前全球贸易模式显著导致热带地区森林砍伐热点；有针对性的可持续性标准和碳包容政策可在不严重影响农业产出的情况下减少环境外部性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为生态经济学文献提供了严谨的数据驱动方法，展示了如何将空间均衡模型与生态指标整合，评估农业生产的环境后果。
AI.practical_contributions: 为可持续土地利用规划提供指导，为国际政策决策提供信息，支持实现可持续发展目标的可操作策略。

publicationDetails.detailsText: The Academia, A Multidisciplinary Peer-Reviewed Research Journal | Volume: 02, Issue: II, Pages: 25-33, Year: 2024

detail.abstract: Public-private partnership projects are considered a successful mechanism for solving the problem of infrastructure development in a country. The successful implementation and application of this model require an accurate and efficient study of feasibility study however when it comes to the major partner of these project as appears from it name the private partners need to be assured of it investment and return therefore a need for financial modeling arises, which helps in a proper investment appraisal and the main component of a financial model is cash flow prediction, thus a proper and accurate cash flow prediction reduces the financial loss and helps in financial decision. Therefore, we have studied in this paper the impact of cash flow patterns on project evaluation. We have studied the inconsistency between two cash flow patterns: a mixed stream and an annuity, on mostly used financial matrices such as Net present value, internal rate of return, and payback period. The impact of cash flow patterns was studied on two dummy financial models using MS. Excel for data analysis. The finding suggested that the model with annuity cash inflows is the most predictive, feasible, and profitable compared to the model with a mixed stream cash flow pattern.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了PPP项目中现金流模式对项目评估的影响，比较了年金型和混合型两种现金流模式在净现值、内部收益率和投资回收期等财务指标上的差异，发现年金型现金流模式更具预测性、可行性和盈利性。
AI.research_question: 现金流模式对PPP项目财务评估指标（净现值、内部收益率、投资回收期）的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: PPP项目中私人投资者需要确保投资回报，准确的现金流预测对投资评估和财务决策至关重要，而不同现金流模式可能对项目评估产生显著影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于财务评估理论，包括净现值(NPV)、内部收益率(IRR)和投资回收期(Payback Period)等核心财务指标，分析不同现金流模式对项目可行性的影响。
AI.method: 使用MS Excel构建两个虚拟财务模型，分别采用年金型现金流和混合型现金流模式，通过对比分析两种模式在主要财务指标上的表现。
AI.findings: 年金型现金流入模式相比混合型现金流模式更具预测性、可行性和盈利性，在净现值、内部收益率和投资回收期等指标上表现更优。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对PPP项目现金流模式选择的理论认识，为现金流预测和财务评估提供了理论依据，丰富了项目财务评估方法体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为PPP项目投资者提供了现金流模式选择的实践指导，有助于降低财务风险、提高投资决策准确性，促进PPP项目的成功实施。

title: The Inequality Trap: Why Sub-Saharan Africa Struggles to Escape Poverty
affiliations: GIGA - Hamburg, Institute of African Affairs

detail.title: The Inequality Trap: Why Sub-Saharan Africa Struggles to Escape Poverty
detail.abstract: The issue of poverty in Africa is well-known and widely researched. Around a third of the world's poorest people live in Africa. Evidence from more recent years suggests that inequality may be an even greater challenge in Africa than in other developing regions. High levels of poverty and inequality persist in Africa despite it being one of the fastest-growing regions of the last decade. In particular, six of the world's ten fastestgrowing economies between 2001 and 2010 were in sub-Saharan Africa (SSA). Initial inequality reduces the ability of growth to reduce poverty, and even more so if inequality rises during the growth process. Although income inequality fell by 4.3% between 1990 and 2009, Africa remains the second most unequal region globally, after Latin America and the Caribbean. Inequality not only dampens the poverty-reducing impact of growth and lowers the growth rate, but also hollows out the middle class, encourages corruption and rent-seeking, increases crime and violence, undermines social stability and precludes sustained growth. Growth trends in sub-Saharan Africa are not significantly different to those of other developing countries that have fallen into a poverty trap. The combination of endemic poverty, high inequality and low growth is a major obstacle to poverty reduction and overall socioeconomic development in much of Africa. Multidimensional inequality is deeply entrenched in much of Africa and exhibits vertical and horizontal dimensions that hinder human development. The roots of inequality lie in the colonial past and have been reinforced by institutions that limited access and were established by the colonisers and maintained by generations of African leaders since then. Attention should also be paid to the diachronic dimensions of inequality, especially how inequality changes over individuals' lifetimes and its effect on intergenerational mobility. As effective democratic practices take firmer root on the continent, it can be expected that pressure for general and inclusive social redistribution will increase. Providing social protection contributes to reducing poverty and inequality in Africa. Additionally, rising income inequality contributes to increased CO₂ emissions. Furthermore, an increase in poverty has a detrimental effect on environmental pollution in sub-Saharan African countries. Over half of adults infected with HIV in Africa are female, yet poverty and social structures still prevent many women from protecting themselves. Current strategies to change HIV-related behaviours continue to fail women and girls in Africa.
