title: Processing Location for Cross-Border Perishables with Arrival-Rate-Conserving Conversion: Thresholds, Strategy Frontiers, and a China-US Case
affiliations: University of Wisconsin-Madison

detail.title: Processing Location for Cross-Border Perishables with Arrival-Rate-Conserving Conversion: Thresholds, Strategy Frontiers, and a China-US Case

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have appeared to influence the work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study uses optimization modeling and secondary, non-identifiable logistics/market data only; no human participants, patient data, or animal subjects were involved, and no IRB/ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This research addresses the processing-location selection problem in cross-border perishable food supply chains by endogenizing processes of state conversion (e.g., conversion of fresh produce to powder) within an arrival-rate-conserving network model. Due to typical spoilage rates between 15% and 40% occurring in conventional chains, we develop a linear programming formulation that endogenizes state-dependent losses and conversion yields. Contribution stems from three main features: (i) we derive pure analytical decision thresholds, specifically critical distance and critical ocean-freight cost, to identify when it is better to process at source or destination; (ii) we provide an entirely linear, flow-conserving formulation that separately accounts for raw versus powder transport and trade/regulatory costs; (iii) we present the analytics as managerial decision rules, quantifying uncertainty as well via 95% confidence intervals. For example, we calibrate with China to the U.S. case for konjac. The relevance is visible since, while processing at destination (shipping raw) in the baseline example incurs an expected total landed cost of $20,119 (effective loss of 33.4%), processing at the source yields a reduction of expected total landed cost of 52.8% ($9,492), and an effective loss of 62.4%. The critical ocean-freight threshold is $116 per ton; we observed and calibrated the ocean-freight cost at $139 per ton, and based on the model, it indicates processing at source. The sensitivity analysis confirms robustness: the recommended decision rule persists under plus or minus 20% perturbations of key parameters. Data and code are openly available at https://doi.org/10.17632/sdw9rkgf2y.1.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文通过建立一个线性规划模型，解决跨境易腐食品供应链中的加工地点选择问题，推导出关键距离和海运成本阈值作为管理决策规则，并验证了在中美魔薯贸易中处理地点选择的经济效益。
AI.research_question: 如何在跨境易腐食品供应链中选择最优的加工地点（原产地还是目的地）以最大化供应链效益？
AI.motivation: 传统跨境易腐食品供应链常见15%-40%的腐烂损耗，需要通过加工处理（如将生鲜产品转换为粉末）来减少损失，但加工地点选择影响整体成本效益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于到达率保持网络模型，将状态转换过程（如新鲜产品转粉末）内生化，考虑状态依赖性损失和转换生产率。
AI.method: 开发线性规划模型，包含原材料与粉末分离运输、贸易相关成本。通过中国向美国魔薯贸易案例校准模型，进行敏感性分析验证稳健性。
AI.findings: 推导出关键距离阈值和关键海运成本阈值（每吨$116）。在基准案例中，原产地加工比目的地加工节省52.8%总成本，并提供包含95%置信区间的管理决策规则。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了纯分析的决策阈值方法，将状态转换过程内生化到供应链网络模型中，为跨境易腐食品供应链管理提供理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了具体的管理决策规则和阈值指标，可直接应用于跨境易腐食品供应链的加工地点选择决策，有助于降低总体成本和减少贸易损失。

title: Overexposure, Overconfidence, and the Making of India Fatigue
affiliations: Central University of Jammu

detail.title: Overexposure, Overconfidence, and the Making of India Fatigue
detail.abstract: The phenomenon of India Fatigue-a growing global skepticism, irritation, and backlash toward India's demographic rise, cultural assertiveness, and political positioning-has emerged as a complex challenge in international relations. Using economic, sociological, and anthropological perspectives, this paper unpacks its drivers: overexposure of national narratives, reputational fallout from diaspora-linked scandals, perceived cultural overreach, media amplification, and mismatches between India's self-image and external perception. Mechanisms of backlash, including stereotype reinforcement, reactive ethnicity, and counter-hegemonic resistance, are examined alongside high-impact case studies. Scenario projections, including the implications of a hypothetical 50% U.S. tariff on Indian goods, highlight strategic vulnerabilities. The study concludes with targeted recommendations to recalibrate soft power, strengthen diaspora engagement, and mitigate reputational damage while preserving legitimate national interests.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了印度疲劳现象——全球对印度崛起日益增长的怀疑和反感，探讨其成因包括国家叙事过度曝光、侨民相关丑闻、文化扩张感知等，并提出应对策略建议。
AI.research_question: 印度疲劳现象的成因、机制及其对国际关系的影响是什么？如何有效应对这一挑战？
AI.motivation: 随着印度在全球舞台上的崛起，出现了日益增长的国际怀疑和反感情绪（印度疲劳），这种现象对印度的国际形象和外交关系构成挑战，需要系统分析其成因和应对策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 综合运用经济学、社会学和人类学视角，结合刻板印象强化理论、反应性族群认同理论和反霸权抵抗理论来分析印度疲劳现象。
AI.method: 采用多学科理论分析框架，结合高影响力案例研究，并进行情景预测分析（如美国对印度商品征收50%关税的假设情景）。
AI.findings: 识别出印度疲劳的主要驱动因素：国家叙事过度曝光、侨民相关丑闻声誉影响、感知文化扩张、媒体放大效应、自我形象与外部认知错配；揭示了刻板印象强化、反应性族群认同和反霸权抵抗等机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了印度疲劳的概念框架，整合了多学科理论视角，为理解新兴大国崛起过程中的国际反应机制提供了新的理论分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了具体的政策建议：重新校准软实力策略、加强侨民参与、减轻声誉损害，同时在维护正当国家利益的前提下改善国际形象。

title: How LLMs Evolved into Emergence
affiliations: University of Birmingham

detail.title: How LLMs Evolved into Emergence
detail.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) sit at the intersection of centuries of intellectual sedimentation and sudden complexity thresholds. This essay traces their genealogy from Pythagoras’ harmonics, through Euclid’s axioms, Newtonian determinism, Bayesian probability, Gödelian incompleteness, Shannon’s information, and Turing’s computation, to the late-twentieth-century science of complexity. Alongside mathematics and physics, sociology emerges as co-author, framing language as social practice and computation as institutional artefact. The argument is that LLMs are not merely evolved linearly nor emergent ex nihilo. Rather, they evolved into emergence: centuries of structured reasoning and probabilistic insight prepared the ground, while the transformer architecture and scaling laws drove the leap into new coherence. In LLMs, we confront the dialectic of continuity and rupture – evolution layering towards the suddenness of emergence.

AI.tldr: 本文追溯了大型语言模型（LLMs）的谱系发展，从古代数学思想到现代复杂性科学，认为LLMs是数世纪结构化推理和概率洞察的积累与Transformer架构和扩展定律驱动的突现性突破的辩证统一
AI.research_question: 大型语言模型是如何在历史知识积淀与复杂性阈值突破的辩证关系中演化而来的？
AI.motivation: 理解LLMs并非线性进化或凭空突现，而是数世纪知识积累与架构创新共同作用的结果，需要从跨学科视角追溯其思想渊源
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合数学史（毕达哥拉斯和声学、欧几里得公理）、物理学（牛顿决定论）、概率论（贝叶斯）、逻辑学（哥德尔不完备定理）、信息论（香农）和计算理论（图灵）的多学科理论框架
AI.method: 思想史谱系分析方法，通过追溯关键概念和理论的历史演变来理解LLMs的生成逻辑
AI.findings: LLMs是结构化推理传统与概率洞察长期演化的产物，同时受到Transformer架构和扩展定律的技术突破驱动，体现了连续性与断裂性的辩证关系
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"演化进入突现"的理论框架，强调LLMs是历史知识积淀与当代技术突破的辩证统一，为理解AI发展提供了新的历史哲学视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI研究者和开发者提供了理解技术演化的宏观视角，有助于识别未来发展方向和避免重复历史路径

title: Carbon dioxide pipeline network transportation cost model: evaluating economic and geographic factors for efficient carbon capture, storage, and utilization
affiliations: Government of the United States of America - Argonne National Laboratory, Government of the United States of America - Argonne National Laboratory and Government of the United States of America - Argonne National Laboratory

detail.title: Carbon dioxide pipeline network transportation cost model: evaluating economic and geographic factors for efficient carbon capture, storage, and utilization
detail.abstract: We developed a Python-based CO2 pipeline network transportation cost model by leveraging Argonne National Laboratory’s experience with pipeline engineering modeling and detailed cost data for natural gas pipelines in various regions of the United States. The model calculates CO2 pipeline delivery costs through a two-step process. First, it maps out a pipeline route along the existing road system to capture a realistic pipeline route and accurately calculates the pipeline length. Then, given specific CO2 delivery conditions (CO2 throughput, pressure, temperature, and region), it calculates the CO2 pipeline delivery cost by optimizing the pipeline diameter configuration with the number of initial and booster pumps. A standout feature of this model is its ability to simulate a pipeline network to calculate the optimal CO2 delivery cost by connecting multiple CO2 sources to various destinations or storage sites using regional geographic information system-based information. This pipeline network provides a regional CO2 delivery configuration considering practical geographical and supply chain constraints, as the CO2 demand for utilization or storage is typically greater than the CO2 available from individual CO2 sources.

AI.tldr: 基于Python的CO2管网运输成本模型，通过优化管网路径和管径配置来计算最优CO2运输成本
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够准确计算CO2管网运输成本的模型，考虑实际地理约束和管网网络配置？
AI.motivation: CO2利用或存储需求通常超过单个CO2源的供应能力，需要考虑地理约束和供应链配置的管网网络运输方案
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于阿尔尼国家实验室的管道工程模型和自然气管道详细成本数据，结合地理信息系统路径规划理论
AI.method: 两步法：首先沿现有道路系统设计管道路径确定管道长度，然后根据CO2运输条件优化管径配置和泵站数量来计算最优运输成本
AI.findings: 开发了能够模拟CO2管网网络的模型，能够在考虑实际地理约束和供应链配置的前提下计算最优CO2运输成本
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个结合实际地理约束和管网网络配置的CO2运输成本计算理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为CO2损害防治和利用接入管网运输系统提供了实用的成本估算工具，有助于优化区域CO2运输配置

title: Transition from Traditional to Hybrid Cash Operations Management in Banking: A System Dynamics Approach and Empirical Evaluation
affiliations: Association for Financial Professionals (AFP)

detail.title: Transition from Traditional to Hybrid Cash Operations Management in Banking: A System Dynamics Approach and Empirical Evaluation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants or patient data. The analysis is based on synthetic and anonymized data generated for research purposes only, and therefore ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This paper demonstrates how a system dynamics (SD) approach can serve as the foundation for a controlled transition from traditional cash operations management toward a hybrid digital-assisted model in banking. We construct a causal feedback map and a simulation model of cash flows (branch tellers, ATMs, cash in transit and vault inventories), integrate it with algorithms for demand forecasting and route optimization, and then evaluate the economic impact through a quasi-experimental design (difference in differences). Using synthetic but realistic data from a large universal bank (≈300 branches, 1,200 ATMs), the hybrid scenario delivers: • a 34% reduction in annual CIT costs (-6.12m), • a 55m reduction in idle cash balances (capital cost savings ≈ 1.65m/year at a 3% internal rate), • a drop in unplanned ATM cash-out days from 3.2% to 0.9%, • improved short-term forecasting accuracy (MAPE reduced from 19.8% to 6.2%). Implementation costs included CAPEX of 2.8m and incremental OPEX of 0.6m/year, with a payback period of just 3.5 months. The proposed framework is replicable and scalable across banking networks.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统动力学方法构建了银行现金管理的混合数字辅助模型，实现了现金运输成本降低34%、闲置现金减少5500万、ATM缺勤天数从3.2%降至0.9%，投资回收期仅3.5个月。
AI.research_question: 如何利用系统动力学方法实现银行传统现金运营向混合数字辅助模式的平稳过渡？
AI.motivation: 传统银行现金管理存在效率低下、成本高昂、预测不准确等问题，需要数字化解决方案来优化现金流动和资源配置。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统动力学理论，包括因果反馈映射和仿真建模，结合需求预测算法和路线优化算法。
AI.method: 构建现金流动仿真模型（柜员、ATM、现金运输和金库库存），采用准实验设计（双重差分法）评估经济影响，使用大型综合银行的合成但真实数据（约300家分行，1200台ATM）。
AI.findings: 混合模式实现：年度现金运输成本减少34%（-612万），闲置现金减少5500万（资本成本节省约165万/年），计划外ATM缺勤天数从3.2%降至0.9%，短期预测准确性提高（MAPE从19.8%降至6.2%）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于系统动力学的银行现金管理数字化转型框架，为金融运营管理提供了新的理论建模方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可复制和可扩展的实施框架，投资280万资本支出和60万/年运营支出，投资回收期仅3.5个月，具有显著的经济效益和运营效率提升。

title: Global Corporate Attractiveness Index (GCAI)
affiliations: University of Colorado at Denver - Department of Finance

detail.title: Global Corporate Attractiveness Index (GCAI)
detail.abstract: The Global Corporate Attractiveness Index (GCAI) measures the appeal of U.S. cities for global corporations considering new branch locations. The index is built on six weighted criteria: Airport Connectivity (20%), Geographic Centrality (15%), Cost of Living (20%), Climate & Lifestyle Fit (10%), Talent Pipeline (20%), and Cultural Alignment (15%). Our findings show that Denver ranks highest, followed by Chicago and Austin. This index is critical as it provides a systematic, data-driven framework to guide international business expansion in an increasingly competitive and globalized economy.

AI.tldr: 全球企业吸引力指数(GCAI)通过六个加权标准评估美国城市对跨国企业的吸引力，丹佛排名最高，芝加哥和奥斯汀紧随其后。
AI.research_question: 如何系统评估美国城市对全球企业设立新分支机构的吸引力？
AI.motivation: 在日益竞争激烈的全球化经济中，为企业国际扩张提供数据驱动的决策框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多标准决策理论，构建包含机场连通性、地理中心性、生活成本等六个维度的评估框架。
AI.method: 构建加权指标体系：机场连通性(20%)、地理中心性(15%)、生活成本(20%)、气候与生活方式适配度(10%)、人才储备(20%)、文化契合度(15%)。
AI.findings: 丹佛在GCAI中排名最高，其次是芝加哥和奥斯汀。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了系统化的全球企业选址评估理论框架，丰富了国际商务扩张决策理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业国际扩张提供实用的选址决策工具，帮助企业在全球化竞争中做出更明智的投资决策。

title: Establishing a Rehabilitation and Empowerment Center for Drug-Addicted Youth in Gazipur Sadar Upazila
affiliations: North South University

detail.title: Establishing a Rehabilitation and Empowerment Center for Drug-Addicted Youth in Gazipur Sadar Upazila
detail.abstract: Drug addiction among youth in Bangladesh has become a significant social and developmental challenge, undermining both individual potential and community stability (World Health Organization [WHO], 2014). This paper proposes the establishment of a rehabilitation and empowerment center for drug-addicted youth in Gazipur Sadar Upazila, serving as a model for rehabilitation and reintegration. The project adopts a holistic framework that combines medical treatment, counseling, vocational training, capacity building, and socio-economic support to address the multifaceted nature of addiction (Department of Narcotics Control, 2013). Using a development studies approach, this paper outlines the project’s rationale, baseline context, implementation strategies, risk assessment, and monitoring mechanisms. Cost–benefit and social impact analyses demonstrate the feasibility and sustainability of the initiative, highlighting its potential to reduce drug-related crime, restore family stability, and enhance youth productivity (UNODC, 2012). The findings suggest that a community-based, youth-centered model can serve as a replicable strategy for addressing addiction across Bangladesh. Ultimately, the project emphasizes the urgent need to integrate rehabilitation into broader development policies to safeguard the nation’s demographic dividend (Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, 2014).

AI.tldr: 本文提出在孟加拉国Gazipur Sadar Upazila建立针对吸毒青年的康复和赋权中心，采用包含医疗、咨询、职业培训和社会经济支持的整体框架，通过成本效益和社会影响分析证明其可行性和可持续性。
AI.research_question: 如何通过建立社区康复中心来有效解决孟加拉国青年吸毒问题并促进其社会再融合？
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国青年吸毒已成为重大的社会和经济发展挑战，破坏个人潜力和社区稳定，需要综合性的康复和再融合解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 发展研究框架，结合整体康复理论，整合医疗、心理、职业和社会经济多维度干预。
AI.method: 采用发展研究方法，包括基线背景分析、实施策略制定、风险评估、监测机制设计，以及成本效益和社会影响分析。
AI.findings: 社区为基础、以青年为中心的康复模式具有可行性和可持续性，能够减少毒品相关犯罪、恢复家庭稳定并提升青年生产力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个可复制的社区康复理论模型，为发展研究领域提供了整合康复与发展政策的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为孟加拉国及其他类似情境地区提供了具体的康复中心建设方案和实施策略，可作为政策制定和实践操作的参考模板。

title: When Tweets Beat Portfolios

detail.title: When Tweets Beat Portfolios
detail.abstract: Investment advisors publicly share valuable investment signals. A one-standarddeviation increase in their tweet sentiment predicts an 8-basis-point rise in abnormal returns over the following five trading days. While advisors' portfolios have negative alphas, trading strategies based on their tweets significantly outperform on a riskadjusted basis. Short-selling restrictions and transaction costs reduce feasible profits. I rule out several alternative explanations, including price manipulation, ex-post tweet modification, and small stock effect. My results contribute to the debate on the value of investment advisors.

AI.tldr: 投资顾问的推特情绪能够预测股票异常收益，一个标准偏差的推特情绪增长预测五个交易日内8基点的异常收益增长。虽然投资顾问的投资组合不优，但基于其推特的交昗策略在风险调整后表现优异。短期交易限制和交易成本减少了可实现的利润。排除了价格操控、事后推特修改和小股效应等替代解释。
AI.research_question: 投资顾问在社交媒体上分享的投资信号是否具有实际投资价值？
AI.motivation: 评估投资顾问在社交媒体上分享的投资建议的真实价值，并为投资顾问价值辨论提供实证基础
AI.theoretical_framework: 有效市场假设、信息不对称理论、社交媒体信息传播理论
AI.method: 实证分析方法，使用推特情绪数据进行回归分析，量化推特情绪与股票收益的关系
AI.findings: 推特情绪与异常收益呈正相关关系，一个标准偏差的情绪增长预测五个交易日内8基点的异常收益增长
AI.theory_contributions: 为社交媒体上投资信息的价值提供实证支撑，扩展了有效市场理论在数字时代的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 投资者可以利用投资顾问的推特情绪作为投资决策的参考，但需考虑交易限制和成本影响

title: Cognitive Ecologies of AI-Enhanced Learning : Toward a Meta-Intelligent Pedagogy for the Post-Digital Age
affiliations: African Research Network (ARN)

detail.title: Cognitive Ecologies of AI-Enhanced Learning : Toward a Meta-Intelligent Pedagogy for the Post-Digital Age
detail.abstract: This article explores the transformative potential of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in reshaping digital education by introducing the concept of Meta-Intelligent Pedagogy (MIP), a holistic, adaptive, and context-sensitive learning paradigm. Drawing from complexity theory, cognitive science, and innovationology, the study proposes a framework for designing AIenhanced learning ecologies that transcend current models of personalization and automation. The paper critically examines how AI systems can foster higher-order thinking, systemic intelligence, and ethical discernment, while adressing the risks of dehumanization and epistemic injustice. This article combines real-world case studies with speculative scenarios to explore not only how AI is currently reshaping education, but also how it might enable radically new forms of pedagogy in the future. This dual approach ensures both empirical grounding and imaginative foresight, which are essential in a rapidly evolving post-digital educational landscape.

AI.tldr: 本文提出元智能教学法(MIP)概念，通过AI重塑数字教育，构建整体性、自适应、情境敏感的学习范式，结合现实案例与未来情景探讨AI如何促进高阶思维和系统性智能，同时应对去人性化和认知不公的风险。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何通过元智能教学法(MIP)重塑数字教育，在提升高阶思维和系统性智能的同时，避免去人性化和认知不公的风险？
AI.motivation: 当前AI教育模型主要关注个性化和自动化，缺乏对整体学习生态、高阶认知能力和伦理问题的全面考量，需要构建更全面的教学范式以适应后数字时代的教育需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 复杂性理论、认知科学、创新学，构建元智能教学法(MIP)的理论基础
AI.method: 结合现实案例研究与推测性情景分析的双重方法，确保实证基础与想象前瞻性的平衡
AI.findings: AI系统能够促进高阶思维、系统性智能和伦理辨别能力的发展，但需要谨慎应对去人性化和认知不公的风险
AI.theory_contributions: 提出元智能教学法(MIP)概念，为AI教育研究提供新的理论框架和视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计AI增强的学习生态系统提供实用框架，指导教育实践者在AI时代开发更加人性化和伦理敏感的教学方法

title: The Median Man and the Identification Imaginary Lessons from the Compulsory Voting Debate
affiliations: UNSW Australia Business School, School of Economics and Johns Hopkins University

detail.title: The Median Man and the Identification Imaginary Lessons from the Compulsory Voting Debate
detail.abstract: Does compulsory voting benefit the left? Scholars have long hypothesized that it would, since the voters mobilized by the reform should support leftist parties. Yet recent work reveals a puzzling finding: in places where turnout rose because of CV, the left lost relative to places where turnout fell. This paper argues that these results have puzzled scholars because the implicit referent in their theory is working class men. Instead, we suggest that CV could mobilize other citizens with conservative values, for example, rural women. Revisiting the classic Australian case, which instituted compulsory voting in a staggered fashion throughout the twentieth century, we leverage three strategies-a difference-indifferences estimator, an event study model, and the Callaway-Sant'Anna staggered design-to show that CV increased women's turnout and vote share more than men's, and that the left performed worse in rural areas where women's turnout rose disproportionately. Ultimately, we argue that lasting puzzles in comparative politics can be solved by de-centering men in the "identification imaginary.

AI.tldr: 本文通过重新审视澳大利亚强制投票制度，发现强制投票主要动员了具有保守价值观的农村女性而非工人阶级男性，这解释了为什么强制投票反而导致左翼政党表现更差，挑战了传统比较政治学中以男性为中心的理论假设。
AI.research_question: 强制投票是否有利于左翼政党？为什么在强制投票提高投票率的地方，左翼政党反而表现更差？
AI.motivation: 传统理论认为强制投票会动员支持左翼的选民，但实证研究发现投票率上升反而导致左翼表现更差，这一悖论需要新的解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 挑战传统比较政治学中以男性为中心的理论假设，提出需要去中心化男性在"认同想象"中的主导地位。
AI.method: 使用三重策略分析澳大利亚强制投票的分阶段实施：双重差分估计、事件研究模型和Callaway-Sant'Anna交错设计。
AI.findings: 强制投票增加了女性的投票率和得票率多于男性，左翼在农村地区表现更差，因为那里女性投票率上升更显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 解开了强制投票悖论，证明了比较政治学中持久谜题可以通过去中心化男性视角来解决。
AI.practical_contributions: 为选举制度改革提供了新的理论视角，指出强制投票可能产生与预期相反的政治后果。

title: The Effects of Auditors' Facial Traits on Audit Outcomes
affiliations: Department of Accounting, HKUST Business School, Hong Kong University of Science & Technology , University of Southern California - Leventhal School of Accounting, Shanghai University of Finance and Economics and National Chengchi University

detail.title: The Effects of Auditors' Facial Traits on Audit Outcomes
detail.abstract: Research finds that facial traits of CEOs and analysts, both objectively and subjectively measured, affect their behavior. We investigate the facial traits of engagement auditors, an information intermediary whose incentives and role differs uniquely from those of CEOs and analysts. Using data from Taiwan, we find that Big 4 audit partners with higher facial width-toheight ratio (fWHR, which proxies for achievement drive) deliver higher quality audits. We further find that auditors who are perceived as more trustworthy or more attractive are better at acquiring and retaining clients. In addition, we find that all three facial traits are associated with faster promotion to partner. Overall, our findings suggest that auditors' innate physical characteristics, as reflected in their facial traits, have important effects on audit outcomes.

AI.tldr: 研究发现审计师的面部特征（面部宽高比、可信度和吸引力）影响审计质量、客户获取与保留以及晋升速度
AI.research_question: 审计师的面部特征如何影响审计结果和职业发展
AI.motivation: 已有研究发现CEO和分析师的面部特征会影响其行为，但审计师作为信息中介具有独特的激励和角色，需要单独研究
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于面部特征与行为特征关联的理论，面部宽高比(fWHR)代表成就驱动力，可信度和吸引力影响人际互动
AI.method: 使用台湾数据，分析四大会计师事务所审计合伙人的面部特征与审计质量、客户关系、晋升速度的关系
AI.findings: 高fWHR的审计师提供更高质量的审计；被认为更可信或更有吸引力的审计师在获取和保留客户方面表现更好；所有三种面部特征都与更快的合伙人晋升相关
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了面部特征影响行为的研究到审计领域，揭示了物理特征对专业服务提供者的影响机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为会计师事务所的人才选拔和晋升决策提供参考，帮助理解审计质量差异的来源

title: Universal Recursive Preference Structures
affiliations: Université Paris I Panthéon-Sorbonne - Centre d'Economie de la Sorbonne (CES)

detail.title: Universal Recursive Preference Structures
detail.abstract: Given a set X of "outcomes" and a set T of "types", a recursive preference structure (RPS) is a function that assigns a continuous partial order over T x X to every element of T. This describes an agent who has preferences not only over the outcomes in X , but also over her own preferences (as encoded by the types). We prove the existence of a universal RPS ---one into which any other RPS can be mapped in a unique way. Formally, this universal RPS is a terminal coalgebra of a suitably defined endofunctor on the category of compact Hausdorff spaces.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了递归偏好结构（RPS）存在一个通用结构，任何其他RPS都可以通过唯一方式映射到该通用结构中。该通用RPS是紧致Hausdorff空间范畴上适当定义的自函子的终余代数。
AI.research_question: 递归偏好结构是否存在通用结构？
AI.motivation: 研究具有递归偏好的代理人，这些代理人不仅对结果有偏好，还对自己的偏好（通过类型编码）有偏好。
AI.theoretical_framework: 递归偏好结构（RPS）理论，范畴论中的自函子和余代数理论
AI.method: 使用范畴论方法，在紧致Hausdorff空间范畴上定义适当的自函子，并证明其终余代数的存在性
AI.findings: 证明了通用递归偏好结构的存在性，该结构是终余代数，任何其他RPS都可以唯一映射到其中
AI.theory_contributions: 为递归偏好理论提供了范畴论基础，建立了通用结构的存在性定理
AI.practical_contributions: 为建模具有自反偏好的经济代理人提供了理论工具，可用于行为经济学和决策理论

title: From Exit to Extension: The Rise of Continuation Vehicles in Private Equity
affiliations: , Rotterdam School of Management, Erasmus University and Erasmus University - Rotterdam School of Management

detail.title: From Exit to Extension: The Rise of Continuation Vehicles in Private Equity
detail.abstract: We provide one of the first large-sample empirical studies of continuation vehicles (CVs), a rapidly growing secondary transaction in private equity. Using a proprietary dataset of 199 CVs launched from 2014 to 2024, we show that CVs are predominantly sponsored by large, established General Partners (GPs) and often involve high-performing assets. CVs are correlated with fundraising success, though this relationship appears largely driven by their association with strong prior fund performance. CVs enable GPs to extend fee streams, reset carried interest and commit additional capital, resulting in substantial gains, particularly for top-performing assets. They also depart from traditional fund structures with bespoke terms that reshape governance, liquidity, and conflicts of interest among stakeholders, highlighting CVs as hybrid mechanisms that balance financial incentives and liquidity options.

AI.tldr: 本研究对私募股权中快速增长的续期基金（CVs）进行了首次大规模实证分析，发现CVs主要由大型成熟GP发起，涉及优质资产，与募资成功相关但主要受过往基金业绩驱动，CVs通过延长收费期限、重置分成和追加投资为GP带来显著收益，其定制化条款重塑了治理结构和利益冲突平衡机制。
AI.research_question: 续期基金（CVs）的特征、驱动因素及其对私募股权行业各利益相关方的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 随着续期基金在私募股权二级市场中快速增长，但缺乏大规模实证研究来系统分析其特征、经济动因以及对GP、LP等利益相关方的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于代理理论、私募股权基金结构和治理理论，分析CVs如何重塑GP与LP之间的激励相容机制和利益冲突平衡。
AI.method: 使用2014-2024年间199个CVs的专有数据集进行实证分析，采用统计方法和相关性检验。
AI.findings: CVs主要由大型成熟GP发起且多涉及优质资产；与募资成功相关但主要受过往业绩驱动；为GP带来显著经济收益（延长收费、重置分成、追加资本）；通过定制化条款重塑治理结构和流动性安排。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统构建了CVs的理论分析框架，揭示了其作为混合机制在平衡财务激励与流动性选择方面的理论价值，丰富了私募股权二级市场理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为GP提供了CVs运作的实际参考，为LP揭示了CVs的利益分配机制和潜在冲突，为监管机构提供了市场发展的实证依据。

title: Coherent Option Pricing
affiliations: Pennsylvania State University, SUNY at Binghamton - School of Management and Pennsylvania State University

detail.title: Coherent Option Pricing

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We have no conflicts of interest to declare.
declarations.funderStatement: Funding for SPX options data was provided by SUNY Binghamton and the Chinese University of Hong Kong.

detail.abstract: The demand-based option pricing framework of Garleanu et al. (2009) assumes the existence of "end-users" of traded options who have an exogenous non-zero demand for option contracts, but is agnostic with respect to the nature of this demand. In this paper, we shed light on the demand for options by extending the binomial option pricing model to include risk-averse end-users with exogenous exposure to the underlying asset and imperfect delta-hedging by market makers. We derive analytical expressions for supply and demand curves in the index options market. Our model results closely mimic several empirical features of the index options market, including the persistence of a heterogeneous implied volatility surface and time-series correlations between the implied volatility skew and forward-looking measures of investor sentiment.

AI.tldr: 本文通过扩展二项式期权定价模型，纳入具有外生标的资产暴露的风险厌恶终端用户和不完全Delta对冲的做市商，揭示了期权需求的本质，并推导出指数期权市场的供需曲线解析表达式。
AI.research_question: 期权市场中终端用户需求的本质是什么？如何通过包含风险厌恶终端用户和不完全对冲做市商的扩展定价模型来解释指数期权市场的实证特征？
AI.motivation: Garleanu等人(2009)的需求基础期权定价框架假设存在对期权合约具有外生非零需求的"终端用户"，但对该需求的本质保持不可知论态度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Garleanu等人的需求基础期权定价框架，扩展二项式期权定价模型，纳入风险厌恶终端用户的外生标的资产暴露和市场maker的不完全Delta对冲。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，扩展二项式期权定价模型，推导供需曲线的解析表达式，并与实证市场特征进行比较。
AI.findings: 模型结果密切模拟了指数期权市场的多个实证特征，包括异质隐含波动率曲面的持续性，以及隐含波动率偏斜与前瞻性投资者情绪度量之间的时间序列相关性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为期权需求提供了理论解释，揭示了风险厌恶终端用户的外生暴露和市场maker对冲不完全性对期权定价的影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解指数期权市场的供需动态提供了分析工具，有助于市场参与者和监管机构更好地理解期权定价和市场行为。

title: "Beyond the Language Barrier: Digital Divides and Environmental Participation in Immigrant Communities"
affiliations: Faculty of Environmental and Urban Change, York University

detail.title: "Beyond the Language Barrier: Digital Divides and Environmental Participation in Immigrant Communities"
detail.abstract: Municipal environmental communication strategies increasingly rely on digital platforms, yet these approaches may systematically exclude immigrant communities who face cultural, linguistic, and technological barriers to accessing environmental information. This study examines communication barriers among first-generation immigrants in the Greater Toronto Area through a cross-sectional survey of 815 participants across four age cohorts, measuring English proficiency, digital literacy, and municipal resource awareness.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过调查多伦多地区815名第一代移民，发现数字环境传播策略存在系统性排斥问题，移民群体面临语言、文化和科技障碍
AI.research_question: 数字环境传播策略如何系统性地排斥移民社区？移民面临哪些具体的沟通障碍？
AI.motivation: 市政环境传播日益依赖数字平台，但这些方法可能系统性地排斥面临文化、语言和技术障碍的移民社区获取环境信息
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字鸿沟理论、环境传播理论、移民融入理论
AI.method: 横断面调查设计，对大多伦多地区815名第一代移民参与者进行问卷调查，覆盖四个年龄组群，测量英语熟练度、数字素养和市政资源意识
AI.findings: 研究发现移民群体在环境信息获取方面存在显著障碍，包括语言能力不足、数字技能缺乏以及对市政资源认知有限
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了数字鸿沟理论在环境传播领域的应用，提出了移民环境信息获取障碍的综合分析框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为市政部门制定更具包容性的环境传播策略提供实证依据，建议采取多语言、多渠道的传播方式以更好地服务移民社区

title: Application of Deep Learning Models for Real-Time Monitoring and Early Warning of Mine Slope Failures
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Application of Deep Learning Models for Real-Time Monitoring and Early Warning of Mine Slope Failures

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I declare that I have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have influenced the work presented in this study. The design, methodology, analysis, and interpretation of results were performed independently and solely for academic and scientific purposes. All authors contributed equally and adhered strictly to ethical research practices to ensure transparency, accuracy, and objectivity throughout the research and writing process.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research did not involve human participants, animals, or personal data, and therefore, ethics committee approval was not required. The study focused solely on computational modeling, simulation, and the analysis of geotechnical and sensor data obtained from publicly available datasets or non-identifiable operational data provided by industry partners, ensuring no privacy or ethical concerns were violated.
declarations.funderStatement: This study was conducted without external financial support. The research was fully self-funded by the authors as part of an independent academic investigation into the application of deep learning models for real-time monitoring and early warning systems in mine slope stability analysis. No grants, sponsorships, or external funding sources influenced the design, execution, analysis, or reporting of this work.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: Not applicable. This study does not involve a clinical trial or any research requiring clinical trial registration.

detail.abstract: The failure of mine slopes constitutes one of the most serious dangers to surface mine and openpit mining operations as it causes serious harm to the safety of workers, continuation of the operations, and economic viability. Traditional monitoring methods like geotechnical sensors, embracing a periodic visual check and statistical prediction methods, tend to fail in delivering near-real-time, precise and flexible estimations. Such constraints create an acute demand on intelligent systems that will work with complex high-dimensional data in dynamic mining environments. The general approach of deep learning with its ability of automated feature selection and nonlinear pattern recognition provides a revolutionary method of slope stability monitoring. The Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), specifically, a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) model, allow fusing various kinds of sensor data, including InSAR images, ground-based radar, accelerometers, and acoustic emissions. These models have the ability to ascertain spatial-temporal relationships, which can be used to forerun indicators of instabilities earlier than the traditional approaches. The present paper discusses the tool of deep learning models use in real-time monitoring and early warning systems of slope failures. It also emphasizes using sensor networks, big data platforms, predictive analytics in a comprehensive framework that would significantly increase the accuracy and timeliness of hazard detection. A specific focus is given to model adaptability, scalability, and pragmatic implementation both in mining and resource-limited production operations and those that have a high technology profile. This could save lives in the case of an attack because of the reduced probability of false alarms and hence the earlier interventions that could be sent and provide help on time. These consequences include better safety of the workers, fewer economic losses, and greater sustainability of the mining. This paper ends by outlining the research gaps such as explainable AI to support transparency, edge computing to support low latency analysis, and the need to establish some form of policy framework to standardize AI-driven geotechnical monitoring systems.

AI.tldr: 深度学习模型（特别是CNN和LSTM）能够通过融合多源传感器数据，实现对矿山边坡稳定性的实时监测和早期预警，相比传统方法具有更高的准确性和时效性。
AI.research_question: 如何利用深度学习技术实现矿山边坡稳定性的实时监测和早期预警？
AI.motivation: 传统边坡监测方法无法提供近实时、精确和灵活的估计，在动态采矿环境中存在严重局限性，需要智能系统来处理复杂的高维数据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于卷积神经网络（CNN）和长短期记忆网络（LSTM）的深度学习理论框架，能够自动特征选择和非线性模式识别。
AI.method: 使用CNN和LSTM模型融合多源传感器数据（InSAR图像、地基雷达、加速度计、声发射等），建立时空关系模型进行预测分析。
AI.findings: 深度学习模型能够比传统方法更早识别不稳定迹象，显著提高灾害检测的准确性和及时性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于深度学习的边坡稳定性监测理论框架，拓展了AI在岩土工程监测中的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了可实时监测和预警的智能系统，能够减少误报、实现早期干预，提高工人安全性、减少经济损失，提升采矿可持续性。

title: Dynamic Delegation with Reputation Feedback
affiliations: and Ecole Polytechnique

detail.title: Dynamic Delegation with Reputation Feedback
detail.abstract: We study dynamic delegation with reputation feedback: a long-lived expert advises a sequence of implementers whose effort responds to current reputation, altering outcome informativeness and belief updates. We solve for a recursive, belief-based equilibrium and show that advice is a reputation-dependent cutoff in the expert's signal. A diagnosticity condition-failures at least as informative as successes-implies reputational conservatism: the cutoff (weakly) rises with reputation. Comparative statics are transparent: greater private precision or a higher good-state prior lowers the cutoff, whereas patience (value curvature) raises it. Reputation is a submartingale under competent types and a supermartingale under less competent types; we separate boundary hitting into learning (news generated infinitely often) versus no-news absorption. A success-contingent bonus implements any target experimentation rate with a plug-in calibration in a Gaussian benchmark. The framework yields testable predictions and a measurement map for surgery (operate vs. conservative care).

AI.tldr: 研究动态委托与声誉反馈机制，专家声誉影响实施者努力程度，进而影响结果信息量和信念更新。在诊断性条件下（失败比成功更具信息性），声誉趋于保守，建议阈值随声誉上升。声誉在能人类型下是下鞅，在非能人类型下是上鞅。成功奖励机制可实现目标实验率。
AI.research_question: 在动态委托关系中，专家声誉如何影响建议策略和实施者行为？声誉反馈机制如何塑造信念更新和均衡结果？
AI.motivation: 理解在长期委托关系中，声誉机制如何影响专家建议质量和实施者响应，这对于医疗、咨询等专业服务领域具有重要意义
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态博弈理论、声誉模型、贝叶斯学习、递归均衡、诊断性条件理论
AI.method: 建立递归的基于信念的均衡模型，求解声誉依赖的建议阈值策略，分析比较静态和动态性质
AI.findings: 在诊断性条件下（失败比成功更具信息性），建议阈值随声誉上升（声誉保守主义）；声誉在能人类型下是下鞅，在非能人类型下是上鞅；成功奖励机制可实现目标实验率
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了动态委托与声誉反馈的统一分析框架，揭示了声誉对建议策略的系统性影响，提出了诊断性条件和声誉保守主义的新理论见解
AI.practical_contributions: 为手术决策（手术vs保守治疗）等实际应用提供了可测试的预测和测量框架，设计了可实现目标实验率的激励机制

title: The Uniform Computer Information Transactions Act: A Well Built Fence or Barbed Wire around the Intellectual Commons
affiliations: University of New Mexico School of Law

detail.title: The Uniform Computer Information Transactions Act: A Well Built Fence or Barbed Wire around the Intellectual Commons

publicationDetails.detailsText: Warigia Bowman, The Uniform Computer Information Transactions Act: A Well Built Fence or Barbed Wire around the Intellectual Commons, 13 LBJ J. PUB. AFF. 80 (2001).

detail.abstract:
The Uniform Computer Information Transactions Act (UCITA) is a proposed state contract law developed to regulate transactions in intangible goods such as computer software, online databases and other digital products.'

UCITA was intended to act as Article 2B of the Uniform Commercial Code (UCC). Article 2 comprises the law governing commercial transactions in the sale of goods and ensures consistent contract laws from state to state. The stated goal of UCITA is to provide clarity regarding computer information transactions.

AI.tldr: UCITA作为统一商法典第2B条的提案，旨在规范软件、数据库等数字产品的交易，提供统一合同法律框架。
AI.research_question: UCITA作为计算机信息交易统一法的有效性及其对数字产品交易的法律规制作用
AI.motivation: 数字产品交易的快速发展需要统一的法律框架来规范无形商品的交易，确保合同法律的一致性和明确性
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于统一商法典(UCC)的合同法律理论，特别是Article 2关于商品销售的法律框架
AI.method: 法律文本分析和比较法研究，分析UCITA作为UCC Article 2B提案的法律结构和适用范围
AI.findings: UCITA旨在为计算机软件、在线数据库等数字产品提供统一的交易法律规范，填补无形商品交易的法律空白
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了传统商品交易法律理论，为数字时代无形商品的合同法律规制提供了理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为各州提供统一的计算机信息交易法律标准，促进数字产品交易的规范化和法律确定性

title: Beyond Words: Fed Chairs' Voice Sentiments and US Bank Stock Price Crash Risk
affiliations: Athens University of Economics and Business - Department of Business Administration, Athens University of Economics and Business - Department of Accounting and Finance, University of Zurich - Department Finance and Athens University of Economics and Business

detail.title: Beyond Words: Fed Chairs' Voice Sentiments and US Bank Stock Price Crash Risk

publicationDetails.detailsText: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper No. 25-72
publicationDetails.journalName: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Building on the methodology of Gorodnichenko et al. (2023), we reconstruct and propose a novel measure that quantifies the voice sentiment of the Chair of the Federal Reserve press conference responses and examine its impact on the stock price crash risk of U.S. banks. We find that a more positive vocal sentiment, indicative of happiness, significantly reduces banks' ex-ante crash risk, whereas negative emotions, such as sadness and anger, amplify it. Our findings suggest that, beyond the textual content of monetary policy statements, the emotional delivery of central bank communication plays a critical role in shaping financial stability outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文基于Gorodnichenko等人的方法，构建了美联储主席新闻发布会回答的语音情感测量指标，研究发现积极语音情感（如快乐）显著降低银行股价崩盘风险，而消极情感（如悲伤、愤怒）则会放大风险。
AI.research_question: 美联储主席新闻发布会回答的语音情感如何影响美国银行的股价崩盘风险？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注央行沟通的文本内容，但忽视了情感传递对金融市场稳定性的影响，需要探索语音情感在央行沟通中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为金融学和情感传染理论，语音情感通过影响投资者情绪和市场预期来影响金融稳定性。
AI.method: 采用Gorodnichenko等人的方法重建并构建新的语音情感测量指标，分析其对美国银行股价崩盘风险的影响。
AI.findings: 积极的语音情感（快乐）显著降低银行的事前崩盘风险，消极情感（悲伤、愤怒）则会放大崩盘风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了央行沟通理论，强调了情感传递在货币政策沟通中的重要性，丰富了行为金融学在央行沟通领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行沟通策略提供实践指导，建议关注情感表达对金融市场稳定的影响，为银行风险管理和监管提供新视角。

title: What Works for Working Couples? Work Arrangements, Maternal Labor Supply, and the Division of Home Production
affiliations: University of Nottingham - School of Economics and New York University (NYU) - Department of Economics

detail.title: What Works for Working Couples? Work Arrangements, Maternal Labor Supply, and the Division of Home Production
detail.abstract: We provide the first causal evidence that changes to work arrangements – in the form of greater schedule regularity – can reduce the child penalty in earnings for women. The Australian 2009 Fair Work Act explicitly entitled parents of young children to request a change in work arrangements. Leveraging variation in the timing of the law, timing of childbirth, and the bite of the law across different occupations and industries, we establish three main results. First, new mothers used the Fair Work Act to maintain a regular schedule while reducing hours upon childbirth. Second, thanks to increased regularity, working mothers’ child penalty declined from a 47 to a 38 percent drop in hours worked. Third, while this increase in maternal labor supply implies a significant shift towards equality in the female- and male-shares of household income, we do not observe any changes in the female share of home production.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提供了因果证据，表明工作安排的变化（即更规律的工作时间安排）能够减少女性因生育导致的收入惩罚。通过澳大利亚2009年《公平工作法案》的实施，研究发现该政策使新妈妈能够保持规律工作时间的同时减少工作时长，从而将生育导致的工时惩罚从47%降低到38%。
AI.research_question: 工作安排的规律性变化（特别是更规律的工作时间安排）是否能够减少女性因生育导致的收入惩罚？
AI.motivation: 女性在生育后往往面临显著的职业收入惩罚（child penalty），这影响了性别平等和女性职业发展。现有研究主要关注工作时长减少的影响，但缺乏对工作时间规律性变化作用的因果证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动经济学和性别平等理论，重点关注工作安排灵活性对女性劳动力市场参与的影响，特别是工作时间规律性对减少生育惩罚的作用机制。
AI.method: 利用澳大利亚2009年《公平工作法案》的自然实验，该法案明确赋予年轻子女父母要求改变工作安排的权利。采用三重差分方法，利用法律实施时间、生育时间以及不同职业和行业对法律的敏感度差异进行因果识别。
AI.findings: 1）新妈妈利用该法案在减少工时的同时保持了工作时间的规律性；2）由于规律性增加，在职母亲的生育惩罚从工时减少47%降至38%；3）虽然母亲劳动力供给增加意味着家庭收入中女性份额向平等方向显著转变，但未观察到家庭生产中女性份额的变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供了工作时间规律性对减少女性生育惩罚的因果证据，拓展了工作安排灵活性理论，为理解性别收入差距提供了新的机制解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了实证依据，表明通过立法保障工作安排灵活性可以有效减轻女性生育后的职业发展障碍，促进职场性别平等。

title: When Am I Richer than You? Toward a Meaningful Comparison of Income of Nations
affiliations: Concordia University, Quebec - Department of Economics and University of Bergen

detail.title: When Am I Richer than You? Toward a Meaningful Comparison of Income of Nations
detail.abstract: Per-capita national income remains a primary indicator of wellbeing in an international comparison. Accordingly, the World Bank has popularised the concept of constant-dollar income of a given base year (say 2015), which converts income denominated in constant local currency units (LCU) to a common base year and uses the market exchange rate of that year to derive the ‘2015 constant-USD’ income which is directly comparable across nations. The issue we address here centres on the evolving base year; with each change, a new constant USD income series is born embodying the base-year market exchange rate, which tends to be volatile. Predictably, the prior ranking of income of any two countries may well get reversed. To be concrete, as per 2010-base, Japan’s per capita GDP appeared to have peaked in 1991 at 10.4 percentage points above the US level, but by the constant 2015 metric, the 1991 Japanese income was only about 3/4th. Was Japan actually richer than the US in 1991? In an attempt to answer this, we propose replacing the market rate by a smoothed exchange rate. We then compare the smoothed exchange rates as well as the resulting constant-dollar income series with the PPP exchange rate and PPP income. We show that some of the smoothed rates yield exchange rates that are at least as stable as the PPP, measure the exchange rate movement at par with PPP, and the predicted income levels appear mutually consistent with the PPP income.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用平滑汇率替代市场汇率来计算不变美元收入，以解决基准年变化导致的国际收入排名反转问题，并证明平滑汇率与PPP汇率具有相似的稳定性。
AI.research_question: 如何解决因基准年变化导致的国际人均收入比较不一致问题？
AI.motivation: 世界银行使用基准年市场汇率计算不变美元收入，但市场汇率波动大，导致不同基准年下国家收入排名出现反转，影响国际比较的准确性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于汇率理论和购买力平价理论，探讨市场汇率波动对国际收入比较的影响。
AI.method: 提出使用平滑汇率替代市场汇率来计算不变美元收入，并与PPP汇率和PPP收入进行比较分析。
AI.findings: 平滑汇率产生的汇率至少与PPP汇率一样稳定，汇率变动与PPP一致，预测的收入水平与PPP收入相互一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于平滑汇率的国际收入比较新方法，丰富了汇率理论在国际经济比较中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际组织和研究人员提供了更稳定的国际收入比较工具，避免了基准年变化导致的排名反转问题。

title: Mitigating Cognitive Deficits from Prenatal Air Pollution: Experimental Evidence from a Nutrition Intervention
affiliations: , Peking University, Peking University and Peking University

detail.title: Mitigating Cognitive Deficits from Prenatal Air Pollution: Experimental Evidence from a Nutrition Intervention

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The data used in this study come from a previously conducted randomized controlled trial (ISRCTN44149146), which received ethical approval from the Institutional Review Board of Stanford University (No. 25734) and the Institutional Review Board of Sichuan University (No. 2013005-01). All participating caregivers provided oral informed consent for themselves and their child’s involvement at the time of the original trial. The present study is a secondary analysis of de-identified data and did not require additional ethical approval.
declarations.funderStatement: The project is supported by the Young Scientists Fund of the National Natural Science Foundation of China (No. 72403005).

detail.abstract: This paper examines the impact of prenatal exposure to air pollution on early childhood cognitive development and the potential mitigating role of nutritional interventions in China. Using variation in fetal exposure to PM2.5, we show that higher in-utero pollution levels reduce cognitive outcomes in early childhood. A randomized micronutrient supplementation program partially offsets these adverse effects, suggesting that improved nutrition can buffer some of the developmental damage caused by environmental shocks during gestation. These findings underscore the importance of complementary health and nutrition policies in alleviating the long-term consequences of environmental risk in developing countries.

AI.tldr: 产前空气污染暴露会损害儿童早期认知发展，但微量营养素补充干预可以部分缓解这种负面影响
AI.research_question: 产前空气污染暴露对儿童早期认知发展的影响是什么？营养干预能否缓解这种影响？
AI.motivation: 研究发展中国家环境风险对儿童发展的长期影响，以及如何通过健康政策来减轻这些影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境流行病学、发展经济学、胎儿起源假说
AI.method: 利用胎儿PM2.5暴露的变异，结合随机化微量营养素补充项目进行实证分析
AI.findings: 较高的产前污染水平会降低早期儿童认知结果；微量营养素补充能部分抵消这些不利影响
AI.theory_contributions: 为环境冲击对胎儿发育的影响提供了实证证据，验证了营养干预的缓冲作用机制
AI.practical_contributions: 强调了在发展中国家实施互补性健康和营养政策的重要性，为缓解环境风险的长期后果提供了政策依据

title: A Study of the Impacts of GST on Selected Service Sector Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises in Gujarat
affiliations: Sardar Vallabhbhai Global University

detail.title: A Study of the Impacts of GST on Selected Service Sector Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises in Gujarat
detail.abstract: The study explores how Gujarat’s service sector MSME units are affected by GST. Direct and indirect taxes are the main sources of income for the Indian government; the latter has undergone substantial reform over time. An important turning point in India’s tax system was the implementation of the Goods and Services Tax (GST), which replaced a complex system of state and central levies with a single, cohesive framework. Beginning in 1986, the first efforts towards GST reform were followed by the submission of the Constitution Amendment Bill in 2011 and the recommendations of the Kelkar Task Force’s in 2000. The Constitution (122nd Amendment) Bill of 2014 was passed in spite of early opposition, opening the door for the implementation of GST on 1 July, 2017. Three parts make up the GST system, which is organised around the idea of “One Nation, One Tax”: The Central GST (CGST), State GST (SGST), and Integrated GST (IGST). Goods and services are subject to the tax, which is divided into four tax slabs: 5%, 12%, 18%, and 28%. Certain goods, such as those relating to gold and diamonds, are subject to lower taxes, while some necessities are exempted. For luxury and demerit goods, there is a compensating cess. The Union Finance Minister and members from each state and Union Territory make up the GST Council, which is crucial in determining tax rates, exemptions, and compliance procedures. Micro, Small, and Medium-Sized Enterprises (MSMEs) have benefited greatly from the new tax regime’s simplified compliance requirements, which include composition levy schemes, threshold exemptions, and quarterly GST return files. GST regulations must be followed by service sector MSMEs having a turnover of at least Rs. 20 lakhs (Rs. 10 lakhs for special category states). This paper examines the historical evolution of GST in India, its structural framework, and the economic impact on businesses, particularly MSMEs. By analysing the benefits and challenges associated with GST implementation, this study aims to provide insights into its role in promoting economic integration and simplifying tax compliance.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了GST对古吉拉特邦服务业MSME单位的影响，分析了GST的历史演变、结构框架及其对企业特别是MSME的经济影响，旨在提供关于GST在促进经济一体化和简化税务合规方面作用的见解。
AI.research_question: GST如何影响古吉拉特邦服务业MSME单位？
AI.motivation: GST作为印度税收制度的重要转折点，取代了复杂的中央和地方征税体系，建立了统一框架，对MSME企业具有重要影响，需要研究其实际效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于税收改革理论和经济一体化理论，分析单一税制对中小企业的影响机制。
AI.method: 历史分析法和政策分析法，通过分析GST的历史演变、结构框架和政策规定来评估其影响。
AI.findings: GST通过简化合规要求（包括组成征税方案、门槛豁免和季度申报）给MSME带来显著好处，服务行业MSME需遵守20万卢比营业额的门槛要求。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了发展中国家税收改革对中小企业影响的理论研究，为单一税制在促进经济一体化方面的作用提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供GST实施效果的评估，为MSME企业应对GST改革提供实践指导，帮助企业更好地理解和适应新的税收环境。

title: Dietary Exposure to Toxic Trace Elements Through Cooked Rice in High Rice Consuming Populations: A Comprehensive Risk Assessment in Sri Lanka
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Colombo - Department of Zoology and Environment Sciences, Sabaragamuwa University of Sri Lanka and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Dietary Exposure to Toxic Trace Elements Through Cooked Rice in High Rice Consuming Populations: A Comprehensive Risk Assessment in Sri Lanka
detail.abstract: Toxic Trace Element (TTE) contamination in rice poses a significant public health challenge, especially in populations with high rice consumption like Sri Lanka. This study evaluated the dietary exposure risk by measuring cadmium(Cd), arsenic(As), lead(Pb), and chromium(Cr) in widely consumed rice varieties in cooked form. Median(IQR) concentrations of Cd, As, Pb, and Cr in raw rice were 0.032(0.054), 0.049(0.028), 0.095(0.123) and 0.376(0.366)mg kg-1ww respectively. Red-rice showed higher Cd and As, whereas white-rice accumulated more Pb and Cr (p>0.05). No notable differences in TTE levels were found between Traditional, Improved or Imported rice varieties(p>0.05). Parboiled rice contained higher TTEs than non-parboiled rice(p<0.05). No samples exceeded JECFA-ML for Cd or As, with one exceeding the ML-Pb. However, 20% of samples surpassed the stricter 0.1 mgkg-1 Cd threshold used in several rice-consuming countries. Cooking reduced TTE levels significantly(p<0.001). Estimated daily intakes(EDIs) od Cd, As, Pb and Cr for a 61.4 kg Sri Lankan-adult were 0.271(±0.279), 0.297(±0.126), 0.643(±0.500), and 0.379(±0.333) mg day-1. The JECFA-PTMI-Cd was exceeded by 8.3% of samples, while 25% surpassed the EFSA-TDI-Cd. Potential carcinogenic risks were evident for Cd, As and Cr even at average consumption levels. Country-specific thresholds are recommended for ongoing monitoring to safeguard consumers with high rice intake.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了斯里兰卡大米中镉、砷、铅、铬等有毒微量元素污染情况，发现烹饪能显著降低污染物水平，但仍有部分样品超过安全阈值，建议制定国家特定标准以保护高米消费人群。
AI.research_question: 斯里兰卡广泛消费的大米品种中镉、砷、铅、铬等有毒微量元素的污染状况及其膳食暴露风险如何？
AI.motivation: 大米中的有毒微量元素污染对以大米为主食的人群（如斯里兰卡）构成重大公共卫生挑战，需要评估其污染水平和健康风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于食品安全风险评估理论，采用污染物浓度测量、每日摄入量估算和健康风险评价框架。
AI.method: 测量生米和熟米中Cd、As、Pb、Cr浓度，比较不同品种（红米/白米、传统/改良/进口、蒸谷米/非蒸谷米）差异，分析烹饪影响，计算估计每日摄入量(EDI)并与国际安全标准对比。
AI.findings: 红米Cd和As较高，白米Pb和Cr较高；蒸谷米污染物高于非蒸谷米；烹饪显著降低污染物水平；20%样品超过0.1 mg/kg Cd阈值；8.3%样品超过JECFA-PTMI-Cd标准；Cd、As、Cr存在潜在致癌风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了斯里兰卡大米有毒微量元素污染的详细基线数据，验证了烹饪对污染物降低的效果，为发展中国家大米安全评估提供了方法学参考。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议制定国家特定的安全阈值，为持续监测和高米消费人群保护提供科学依据，对公共卫生政策制定具有重要指导意义。

title: The Virtues of Clarity: Robert Dorfman, from Mathematical Programming to Environmental Economics

detail.title: The Virtues of Clarity: Robert Dorfman, from Mathematical Programming to Environmental Economics
detail.abstract: This article explores the career of American economist Robert Dorfman (1916-2002), that can be divided into three distinct phases. During the first phase (1938-1958), he made contributions to mathematical programming and statistics. The clarity of his work was particularly emphasized by his colleagues, who believed it greatly helped disseminate mathematical programming among economists in the 1950s. In the second phase (1959-1972), he contributed to water management. His work during this phase was more applied and characterized by its interdisciplinary nature. Notably, he collaborated with oceanographers, political scientists, and sanitation engineers. Again, his explanations of the economic approach to water management and the relevance of mathematical programming in this context were praised for their clarity. During the third phase (1972-1997), he moved away from the specific case of water to focus more broadly on environmental economics, especially on critiques of cost-benefit analysis. By retracing his career, this article sheds light on the links among his various contributions and the role that clarity plays in how an economist's work is received.

AI.tldr: 本文追溯美国经济学家罗伯特·多尔夫曼（1916-2002）的职业生涯，分为三个阶段：数学规划与统计学贡献（1938-1958）、水资源管理应用研究（1959-1972）和环境经济学批判研究（1972-1997），重点分析其工作清晰性对学术影响力的作用。
AI.research_question: 罗伯特·多尔夫曼的职业生涯如何演变？其工作的清晰性如何影响其学术贡献的被接受程度？
AI.motivation: 通过分析多尔夫曼三个不同阶段的学术贡献，探讨经济学家工作中清晰性对学术传播和影响力的重要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 学术职业生涯分析框架，清晰性在学术传播中的作用理论
AI.method: 历史文献分析和职业生涯轨迹追溯方法
AI.findings: 1. 多尔夫曼的职业生涯呈现明显的三阶段特征；2. 每个阶段的工作都因其清晰性而受到同事高度评价；3. 清晰性在数学编程和经济方法传播中起到关键作用；4. 从理论数学到应用研究再到批判性分析的职业转变路径
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了经济学家工作中清晰性对学术影响力的理论框架，为理解学术传播机制提供了新视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为年轻学者提供了职业生涯发展的参考模式，强调了跨学科合作和清晰表达在学术成功中的重要性

title: Sniffing the Context: Divergent Effects of Odor Valence on Intertemporal Choice in Loss vs. Gain Frames
affiliations: Southwest Jiaotong University, Southwest Jiaotong University, Southwest Jiaotong University and Southwest Jiaotong University

detail.title: Sniffing the Context: Divergent Effects of Odor Valence on Intertemporal Choice in Loss vs. Gain Frames
detail.abstract: Olfactory cues, processed via direct limbic connections, can potently modulate affective states, yet their influence on complex decisions like intertemporal choice (involving trade-offs between immediate and delayed outcomes) have received scant attention in the research literature. Grounded in hyperbolic discounting models, this study used within-subjects experiment to systematically investigate the impact of olfactory emotional valence on temporal discounting behavior. Forty-four participants (18 males, 26 females) performed an intertemporal choice task under pleasant (sweet orange essential oil) and unpleasant (sodium valerate) odor conditions, alongside a neutral (diluted water) control. The major findings are as follows: (1) A significant main effect of odor valence on choice was observed (F(2,86)=5.967, p<0.01, η2=0.122), with participants showing a stronger preference for the smaller-sooner (SS) option when exposed to unpleasant odors. (2) A significant main effect of task type emerged (F(1,86)=190.324, p<0.001, η2=0.816): the proportion of immediate choices was significantly higher in loss contexts than in gain contexts. (3) A significant odor valence × task type interaction was found (F(2,86)=3.402, p<0.05). Simple effect analyses revealed that unpleasant odors significantly increased decision impulsivity (more SS choices) specifically in the gain task (p<0.01), but not in the loss task. (4) Linear mixed-effects modeling indicated that odor valence influenced decision speed: the pleasant odor prolonged reaction times (RT) in both gain and loss contexts (p<0.001). Furthermore, the sequence of odor presentation dynamically modulated the expression of impulsivity over trials. These results reveal a context-specific mechanism by which olfactory emotions influence intertemporal choice, providing a theoretical basis for environmental sensory modulation of decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过实验发现嗅觉情绪效价对跨期决策有显著影响：不愉快气味会增加收益情境下的冲动决策，愉快气味会延长决策反应时间，且气味呈现顺序会动态调节冲动性表达。
AI.research_question: 嗅觉情绪效价如何影响跨期决策行为？
AI.motivation: 嗅觉线索通过直接边缘系统连接能有效调节情感状态，但其对复杂决策（如跨期选择）的影响在研究文献中很少受到关注。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于双曲线贴现模型，研究嗅觉情绪效价对时间贴现行为的影响。
AI.method: 采用被试内实验设计，44名参与者在愉快（甜橙精油）、不愉快（戊酸钠）和中性（稀释水）气味条件下完成跨期选择任务，包括收益和损失两种情境。
AI.findings: 1) 气味效价对选择有显著主效应，不愉快气味下参与者更偏好较小即时选项；2) 任务类型主效应显著，损失情境下即时选择比例更高；3) 气味效价与任务类型存在交互作用，不愉快气味仅在收益任务中显著增加决策冲动性；4) 愉快气味延长决策反应时间，气味呈现顺序动态调节冲动性表达。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了嗅觉情绪影响跨期决策的情境特异性机制，为环境感官调节决策提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为通过环境气味调节来干预冲动决策行为提供了实证依据，具有潜在的应用价值。
