title: Firmsʼ Investment and Capacity Utilisation: The Role of Financial Constraints and Uncertainty
affiliations: Maastricht University, Maastricht University, SPRU, University of Sussex and Maastricht University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Firmsʼ Investment and Capacity Utilisation: The Role of Financial Constraints and Uncertainty
detail.abstract: This paper studies the role of capacity utilisation in explaining investment behaviour in Italian SMEs and large firms. We propose a framework in which firms with high capacity utilisation are more likely to invest in maintaining a buffer against future shocks. Using firm-level data from the Bank of Italy’s Survey of Industrial and Service Firms (2002–2024), we empirically examine how deviations from a sector-specific target capacity utilisation influence investment decisions, accounting for the roles of uncertainty and financial constraints. Our findings reveal that Italian firms with high growth potential - those at the so-called “growth window” (Coad et al., 2021) - are more likely to invest. This result is primarily driven by large firms, while SMEs do not seem to respond strongly to the presence in such growth windows. Furthermore, we find that uncertainty does not deter investment among firms operating at high capacity, but instead stimulates investment in firms with low capacity utilisation. These insights have significant implications for industrial policy that targets support to firms at critical decision points in their growth trajectory.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了意大利中小企业和大企业的产能利用率对投资行为的影响，发现高增长潜力企业更可能投资，但这一效应主要由大企业驱动，中小企业反应较弱。不确定性对高产能企业投资无抑制作用，反而刺激低产能企业投资。
AI.research_question: 产能利用率如何影响意大利中小企业和大企业的投资行为？偏离行业特定目标产能利用率如何影响投资决策？
AI.motivation: 理解企业在不同产能利用率水平下的投资行为差异，特别是考虑到不确定性和财务约束的影响，为针对性的产业政策提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于企业投资理论，特别是产能利用率作为投资决策关键驱动因素的理论框架，结合增长窗口理论（Coad et al., 2021）
AI.method: 使用意大利银行工业和服务企业调查（2002-2024）的企业层面数据，实证分析偏离行业特定目标产能利用率对投资决策的影响
AI.findings: 1）高增长潜力企业（处于增长窗口）更可能投资，但主要由大企业驱动；2）中小企业对增长窗口反应较弱；3）不确定性不抑制高产能企业投资，反而刺激低产能企业投资
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了产能利用率与投资关系的理论理解，揭示了企业规模在投资决策中的调节作用，以及不确定性对不同产能水平企业的差异化影响
AI.practical_contributions: 为产业政策制定提供重要启示，建议在企业发展轨迹的关键决策点提供针对性支持，特别是针对不同规模企业和不同产能水平的企业制定差异化政策

title: Situating Sustainable Food Systems Within the International Trading Regime: What is at Stake for Developing Countries?
affiliations: Indian Institute of Foreign Trade - Centre for Trade and Investment Law and Indian Institute of Foreign Trade - Centre for WTO Studies

detail.title: Situating Sustainable Food Systems Within the International Trading Regime: What is at Stake for Developing Countries?
detail.abstract: Purpose-This paper aims to analyse the concept of the sustainable food system, and discussion on this topic at the international fora. This paper further explores increasing confluence of sustainable food system with international trade. Finally, this paper briefly traces the potential implications of sustainable food systems related obligations for developing countries and least developed countries (LDCs). This paper aims to bring forth the growing confluence of sustainable food system on international trade and potential implications. Design/methodology/approach-This paper studies the concept of the sustainable food system, growing interlinkage between sustainable food system and international trade through tracing the evolution of discussions related to sustainable food systems at various forums and the potential implications for developing countries. Findings-This paper shows that there is growing confluence of sustainable food systems with international trade. This paper also highlights the potential implications of the same for developing countries and LDCs. It is difficult, however, to conclusively trace all potential implications. Originality/value-This paper presents one of the first systematic accounts of the increasing confluence of sustainable food systems and international trade. It shows, at the same time, that developing countries and LDCs need to tread carefully in view of potential implications of the growing confluence of sustainable food systems and international trade.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了可持续粮食系统的概念及其在国际论坛上的讨论，探讨了可持续粮食系统与国际贸易日益增长的联系，并研究了其对发展中国家和最不发达国家的潜在影响。
AI.research_question: 可持续粮食系统与国际贸易之间的日益增长的联系是什么？这种联系对发展中国家和最不发达国家有哪些潜在影响？

AI.method: 通过研究可持续粮食系统的概念，追踪各论坛相关讨论的演变，分析可持续粮食系统与国际贸易之间的日益增长的联系。

title: Two Roads Diverge and Converge in the AI Era: Computer-Generated Works as an Exception for Human Authorship?
affiliations: School of Law, City University of Hong Kong

detail.title: Two Roads Diverge and Converge in the AI Era: Computer-Generated Works as an Exception for Human Authorship?
detail.abstract:
The intersection of copyright law and artificial intelligence (AI) presents numerous unresolved challenges, while the copyrightability of AI-generated content (AIGC) is particularly complex. Jurisdictions have adopted distinct approaches that converge and diverge in addressing this matter. Classic human authorship jurisdictions, such as the United States (US), China, and the European Union (EU), require AIGC to satisfy human authorship and originality requirements to be copyrightable. As a result, their debates focus on the level of original authorial contributions required for AIGC protection. In contrast, jurisdictions following the computer-generated works (CGWs) doctrine, such as the United Kingdom (UK) and Hong Kong (HK), diverge significantly when applying a plain interpretation approach. These jurisdictions treat AIGC as copyrightable subject matter regardless of originality standard, even though they also generally follow the human authorship requirement. The convergences and divergences among these jurisdictions make their comparison particularly valuable to explore.

 

To unpack this convergence and divergence, the article first examines relevant scholarly debates and recent legal developments in classic human authorship jurisdictions (represented by the US, China, and the EU) that illustrate how they address the copyrightability of AIGC. It then explores the CGWs doctrine in jurisdictions such as the UK and HK, highlighting how their approaches may differ significantly. In light of these divergences, particularly under a plain interpretation approach, the article argues that the divergent stance adopted by CGWs jurisdictions is doctrinally problematic and lacks theoretical justification. The article proposes a refined doctrinal approach to the CGWs doctrine that aligns more closely with the frameworks in human authorship jurisdictions regarding AIGC protection. While some divergences may persist, this refined approach establishes a more reasonable and justifiable framework, fostering greater convergence between the two systems.

 

This comparative analysis offers insights on unified pathways forward for jurisdictions navigating AI and copyright. These pathways include developing a more reasonable originality standard for AIGC, exploring limitations on AIGC copyright protection, and acknowledging the diminishing role of copyright law in the AI era. This recognition of the diminishing role underscores the need for alternative solutions beyond the traditional copyright regime to address emerging challenges more directly and efficiently.

AI.tldr: 本文比较分析了不同司法管辖区对AI生成内容(AIGC)版权保护的不同路径，探讨了传统人类作者管辖区和计算机生成作品(CGWs)管辖区的趋同与分歧，并提出改进的教义学方法以实现两大体系的更大融合。
AI.research_question: 不同司法管辖区在AI生成内容版权保护方面存在哪些趋同与分歧？如何建立更合理的AIGC版权保护框架？
AI.motivation: 人工智能与版权法的交叉领域存在诸多未解决的挑战，特别是AIGC的可版权性问题，各司法管辖区采取了不同甚至相互矛盾的处理方式，需要进行系统比较分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人类作者原则和原创性要求的传统版权理论，以及计算机生成作品(CGWs)学说，比较法理论框架。
AI.method: 比较法研究，分析美国、中国、欧盟等传统人类作者管辖区与英国、香港等CGWs管辖区的法律学说、学术争论和最新法律发展。
AI.findings: 传统人类作者管辖区要求AIGC满足人类作者身份和原创性标准，而CGWs管辖区在字面解释下将AIGC视为可版权主题而无论原创性标准，这种分歧在教义学上存在问题且缺乏理论依据。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了改进的CGWs教义学方法，使其在AIGC保护方面更接近人类作者管辖区的框架，建立了更合理和可辩护的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各司法管辖区提供了统一的前进路径，包括制定更合理的AIGC原创性标准、探索AIGC版权保护限制，以及认识到版权法在AI时代作用的减弱，需要超越传统版权制度的替代解决方案。

title: Hospitals' product strategies under market competition: The impact of common ownership
affiliations: Beijing Institute of Technology, Catholic University of Lille - IESEG School of Management, Catholic University of Lille - IESEG School of Management and China University of Political Science and Law

detail.title: Hospitals' product strategies under market competition: The impact of common ownership
detail.abstract: This study investigates the impact of common institutional ownership on hospitals' service line offering strategies. Using yearly data from 2005 to 2015, we measure the extent of common ownership change by the exogenous change caused by a prominent 2009 financial institution merger, and we use a linear probability model to run a generalized difference-in-differences analysis. Our findings uncover a positive impact of common ownership on hospitals' strategies of providing profitable service lines, and negative impacts on their providing unprofitable services. Financial institutions’ investments in hospital systems can cause concerns regarding the hospitals’ balance between profit-driven and welfare-driven objectives. We address these concerns by analyzing the impact of common ownership on a structural indicator of hospital quality, and find that common ownership leads hospitals to improve quality, as measured by staff-to-patient ratios, while in the pursuit of profits.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过2009年金融机构合并的外生冲击，发现共同机构所有权促使医院增加盈利性服务项目、减少非盈利性服务，但在追求利润的同时通过提高医护人员配置比例来改善医疗质量。
AI.research_question: 共同机构所有权如何影响医院的服务项目提供策略？
AI.motivation: 金融机构对医院系统的投资可能引发医院在利润驱动和福利驱动目标之间平衡的担忧，需要实证研究共同所有权的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于机构所有权理论和医院战略管理理论，探讨共同所有权对医院服务线决策的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用2005-2015年年度数据，以2009年金融机构合并作为外生冲击，采用线性概率模型进行广义双重差分分析。
AI.findings: 共同所有权对医院提供盈利性服务线有正向影响，对非盈利性服务有负向影响；同时通过提高医护人员与患者比例来改善医疗质量。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了机构所有权理论在医疗领域的应用，揭示了共同所有权同时影响医院服务策略和质量改进的双重机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医院管理者和政策制定者提供了关于机构投资影响的实际证据，有助于平衡医疗服务的经济效益和社会福利目标。

detail.abstract: Over the past decade, agent-based models (ABMs) have been increasingly employed as analytical tools within economic policy institutions. This paper documents this trend by surveying the ABM-relevant research and policy outputs of central banks and other related economic policy institutions. We classify these studies and reports into three main categories: (i) applied research connected to the mandates of central banks; (ii) technical and methodological research supporting the advancement of ABMs; and (iii) examples of the integration of ABMs into policy work. Our findings indicate that ABMs have emerged as effective complementary tools for central banks in carrying out their responsibilities, especially after the extension of their mandates following the global financial crisis of 2007-2009. While acknowledging that room for improvement remains, we argue that integrating ABMs into the analytical frameworks of central banks can support more effective policy responses to both existing and emerging economic challenges, including financial innovation and climate change.

title: The Relationship between Immigration and Housing Price Case Study 17 Autonomous Regions in Spain from 2010 to 2022
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Relationship between Immigration and Housing Price Case Study 17 Autonomous Regions in Spain from 2010 to 2022

declarations.declarationOfInterest: In recent years, the problem related to immigrants to the housing market include rising rents and house prices that frequently appear on social media platforms. Besides that, Spain's golden visa policy has been terminated in April 2025. It makes the author wonder if immigrants really have an impact on Spain's housing market. The motivation for doing this research is the passion and interest to understanding about the impact of immigration on house prices

detail.abstract: Notably, previous research papers argue that the immigrant population has an impact on housing prices in the Spanish regions. House prices in Spain have shown a rising trend since 2014. The Spanish government has reformed their immigration policy in this period. The study's purpose is observing the relationship between the immigration population and housing prices in the period from 2010 to 2022 at the regional level. We utilized panel data from 17 autonomous regions in Spain and employ the fixed effects model (FEM). To ensure reliability and accurate results, the regression model is run with a robust check. The result reveals that the immigration population has a positive relationship with housing prices. In addition, the study adds interaction terms in the REM model to observe the influence of the immigration population on each region. The findings show the impact of immigration on large housing prices in economically developed regions, rather than in small regions. It is undeniable that there are endogeneity factors that affect house prices.

title: Global Metal Price Index and Solar Activity (1992 - 2024)
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Global Metal Price Index and Solar Activity (1992 - 2024)
detail.abstract: The report uses a methodological approach based on W. S. Jevons and A. L. Chizhevsky. During the study period, the years of solar cycles were numbered according to the order established in solar astrophysics, grouped and compared with the arithmetic mean values of global metal price indices. The resulting models have approximation reliability coefficients equal to 1.0 and 0.95. The study suggests a significant decrease in the world metal price index in 2025 and 2026.

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No personal or financial relationship with other people or organizations that may have or could be perceived to have influenced the study.

detail.abstract: This research aims to develop and integrate an AI-powered smart health application that allows individuals with metabolic disorders to create personalized plant-based patty formulations. The app will use individual health data, such as blood glucose levels, lipid profiles, and body weight, to recommend ingredients like low-glycemic grains or high-fiber vegetables tailored for conditions like diabetes, hypertension, and dyslipidemia. The project will also investigate user engagement, acceptance, and the application's usability in supporting dietary decision-making and promoting better health outcomes. The methodology includes compiling a database of nutritional and health data and developing an AI model that utilizes techniques like deep learning or knowledge-based systems to generate personalized recipes. The final product is expected to be a user-friendly dietary solution that bridges the gap between technology, nutrition, and healthcare, offering a practical approach to managing chronic conditions.

detail.abstract: Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine has prompted not only military and diplomatic responses, but also novel forms of international agreements centered on co-investment in resources and infrastructure. This essay examines the “minerals deal” between Ukraine and the United States. The agreement establishes a joint venture for investment in mining, hydrocarbons, and infrastructure in Ukraine. Although the key details are set forth in a Limited Partnership Agreement (LP Agreement) that remains undisclosed, insights can be drawn from the publicly available Agreement on the Establishment of a United States–Ukraine Reconstruction and Investment Fund (UURIF), official statements, a leaked draft of the LP Agreement, and interviews. This essay analyzes the deal’s implications for both Ukraine and the United States, as well as for broader questions of international law and global economic governance. It argues that the arrangement marks a shift toward a more transactional model for U.S. assistance where the United States requires the opportunity by contract to obtain stakes in a country’s resources in exchange for U.S. aid, military support, and financing. The essay highlights transparency issues, as neither the United States nor Ukraine have made public the LP Agreement.

title: Fiscal Regimes and Sustainability: Insights from Post-War Germany
affiliations: ISEG, Universidade de Lisboa and

detail.title: Fiscal Regimes and Sustainability: Insights from Post-War Germany

keywords: Fiscal Theory of the Price Level

detail.abstract: This paper investigates fiscal sustainability and the prevailing fiscal regime in the Federal Republic of Germany. Using annual data from 1950 to 2023, the long-term relationship between the primary balance and government debt is estimated using a single-equation error correction model (SECM). The results from this long-term analysis do not support the hypothesis of fiscal sustainability, and the SECM proves inconclusive in identifying a dominant fiscal regime, showing a statistically insignificant long-run coefficient and bidirectional Granger causality. Moreover, with the local projections method on quarterly data from 2002 to 2023, this impulse response analysis reveals a clear Money-Dominant (MD) regime. A discretionary positive shock to the primary balance leads to a significant a decrease in real government debt, a result consistent with the MD regime. These findings suggest that while Germany’s long-run fiscal framework is ambiguous, its policy dynamics in the 21st century have been characterised as sustainable fiscal practices.

title: The Economic Impact of Lives Saved in PEPFAR Countries
affiliations: Boston University, Boston University, University of California, San Francisco (UCSF) - School of Medicine, Brandeis University, Kaiser Family Foundation, Boston University and Boston University

detail.title: The Economic Impact of Lives Saved in PEPFAR Countries

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The team has no conflicts of interest to disclose.
declarations.funderStatement: The contents of this manuscript were developed under grant INV-046280 from the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundations.

detail.abstract:
Background: Previous research has demonstrated the lifesaving impact of the PEPFAR program, as well as the broader economic returns of global health investments more generally. As policymakers consider PEPFAR’s future, it is important to understand the program’s wider benefits. This study builds on prior estimates of PEPFAR’s effect on reducing all-cause mortality (ACM), translates these reductions in premature deaths to estimate the total number of lives saved, then analyses the associated impact on gross domestic product (GDP) in PEPFAR countries.

Methods: This study uses a panel data difference-in-difference model with heterogeneous treatment effects to estimate the relationship between PEPFAR spending and ACM over time. Fixed effects and instrumental variable panel models are then used to estimate the impact of ACM reductions on GDP in 30 PEPFAR countries. 

Findings: There is a significant positive relationship between PEPFAR and reductions in ACM, with an average ACM reduction of 3·50 per 1000 people in PEPFAR countries from 2004 to 2022. These reductions in premature death translate to roughly 84·58 million lives saved.  The fixed effects and instrumental variables models estimate that each one-point decrease in ACM is associated with a 9·0 - 12·3% increase in average GDP.  Together, these estimates indicate that PEPFAR is associated with an additional 2·3 - 3·3% annual GDP growth in PEPFAR countries—for a total economic benefit of $1·1 - $1·5 trillion across countries from 2004 to 2022.

Interpretation: This analysis finds that PEPFAR is associated with significant reductions in ACM that produce substantial economic gains. Disinvestment in the program could result in forgoing future health and economic benefits.

AI.tldr: PEPFAR项目通过降低全因死亡率拯救了约8458万人的生命，并带来1.1-1.5万亿美元的经济收益，年均GDP增长2.3-3.3%。

title: Income Distribution, Welfare, and the Patterns of Trade
affiliations: University of St. Gallen - Swiss Institute for International Economics and Applied Economic Research,  and University of Zurich

detail.title: Income Distribution, Welfare, and the Patterns of Trade
detail.abstract: We develop a two-country model of international trade featuring non-homothetic preferences and income inequality, generating a price schedule where cheap necessities coexist with expensive luxury goods. A central mechanism driving price differences is firm’s ability to shift fixed costs between countries, shaping trade patterns and welfare. In a North-South setting, poor consumers in the rich country are most negatively affected by this fixed cost shifting, leading to a Manhattan effect. Following mean-preserving redistribution, import volumes rise in the unequal country, and fall in the more equal one.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个包含非位似偏好和收入不平等的两国贸易模型，解释了必需品低价与奢侈品高价并存的现象。核心机制是企业能够在国家间转移固定成本，这影响了贸易模式和福利分配。在南北贸易背景下，富裕国家的贫困消费者受固定成本转移的负面影响最大，产生了"曼哈顿效应"。均值保持的再分配后，不平等国家的进口量增加，而更平等国家的进口量减少。
AI.research_question: 收入不平等和非位似偏好如何影响国际贸易模式、价格差异和福利分配？
AI.motivation: 传统贸易模型通常假设位似偏好，无法解释现实中必需品低价与奢侈品高价并存的现象，以及收入不平等对贸易模式的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于非位似偏好理论和收入不平等框架，构建两国贸易模型，引入企业固定成本转移机制。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建包含非位似偏好和收入不平等的两国一般均衡贸易模型。
AI.findings: 1) 企业固定成本转移导致价格差异；2) 富裕国家的贫困消费者受负面影响最大（曼哈顿效应）；3) 再分配后不平等国家进口增加，平等国家进口减少。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了包含非位似偏好和收入不平等的贸易理论框架，提出了固定成本转移机制和曼哈顿效应概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解收入不平等对贸易模式的影响提供了新视角，对贸易政策和收入分配政策具有启示意义。

title: The Uninsured Deposit Premium
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: The Uninsured Deposit Premium
detail.abstract: We estimate the uninsured deposit premium – the difference between the rates paid on uninsured versus insured deposits – by linking observed average deposit rates to an estimated share of uninsured deposits. Using U.S. bank data from 1991 to 2025, we show that the average uninsured deposit premium rose by nearly 400 basis points over this period. This rise reflects both falling insured deposit rates and rising uninsured deposit rates. We find a strong correlation with the monetary policy cycle: a onepercentage-point increase in the Federal Funds Rate corresponds to a rise of roughly 32 basis points in the uninsured deposit premium. We develop a bargaining model between banks, insured depositors, and uninsured depositors that explains these dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析1991-2025年美国银行数据，发现未保险存款溢价（未保险与保险存款利率之差）在此期间上升了近400个基点，且与货币政策周期密切相关。
AI.research_question: 未保险存款溢价如何随时间变化？其与货币政策周期的关系如何？
AI.motivation: 理解银行体系中未保险存款与保险存款之间的利率差异动态，以及货币政策对存款定价的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 银行、保险存款人和未保险存款人之间的议价模型
AI.method: 使用1991-2025年美国银行数据，将观察到的平均存款利率与估计的未保险存款份额相关联
AI.findings: 未保险存款溢价在此期间上升近400个基点，与联邦基金利率呈正相关（每上升1个百分点对应约32个基点的溢价上升）
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了银行与不同类型存款人之间的议价模型，解释了未保险存款溢价的动态变化
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构和银行提供了关于存款定价和货币政策传导机制的重要见解

title: Information Disclosure, Search Cost, and the Housing Market
affiliations: Tsinghua University - Hang Lung Center for Real Estate, Tsinghua University - Department of Construction Management, University of International Business and Economics (UIBE) - School of International Trade and Economics and Tsinghua University - Hang Lung Center for Real Estate

detail.title: Information Disclosure, Search Cost, and the Housing Market
detail.abstract: This study examines the impact of information disclosure on housing market outcomes. Leveraging an administrative housing resale transactions dataset in Beijing, we employ a boundary discontinuity design and difference-in-differences model to explore the consequences of prohibiting school-district labels in the online listing information. Our results show that the prohibition leads to a 2.44% reduction in transaction prices and a 19.82% increase in the seller’s time on the market for the houses corresponding to the key primary schools compared with the other houses. The extended time on the market is primarily attributed to the heightened search cost that potential buyers face in finding their ideal dwellings. Moreover, the changes in buyers’ search behavior and sellers’ time on the market prompt the sellers to lower the listing prices to attract potential buyers and lead to lower transaction prices. Overall, the empirical evidence highlights the importance of information disclosure during the housing search process.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过北京住房交易数据，采用边界断点设计和双重差分模型，发现禁止在线房源信息中标注学区标签导致重点学区房交易价格下降2.44%，卖家挂牌时间延长19.82%，揭示了信息披露对住房市场的重要影响。
AI.research_question: 禁止在线房源信息中标注学区标签对住房市场结果（交易价格和销售时间）有何影响？
AI.motivation: 探讨信息披露在住房市场中的作用，特别是在学区房这一重要属性被隐藏时，对市场交易效率和价格形成机制的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息不对称理论和搜索成本理论，研究信息披露对住房市场效率的影响。
AI.method: 使用北京住房转售交易行政数据，采用边界断点设计（boundary discontinuity design）和双重差分模型（difference-in-differences）进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 禁止学区标签标注导致重点小学对应学区房交易价格下降2.44%，卖家挂牌时间延长19.82%；搜索成本增加是主要原因，卖家通过降低挂牌价格来吸引买家。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了信息不对称理论在住房市场中的应用，验证了信息披露对市场效率的重要影响，为搜索成本理论提供了新的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为房地产平台的信息披露政策提供参考，帮助政策制定者理解信息透明度对市场稳定性的作用，对买家和卖家的决策具有指导意义。

title: Governance Pathology in the Western Balkans:How Ignored Expertise and Political Pricing Doomed Bosnia’s Emission Plan
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Governance Pathology in the Western Balkans:How Ignored Expertise and Political Pricing Doomed Bosnia’s Emission Plan
detail.abstract: In 2015, Bosnia and Herzegovina submitted its National Emission Reduction Plan as part of its EU integration commitments to the Energy Community. Critically, the NERP drafting process—supported by an international organization and selected local consultants—excluded peer-reviewed research from Bosnia’s scientific community. Economically viable compliance scenarios and regulatory warnings were disregarded during finalization, reflecting institutional priorities misaligned with the public interest. A decade later, BiH has failed to implement the NERP, as evidenced by ongoing dispute settlements against thermal units breaching opt-out provisions. This policy failure stems from the dismissal of scientific expertise: authorities adopted an unworkable plan despite documented retrofitting scenarios and feasibility warnings, particularly about very high investment costs. The OECD (2024) indicates that artificially low electricity prices—characteristic of the regional Balkan governance pattern—have rendered compliance untenable. Consequently, this neglect jeopardizes BiH’s commitments to SDG 7, exposes the country to EU sanctions and Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism liabilities, and threatens the viability of its electricity sector. This Policy Perspective analyses the systemic sidelining of expertise as a cautionary tale for energy governance in BiH and the Western Balkans (WB) region.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那国家减排计划（NERP）制定过程中排斥科学专业知识导致的政策失败，揭示了该地区能源治理的系统性问题。
AI.research_question: 为什么波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那的国家减排计划（NERP）在制定过程中排斥科学专业知识，并最终导致政策失败？
AI.motivation: NERP制定过程排除了科学界的同行评审研究，忽视了经济可行的合规方案和监管警告，反映了制度优先事项与公共利益的不一致。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于政策制定中的专业知识排斥理论，分析制度优先事项与公共利益的错位问题。
AI.method: 政策分析，通过案例研究分析NERP制定和实施过程，结合OECD等国际组织的数据和报告。
AI.findings: NERP因排斥科学专业知识而不可行，十年后仍未实施；人为低电价使合规不可持续；威胁SDG 7承诺、面临欧盟制裁和碳边境调整机制责任。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了专业知识在政策制定中被系统性边缘化的实证案例，丰富了能源治理和制度分析理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为波斯尼亚和西巴尔干地区的能源治理提供警示，强调科学专业知识在政策制定中的重要性，避免类似政策失败。

title: Disruptive Timing
affiliations: Cheung Kong Graduate School of Business, Independent, Harvard Business School (Strategy Unit), University of Pennsylvania, The Wharton School and University of Michigan, Stephen M. Ross School of Business

detail.title: Disruptive Timing
detail.abstract: This study examines the role of strategic timing in disruptive innovation. We construct a model where an entrant decides when to enter with a potentially disruptive technology, and the incumbent determines whether and when to switch from its existing technology. By accounting for endogenous firm-specific learning alongside exogenous technological improvement, our model highlights the critical role of timing in shaping disruption. First, an entrant's strategic timing-whether to enter early or delay entry-can cause disruption by deferring the timing of the incumbent's response or deterring it altogether. Second, we identify conditions where incumbents, even those unable to initially mount a response, can later switch to the disruptive technology and coexist with an entrant. Based on these insights, we propose a typology of five distinct disruption types-Perfect, Postponed, Passing, Phased, and Partial-that expands the traditional understanding of disruption beyond the oft-studied "perfect" cases to comprehend transient and mixed cases as well. Our theory of disruptive timing integrates the literatures on strategic timing and disruptive innovation to offer a new perspective for scholars and actionable insights for practitioners.

AI.tldr: 本研究构建了一个战略时机选择模型，分析了进入者何时引入颠覆性技术以及现有企业如何应对的决策过程，提出了五种颠覆类型分类，扩展了对颠覆性创新的传统理解。
AI.research_question: 战略时机在颠覆性创新中扮演什么角色？进入者何时进入以及现有企业何时转换技术的决策如何影响颠覆过程？
AI.motivation: 传统颠覆性创新研究主要关注"完美"颠覆案例，缺乏对时机选择策略和混合结果的理解，需要更全面的理论框架来解释不同颠覆模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合战略时机理论和颠覆性创新理论，构建内生企业特定学习与外生技术改进相结合的理论模型。
AI.method: 构建理论模型分析进入者和现有企业的战略时机决策，通过数学建模推导最优进入和转换时机条件。
AI.findings: 1) 进入者的战略时机选择（早进入或延迟进入）可以通过推迟或阻止现有企业响应而导致颠覆；2) 即使现有企业最初无法响应，后期仍可能转换技术并与进入者共存；3) 提出了五种颠覆类型分类：完美、推迟、错过、分阶段和部分颠覆。
AI.theory_contributions: 将战略时机理论与颠覆性创新理论整合，提出了更全面的颠覆类型学，扩展了对非完美颠覆案例的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实践者提供了可操作的洞察，帮助企业制定进入时机策略和应对颠覆性技术的响应策略，识别不同类型的颠覆模式并制定相应战略。

reference: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper No. 25-73
title: Is AI Trained on Public Money? Evidence from US Data Centers
affiliations: University of Lausanne, Norges Bank and Swiss Finance Institute - HEC Lausanne

detail.title: Is AI Trained on Public Money? Evidence from US Data Centers

publicationDetails.detailsText: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper No. 25-73
publicationDetails.journalName: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We leverage a comprehensive dataset on U.S. data center energy loads, utility electricity prices, and establishment-level revenues, employment, and carbon emissions from 2010 to 2023 to examine whether rising data center demand affects local retail energy prices or other spillovers. For identification, we employ an instrumental variables continuous difference-indifferences design, exploiting exogenous variation in data center location attractiveness. We find no detectable local spillover effects from data center energy growth. A regional model calibrated to these null results suggests that shocks larger than those observed through 2023 could still result in noticeable increases in household utility bills if not offset by regulation or external supply.

AI.tldr: 基于2010-2023年美国数据中心能源负荷、电力价格和企业数据的分析显示，数据中心能源需求增长未对当地零售能源价格产生可检测的溢出效应，但更大规模冲击可能导致家庭电费上涨。
AI.research_question: 数据中心能源需求增长是否会影响当地零售能源价格并产生其他溢出效应？
AI.motivation: 随着数据中心能源需求的快速增长，需要了解其对当地能源市场和社区的潜在影响，为政策制定提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于工具变量连续双重差分设计，利用数据中心选址吸引力的外生变化进行因果识别。
AI.method: 使用2010-2023年美国数据中心能源负荷、电力价格、企业收入、就业和碳排放的全面数据集，采用工具变量连续DID方法。
AI.findings: 未发现数据中心能源增长对当地零售能源价格产生可检测的溢出效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了数据中心能源需求对当地市场影响的实证证据，完善了能源经济学和区域发展的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果表明当前规模的数据中心发展对当地能源价格影响有限，但为应对未来更大规模冲击的监管政策提供了参考依据。

title: Green Technology: How Innovation Is Redefining the Future of the Planet

detail.title: Green Technology: How Innovation Is Redefining the Future of the Planet
detail.abstract: This article discusses how technology can be an essential ally in building a sustainable development model, given global challenges such as climate change, socio-environmental inequalities, and accelerated urbanization. The analysis uses data from institutions such as the IEA, UN, IPCC, and IBGE, and addresses key sectors such as clean energy (solar, wind, biomass, green hydrogen), urban mobility, precision agriculture, sanitation, and waste management. Examples from countries such as Brazil, the USA, Germany, China, and Denmark illustrate different strategies and advances. The text argues that technological innovation, combined with public policies, environmental education, and social participation, is essential to promoting a just and resilient transition. Economic growth today must go hand in hand with environmental preservation-not separately from it.

AI.tldr: 技术是构建可持续发展模式的关键盟友，通过清洁能源、智慧城市、精准农业等技术创新，结合公共政策和社会参与，可以实现经济增长与环境保护的协同发展。
AI.research_question: 技术如何作为关键工具帮助应对全球挑战并构建可持续发展模式？
AI.motivation: 全球面临气候变化、社会环境不平等和快速城市化等严峻挑战，需要寻找有效的解决方案来促进可持续发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续发展理论、技术创新理论、环境经济学理论
AI.method: 基于IEA、UN、IPCC、IBGE等权威机构数据的文献分析和案例研究，重点分析巴西、美国、德国、中国和丹麦等国家的实践案例
AI.findings: 清洁能源技术（太阳能、风能、生物质能、绿氢）、智慧城市交通、精准农业、卫生设施和废物管理等技术领域在推动可持续发展方面显示出巨大潜力，但需要与公共政策、环境教育和社会参与相结合才能实现公正和韧性的转型
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了技术创新与可持续发展深度融合的理论框架，强调了技术、政策和社会三要素协同作用的重要性
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体的技术应用案例和实施路径，展示了不同国家在可持续发展技术应用方面的最佳实践，为全球范围内的可持续发展转型提供了可操作的参考方案

title: Redefining Originality in the Age of AI: The Originality Index, Mirror Spark and the Originality Enabling System

detail.title: Redefining Originality in the Age of AI: The Originality Index, Mirror Spark and the Originality Enabling System
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence has blurred the boundaries of human creativity, raising urgent questions about originality. Traditional frameworks-plagiarism detection, novelty checks, and intellectual property law-fail to capture the richness of originality in an age of humanmachine collaboration. This white paper introduces the Originality Index (OI), a multidimensional framework for measuring originality across four dimensions-Novelty, Resonance, Synthesis, and Ethical Anchoring. It also proposes the Mirror-Spark diagnostic as a telltale indicator of human creativity versus AI mimicry, and the Originality Enabling System (OES), a structured methodology for eliciting, benchmarking, and strengthening originality. Together, these establish a practical originality standard for education, innovation, governance, and culture in the AI century.

title: Globalization and Stock Price Crash Risk: Evidence from the US granting Permanent Normal Trade Relations to China
affiliations: Beihang University (BUAA) - School of Economic and Management Science

detail.title: Globalization and Stock Price Crash Risk: Evidence from the US granting Permanent Normal Trade Relations to China
detail.abstract: This study examines the influence of globalization, specifically the China trade shock, on stock price crash risk of US firms by employing the policy shock of the US granting Permanent Normal Trade Relations (PNTR) status to China in 2000. PNTR eliminated potential tariff increases on Chinese imports by permanently setting duties at NTR levels. We find that the China trade shock induced by PNTR significantly reduces the stock price crash risk of US firms. The relationship remains significant after controlling for various other contemporaneous policies which may be spuriously correlated with the PNTR shock, such as the Sarbanes-Oxley Act, the burst of the internet bubble in 2000, and policy changes in China. Additional tests on the impacts of PNTR on firm performance, earnings management and investment efficiency, and cross-sectional variation suggest that the disciplinary channel, rather than the offshoring channel, is likely to be the main underlying mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用2000年美国授予中国永久正常贸易关系地位的政策冲击，发现中国贸易冲击显著降低了美国公司的股价崩盘风险，主要机制是纪律约束渠道而非离岸外包渠道。
AI.research_question: 全球化（特别是中国贸易冲击）如何影响美国公司的股价崩盘风险？
AI.motivation: 探讨全球化对金融市场稳定性的影响，特别是中国贸易冲击对美国公司股价崩盘风险的潜在作用机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于贸易自由化理论、公司治理理论和信息不对称理论，分析贸易冲击通过纪律约束和离岸外包两种渠道影响股价崩盘风险的机制。
AI.method: 采用准自然实验方法，利用2000年美国授予中国PNTR地位的政策冲击作为外生变量，构建双重差分模型，并控制其他同期政策的影响。
AI.findings: 中国贸易冲击显著降低了美国公司的股价崩盘风险；通过企业绩效、盈余管理和投资效率等额外测试，发现纪律约束渠道是主要作用机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了全球化与金融市场稳定性的理论研究，揭示了贸易自由化通过改善公司治理降低股价崩盘风险的新机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了贸易自由化政策可能带来的金融市场稳定性收益的证据，对企业风险管理具有实践指导意义。

reference: International Journal of Emerging Digital Systems | August 2025
title: Resilient Smart Cities: Blockchain, AI, and IoT for Urban Cybersecurity

detail.title: Resilient Smart Cities: Blockchain, AI, and IoT for Urban Cybersecurity

publicationDetails.detailsText: International Journal of Emerging Digital Systems | August 2025

detail.abstract: Smart cities integrate transportation, utilities, healthcare, and public services into interconnected digital ecosystems. IoT sensors enable real-time monitoring and decision making, while AI provides analytics for traffic control, energy use, and emergency response. These advances improve efficiency but also create significant cybersecurity risks. Centralized data systems and legacy infrastructure remain vulnerable to attack. This paper examines how blockchain and AI enhance cybersecurity for smart cities. Blockchain secures data integrity and decentralized authentication, while AI enables anomaly detection and predictive defense. Methodology combines case studies, simulations, and pilot project analysis. The current standing shows progress but also major barriers in scalability, interoperability, and cost. The future outlook predicts convergence toward blockchain-backed AI frameworks as the foundation of resilient urban systems by 2035.

AI.tldr: 区块链和人工智能技术如何提升智慧城市网络安全，通过去中心化认证和异常检测增强数据完整性，但仍面临可扩展性和成本等挑战。
AI.research_question: 区块链和人工智能如何协同提升智慧城市的网络安全防护能力？
AI.motivation: 智慧城市在提升城市运行效率的同时，集中式数据系统和传统基础设施面临严重网络安全威胁，需要新的安全防护方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于区块链的去中心化安全框架和人工智能的智能威胁检测理论
AI.method: 案例研究、模拟仿真和试点项目分析相结合的方法
AI.findings: 区块链确保数据完整性和去中心化认证，AI实现异常检测和预测性防御，但在可扩展性、互操作性和成本方面仍存在重大障碍
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了区块链与AI融合的网络安全理论框架，为智慧城市安全防护提供新的理论基础
AI.practical_contributions: 为智慧城市网络安全建设提供了可行的技术方案和实施路径，预测到2035年区块链支持的AI框架将成为弹性城市系统的基础

title: Solow's Shameful Cheating Technology
affiliations: Chienkuo Technology University - Department of International Business

detail.title: Solow's Shameful Cheating Technology
detail.abstract: Solow derived a measure of technology. Discarding his wasteful calculation procedure, this paper applies a direct method to obtain more accurate results, and to prove that his bragging about the so-called good estimation is shameful cheating. The direct method is then used to derive another, more powerful and meaningful measure of technology that can also shift a production function. This paper disproves Solow's technology in and out.

AI.tldr: 本文驳斥了索洛的技术测量方法，提出了更准确的直接计算方法，并开发了更强大的技术测量指标
AI.research_question: 如何更准确地测量技术变化？索洛的技术测量方法是否存在缺陷？
AI.motivation: 索洛的技术测量方法计算过程浪费且不准确，其声称的良好估计实际上是欺骗性的
AI.theoretical_framework: 生产函数理论，技术测量理论，经济增长理论
AI.method: 直接计算方法，对比分析方法
AI.findings: 索洛的技术测量方法不准确且具有欺骗性；直接方法能获得更准确的结果；新开发的技术测量指标更强大且有意义
AI.theory_contributions: 推翻了索洛技术测量的理论基础，建立了新的技术测量框架
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了更准确的技术测量工具，为经济增长分析提供了更可靠的方法论

title: Multi-objective Optimization of BERTopic for Large-scale Scholarly Literature Analysis: Application to Autoregressive Models

detail.title: Multi-objective Optimization of BERTopic for Large-scale Scholarly Literature Analysis: Application to Autoregressive Models

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing interests.

detail.abstract: This study proposes a multi-objective optimization framework for BERTopic to advance largescale scholarly literature analysis on autoregressive (AR) models, including ARIMA, TSAR, and hybrid machine learning approaches. Employing the Non-dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm II (NSGA-II), we optimized the hyperparameters of UMAP and HDBSCAN with two objective functions-maximizing C_V coherence and Topic Diversity Score-under a feasibility constraint requiring at least 20 valid topics (≈ 5% of the corpus). In selecting optimal solutions, we further restricted the noise ratio (unassigned documents) to ≤ 30% in order to suppress excessively noisy outputs. Applied to 25,077 academic articles published between 2020 and 2024, the optimized model achieved a C_V Coherence Score of 0.76, a Topic Diversity Score of 0.73, and identified 144 interpretable topics spanning domains such as environmental science, healthcare, and macroeconomic forecasting. Co-occurrence network analysis revealed that AR-based models are organized into two major clusters-environmental and ecological forecasting, and biomedical and signal-processing applications-with technological topics such as renewable energy, battery modeling, and vehicle control serving as interdisciplinary bridges. Complementary community analysis using UMAP-based clustering identified 13 semantically coherent communities, encompassing both large-scale themes (e.g., air pollution, energy markets) and smaller, domain-specific ones (e.g., traffic safety, financial inclusion, education and gender). These findings empirically demonstrate the extensive applicability of AR models across diverse scholarly domains, while also showing that the proposed optimization framework ensures enhanced interpretability and coverage in large-scale literature analysis characterized by thematic diversity. Beyond AR-based models, the framework holds promise as a robust approach for topic classification across a wide range of scholarly corpora.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种多目标优化框架，用于改进BERTopic在自回归模型学术文猥分析中的性能，通过NSGA-II算法优化超参数并在大规模文档集上识别出144个可解释主题，显示了自回归模型在多个学科领域的广泛应用。
AI.research_question: 如何通过多目标优化框架改进BERTopic在大规模学术文猥分析中的主题识别效果和可解释性？
AI.motivation: 自回归模型在各个学科领域广泛应用，但缺乏系统性的大规模文猥分析方法来识别和分析这些模型的研究主题和跨学科应用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于BERTopic主题模型、多目标优化理论（NSGA-II算法）、UMAP降维技术和HDBSCAN聚类算法
AI.method: 使用NSGA-II算法优化UMAP和HDBSCAN的超参数，设置两个目标函数（最大化C_V相关性和主题多样性得分），并应用于25,077篇2020-2024年发表的学术文章
AI.findings: 优化模型达到C_V相关性0.76、主题多样性0.73，识别出144个可解释主题，发现自回归模型形成两个主要聚类（环境生态预测和生物医学信号处理），技术主题起到跨学科桥梁作用
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种新的多目标优化框架来改善大规模学术文猥主题分析的效果，为自动化文猥综述提供了理论支撑
AI.practical_contributions: 证明了自回归模型在多个学科领域的广泛应用，提供的优化框架可以应用于各种学术文档集的主题分类，提高文猥分析的效率和质量

title: Payment Frictions, Capital Flows, and Exchange Rates
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF), IMF, International Monetary Fund, International Monetary Fund (IMF) and International Monetary Fund (IMF) - Research Department

detail.title: Payment Frictions, Capital Flows, and Exchange Rates

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Cross-border payments are changing: existing intermediaries are upgrading their networks and new platforms based on novel digital forms of money are being explored, even as geoeconomic fragmentation is introducing new frictions. We develop a stylized model to assess the potential implications for the level and volatility of capital flows and exchange rates. On levels, we find that lower frictions in cross-border payments reduce UIP deviations and increase capital flows. On volatility, we find that the impact of lower frictions depends on the type of shock and the degree to which frictions decline. For real shocks, lower frictions increase capital flow volatility and reduce exchange rate volatility. For financial shocks, lower frictions increase exchange rate volatility while the impact on capital flow volatility is ambiguous. Specifically, when frictions decline by a small amount, capital flow volatility increases, while the opposite holds when the reduction in frictions is large. An increase in frictions reverses these results.

AI.tldr: 本文通过建立理论模型分析跨境支付摩擦降低对资本流动和汇率的影响，发现降低摩擦会减少UIP偏离、增加资本流动，但对波动性的影响取决于冲击类型和摩擦降低程度。
AI.research_question: 跨境支付摩擦变化对资本流动水平和波动性以及汇率波动性有何影响？
AI.motivation: 跨境支付正在变革，现有中介升级网络，新型数字货币平台涌现，同时地缘经济碎片化带来新摩擦，需要评估这些变化对国际资本流动和汇率的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于无抛补利率平价(UIP)理论，构建包含支付摩擦的资本流动和汇率决定理论模型
AI.method: 建立理论模型进行数值模拟分析，考察不同类型冲击（实际冲击和金融冲击）下支付摩擦变化的影响
AI.findings: 1) 支付摩擦降低减少UIP偏离，增加资本流动水平；2) 实际冲击下：摩擦降低增加资本流动波动性，降低汇率波动性；3) 金融冲击下：摩擦降低增加汇率波动性，对资本流动波动性的影响取决于摩擦降低程度
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统分析跨境支付摩擦变化对资本流动和汇率波动性的差异化影响，为理解数字支付技术发展对国际金融稳定的影响提供理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估跨境支付创新（如CBDC、稳定币等）的宏观金融影响提供参考，有助于设计适当的监管框架

title: Integrating Climate Change into Macroeconomic Analysis
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF), International Monetary Fund (IMF) - Fiscal Affairs Department, , International Monetary Fund (IMF), International Monetary Fund (IMF), International Monetary Fund (IMF), International Monetary Fund (IMF), International Monetary Fund (IMF), , International Monetary Fund (IMF), International Monetary Fund (IMF), , Washington and Lee University - Williams School of Commerce, Economics, and Politics, International Monetary Fund (IMF), International Monetary Fund (IMF) and

detail.title: Integrating Climate Change into Macroeconomic Analysis

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Climate change poses significant and diverse impacts on countries’ macroeconomic and financial stability, resulting in complex macro-critical policy challenges. Consequently, where significant, country-level macroeconomic analysis may need to integrate climate change-related impacts and policies. This paper reviews (i) climate change and related policies’ channels of impact on the real, fiscal, external, monetary, and financial sectors over various time horizons and (ii) corresponding data sources, models, and climate scenarios that could be applied in assessing the impact of physical climate risks as well as adaptation, transition, and mitigation policies. The paper concludes with considerations for future work.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了气候变化对宏观经济和金融稳定的影响渠道，以及评估物理气候风险和气候政策影响的数据、模型和情景分析方法。
AI.research_question: 气候变化及相关政策如何通过不同渠道影响宏观经济和金融稳定？
AI.motivation: 气候变化对各国宏观经济和金融稳定产生重大而多样的影响，带来了复杂的宏观关键政策挑战，需要在国家层面宏观经济分析中整合气候变化相关影响和政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于气候变化对实体经济、财政、外部、货币和金融部门的影响渠道理论框架
AI.method: 文献综述和分析方法，系统梳理气候变化的影响渠道、数据来源、模型和气候情景
AI.findings: 识别了气候变化在不同时间维度下对各经济部门的影响渠道，总结了可用于评估物理风险和气候政策影响的分析工具和方法
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了气候变化对宏观经济多部门影响的系统性理论框架，为气候变化经济学提供了综合分析视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了评估气候风险和制定应对政策的实用工具和方法论指导

title: Monetary Policy Effectiveness in Kazakhstan
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: Monetary Policy Effectiveness in Kazakhstan

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper assesses the effectiveness of monetary policy in Kazakhstan using a small macro model and identifies alternative plausible economic structures consistent with priors on the sign of responses of macro variables to structural shocks. Monetary policy effectiveness has increased over time.

AI.tldr: 本文通过小型宏观模型评估哈萨克斯坦货币政策有效性，发现货币政策效果随时间增强，并识别了与结构冲击下宏观变量响应方向先验一致的替代经济结构
AI.research_question: 哈萨克斯坦货币政策的有效性如何？货币政策效果是否随时间变化？
AI.motivation: 评估哈萨克斯坦货币政策效果，为政策制定提供实证依据，识别符合经济理论预期的经济结构
AI.theoretical_framework: 小型开放经济宏观模型，结构向量自回归(SVAR)方法，货币政策传导机制理论
AI.method: 使用小型宏观模型和结构向量自回归方法，结合先验约束识别结构冲击，分析货币政策对宏观经济变量的影响
AI.findings: 哈萨克斯坦货币政策有效性随时间推移而增强，识别出多个与结构冲击下宏观变量响应方向先验一致的合理经济结构
AI.theory_contributions: 为小型开放经济体货币政策有效性研究提供新的实证证据，发展了结合先验约束的结构识别方法
AI.practical_contributions: 为哈萨克斯坦货币政策制定提供实证支持，帮助政策制定者理解货币政策传导机制和效果

title: A Python Package to Assist Macroframework Forecasting
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF),  and

detail.title: A Python Package to Assist Macroframework Forecasting

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: In forecasting economic time series, statistical models often need to be complemented with a process to impose various constraints in a smooth manner. Systematically imposing constraints and retaining smoothness are important but challenging. Ando (2024) proposes a systematic approach, but a user-friendly package to implement it has not been developed. This paper addresses this gap by introducing a Python package, macroframe-forecast, that allows users to generate forecasts that are both smooth over time and consistent with user-specified constraints. We demonstrate the package’s functionality with two examples about forecasting US GDP and fiscal variables.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个Python包macroframe-forecast，用于在经济时间序列预测中系统地应用平滑约束，解决了现有方法缺乏用户友好工具的问题。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个用户友好的软件包来系统地在经济预测中实现平滑的约束条件？
AI.motivation: 在经济时间序列预测中，统计模型需要补充一个过程来平滑地加入各种约束，但系统地强加约束并保持平滑性是一个挑战。Ando (2024)提出了系统方法，但缺乏用户友好的实现工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Ando (2024)提出的系统方法，通过最优化技术在预测中平滑地强加约束条件。
AI.method: 开发Python包macroframe-forecast，提供用户友好的接口来生成时间上平滑且符合用户指定约束的预测。
AI.findings: 通过美国GDP和财政变量的预测示例，证明了该包能够有效地生成时间平滑且符合约束条件的预测结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 将理论方法转化为实际可用的计算工具，推动了约束预测方法的应用发展。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个开源Python工具包，使得经济学家和数据科学家能够轻松地在预测中实现平滑约束，提高预测质量和可靠性。
